entry.title: PIDP-Attack: Combining Prompt Injection with Database Poisoning Attacks on Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems

author.name: Haozhen Wang, Haoyue Liu, Jionghao Zhu, Zhichao Wang, Yongxin Guo, Xiaoying Tang

entry.summary: Proposes PIDP-Attack, combining prompt injection with database poisoning to attack RAG systems without requiring knowledge of specific user queries. Achieves higher attack success than existing methods.

entry.title: A Decade-Scale Benchmark Evaluating LLMs' Clinical Practice Guidelines Detection and Adherence in Multi-turn Conversations

author.name: Andong Tan, Shuyu Dai, Jinglu Wang, Fengtao Zhou, Yan Lu, Xi Wang, Yingcong Chen, Can Yang, Shujie Liu, Hao Chen

entry.summary: Introduces CPGBench, benchmarking LLMs on clinical practice guideline detection and adherence across 3,418 CPG documents from 9 countries spanning a decade, with 32,155 clinical recommendations across 24 specialties.

entry.title: MolQuest: A Benchmark for Agentic Evaluation of Abductive Reasoning in Chemical Structure Elucidation

author.name: Taolin Han, Shuang Wu, Jinghang Wang, Yuhao Zhou, Renquan Lv, Bing Zhao, Wei Hu

entry.summary: Introduces MolQuest, an agent-based benchmark for molecular structure elucidation requiring multi-turn interactive reasoning with experimental data, moving beyond static QA evaluation of LLM scientific capabilities.

entry.title: AD-CARE: A Guideline-grounded, Modality-agnostic LLM Agent for Real-world Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis with Multi-cohort Assessment, Fairness Analysis, and Reader Study

author.name: Wenlong Hou, Sheng Bi, Guangqian Yang, Lihao Liu, Ye Du, Hanxiao Xue, Juncheng Wang, Yuxiang Feng, Yue Xun, Nanxi Yu, Ning Mao, Mo Yang, Yi Wah Eva Cheung, Ling Long, Kay Chen Tan, Lequan Yu, Xiaomeng Ma, Shaozhen Yan, Shujun Wang

entry.summary: Introduces AD-CARE, a modality-agnostic LLM agent for Alzheimer's disease diagnosis that performs guideline-grounded assessment from incomplete, heterogeneous multimodal data with multi-cohort validation and fairness analysis.

entry.title: Maximum Entropy Behavior Exploration for Sim2Real Zero-Shot Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jiajun Hu, Nuria Armengol Urpi, Jin Cheng, Stelian Coros

entry.summary: Studies online zero-shot reinforcement learning for quadrupedal robots, building on the Forward-Backward algorithm with maximum entropy exploration to improve sim-to-real transfer. Demonstrates that directed exploration yields more diverse data for better downstream zero-shot policy recovery on real hardware.

entry.title: DeepFAN, a transformer-based deep learning model for human-artificial intelligence collaborative assessment of incidental pulmonary nodules in CT scans: a multi-reader, multi-case trial

author.name: Zhenchen Zhu, Ge Hu, Weixiong Tan, Kai Gao, Chao Sun, Zhen Zhou, Kepei Xu, Wei Han, Meixia Shang, Xiaoming Qiu, Yiqing Tan, Jinhua Wang, Zhoumeng Ying, Li Peng, Wei Song, Lan Song, Zhengyu Jin, Nan Hong, Yizhou Yu

entry.summary: Develops DeepFAN, a transformer-based model for classifying benign vs malignant lung nodules, trained on 10K+ pathology-confirmed cases. A multi-reader multi-case clinical trial shows AUC of 0.954 and demonstrates improved diagnostic accuracy for junior radiologists when assisted by the system.

entry.title: How unconstrained machine-learning models learn physical symmetries

author.name: Michelangelo Domina, Joseph William Abbott, Paolo Pegolo, Filippo Bigi, Michele Ceriotti

entry.summary: Introduces rigorous metrics to measure how unconstrained ML models learn physical symmetries (rotational equivariance) through data augmentation rather than architectural constraints. Shows these models learn approximate equivariance effectively.

entry.title: Flow matching on homogeneous spaces

author.name: Francesco Ruscelli

entry.summary: Proposes flow matching on homogeneous spaces (quotients of Lie groups) by lifting distributions to the underlying Lie group, reducing the problem to Euclidean flow matching on Lie algebras. Avoids computing geodesics or premetrics.

entry.title: A Systematic Empirical Study of Grokking: Depth, Architecture, Activation, and Regularization

author.name: Shalima Binta Manir, Anamika Paul Rupa

entry.summary: Presents a controlled empirical study of grokking (delayed generalization) on modular arithmetic, systematically disentangling architecture, optimization, and regularization effects. Finds grokking is primarily determined by optimization-regularization interactions rather than architecture alone.

entry.title: Optimal High-Probability Regret for Online Convex Optimization with Two-Point Bandit Feedback

author.name: Haishan Ye

entry.summary: Resolves an open problem in online convex optimization by providing the first high-probability regret bounds for strongly convex functions under two-point bandit feedback, addressing the challenge of heavy-tailed gradient estimators.

entry.title: Hessian-informed machine learning interatomic potential towards bridging theory and experiments

author.name: Bangchen Yin, Jian Ouyang, Zhen Fan, Kailai Lin, Hanshi Hu, Dingshun Lv, Weiluo Ren, Hai Xiao, Ji Chen, Changsu Cao

entry.summary: Introduces Hessian-informed MLIP (Hi-MLIP) that captures potential energy surface curvature for accurate molecular simulations. The HINT training protocol reduces Hessian label requirements by 2-4 orders of magnitude.

entry.title: Multi-LLM Query Optimization

author.name: Arlen Dean, Zijin Zhang, Stefanus Jasin, Yuqing Liu

entry.summary: Formulates multi-LLM query planning as a robust offline optimization problem minimizing cost under error constraints, proves NP-hardness, and develops a tractable surrogate using union bound decomposition and Chernoff bounds.

entry.title: Demystifying When Pruning Works via Representation Hierarchies

author.name: Shwai He, Guoheng Sun, Haichao Zhang, Yun Fu, Ang Li

entry.summary: Analyzes why network pruning succeeds on non-generative tasks but fails in generative settings through a representation hierarchy lens, finding that while embedding and logit spaces are robust to pruning, the probability space is highly sensitive.

entry.title: Translation or Recitation? Calibrating Evaluation Scores for Machine Translation of Extremely Low-Resource Languages

author.name: Danlu Chen, Ka Sing He, Jiahe Tian, Chenghao Xiao, Zhaofeng Wu, Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick, Freda Shi

entry.summary: Introduces FRED Difficulty Metrics (Fertility Ratio, Retrieval Proxy, Pre-training Exposure, Corpus Diversity) to contextualize machine translation results for extremely low-resource languages. Addresses the problem of incomparable performance across different language pairs.

entry.title: Knowledge-Guided Failure Prediction: Detecting When Object Detectors Miss Safety-Critical Objects

author.name: Jakob Paul Zimmermann, Gerrit Holzbach, David Lerch

entry.summary: Introduces Knowledge Guided Failure Prediction (KGFP), a monitoring framework that detects when object detectors miss safety-critical objects by measuring semantic misalignment between detector features and visual foundation model embeddings.

entry.title: No Hard Negatives Required: Concept Centric Learning Leads to Compositionality without Degrading Zero-shot Capabilities of Contrastive Models

author.name: Hai X. Pham, David T. Hoffmann, Ricardo Guerrero, Brais Martinez

entry.summary: Proposes concept-centric learning for contrastive vision-language models that improves compositionality without requiring hard negatives and without degrading zero-shot capabilities.

entry.title: SafeMath: Inference-time Safety improves Math Accuracy

author.name: Sagnik Basu, Subhrajit Mitra, Aman Juneja, Somnath Banerjee, Rima Hazra, Animesh Mukherjee

entry.summary: Introduces ToxicGSM, a dataset of 1.9k toxic math word problems, and shows that applying safety-aware inference-time reasoning (SafeMath) actually improves math accuracy while maintaining safety.

entry.title: S2D2: Fast Decoding for Diffusion LLMs via Training-Free Self-Speculation

author.name: Ligong Han, Hao Wang, Han Gao, Kai Xu, Akash Srivastava

entry.summary: Presents S2D2, a training-free self-speculative decoding framework for block-diffusion language models that reduces the block size to 1 for autoregressive speculation, enabling faster generation.

entry.title: Calibri: Enhancing Diffusion Transformers via Parameter-Efficient Calibration

author.name: Danil Tokhchukov, Aysel Mirzoeva, Andrey Kuznetsov, Konstantin Sobolev

entry.summary: Calibri shows that adding a single learned scaling parameter per DiT block can significantly improve diffusion transformer generation quality. It frames DiT calibration as a black-box optimization problem solved with evolutionary algorithms, modifying only ~100 parameters.

entry.title: DCARL: A Divide-and-Conquer Framework for Autoregressive Long-Trajectory Video Generation

author.name: Junyi Ouyang, Wenbin Teng, Gonglin Chen, Yajie Zhao, Haiwei Chen

entry.summary: DCARL proposes a divide-and-conquer autoregressive framework for long-trajectory video generation, using a keyframe generator for structural anchors and an interpolation generator for dense frames. This addresses visual drift and poor controllability in autoregressive video models.

entry.title: ICTPolarReal: A Polarized Reflection and Material Dataset of Real World Objects

author.name: Jing Yang, Krithika Dharanikota, Emily Jia, Haiwei Chen, Yajie Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces ICTPolarReal, a large-scale polarized reflection and material dataset of 218 real-world objects captured with an 8-camera, 346-light Light Stage setup, yielding over 1.2M high-resolution images with diffuse-specular separation.

entry.title: BiFM: Bidirectional Flow Matching for Few-Step Image Editing and Generation

author.name: Yasong Dai, Zeeshan Hayder, David Ahmedt-Aristizabal, Hongdong Li

entry.summary: BiFM proposes Bidirectional Flow Matching that jointly learns generation and inversion within a single model, enabling few-step image editing without relying on pretrained generators or auxiliary modules.

entry.title: GeoNDC: A Queryable Neural Data Cube for Planetary-Scale Earth Observation

author.name: Jianbo Qi, Mengyao Li, Baogui Jiang, Yidan Chen, Qiao Wang

entry.summary: GeoNDC encodes planetary-scale Earth observation data as a continuous spatiotemporal neural field, enabling on-demand queries of 20-year MODIS records and 10m Sentinel-2 imagery on consumer hardware.

entry.title: Z-Erase: Enabling Concept Erasure in Single-Stream Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Nanxiang Jiang, Zhaoxin Fan, Baisen Wang, Daiheng Gao, Junhang Cheng, Jifeng Guo, Yalan Qin, Yeying Jin, Hongwei Zheng, Faguo Wu, Wenjun Wu

entry.summary: Z-Erase is the first concept erasure method for single-stream diffusion transformers (like Z-Image), introducing stream disentangled erasure to prevent generation collapse that occurs when applying prior methods.

entry.title: THEMIS: Towards Holistic Evaluation of MLLMs for Scientific Paper Fraud Forensics

author.name: Tzu-Yen Ma, Bo Zhang, Zichen Tang, Junpeng Ding, Haolin Tian, Yuanze Li, Zhuodi Hao, Zixin Ding, Zirui Wang, Xinyu Yu, Shiyao Peng, Yizhuo Zhao, Ruomeng Jiang, Yiling Huang, Peizhi Zhao, Jiayuan Chen, Weisheng Tan, Haocheng Gao, Yang Liu, Jiacheng Liu, Zhongjun Yang, Jiayu Huang, Haihong E

entry.summary: THEMIS is a benchmark of 4,000+ questions across 7 scenarios for evaluating MLLMs on detecting visual fraud in scientific papers, covering 5 fraud types and 16 fine-grained manipulation subtypes from real retracted papers.

entry.title: CIV-DG: Conditional Instrumental Variables for Domain Generalization in Medical Imaging

author.name: Shaojin Bai, Yuting Su, Weizhi Nie

entry.summary: CIV-DG uses conditional instrumental variables from causal inference to address selection bias in medical AI domain generalization, disentangling pathological features from scanner artifacts.

entry.title: V2U4Real: A Real-world Large-scale Dataset for Vehicle-to-UAV Cooperative Perception

author.name: Weijia Li, Haoen Xiang, Tianxu Wang, Shuaibing Wu, Qiming Xia, Cheng Wang, Chenglu Wen

entry.summary: V2U4Real is the first large-scale real-world multi-modal dataset for Vehicle-to-UAV cooperative perception, featuring synchronized ground vehicle and UAV LiDAR/camera data.

entry.title: PMT: Plain Mask Transformer for Image and Video Segmentation with Frozen Vision Encoders

author.name: Niccol\`o Cavagnero, Narges Norouzi, Gijs Dubbelman, Daan de Geus

entry.summary: PMT introduces the Plain Mask Decoder that works on frozen VFM features for image/video segmentation, maintaining encoder-only speed while preserving the multi-task sharing benefit of frozen encoders.

entry.title: VideoWeaver: Multimodal Multi-View Video-to-Video Transfer for Embodied Agents

author.name: George Eskandar, Fengyi Shen, Mohammad Altillawi, Dong Chen, Yang Bai, Liudi Yang, Ziyuan Liu

entry.summary: VideoWeaver is the first multimodal multi-view video-to-video translation framework for embodied AI, enabling consistent appearance across multiple synchronized camera views for robot policy transfer.

entry.title: Wan-Weaver: Interleaved Multi-modal Generation via Decoupled Training

author.name: Jinbo Xing, Zeyinzi Jiang, Yuxiang Tuo, Chaojie Mao, Xiaotang Gai, Xi Chen, Jingfeng Zhang, Yulin Pan, Zhen Han, Jie Xiao, Keyu Yan, Chenwei Xie, Chongyang Zhong, Kai Zhu, Tong Shen, Lianghua Huang, Yu Liu, Yujiu Yang

entry.summary: Introduces Wan-Weaver, a framework for interleaved multi-modal generation (text and images together) using a decoupled training approach with a planner and visualizer. Constructs large-scale textual-proxy interleaved data to overcome training data scarcity.

entry.title: MMaDA-VLA: Large Diffusion Vision-Language-Action Model with Unified Multi-Modal Instruction and Generation

author.name: Yang Liu, Pengxiang Ding, Tengyue Jiang, Xudong Wang, Wenxuan Song, Minghui Lin, Han Zhao, Hongyin Zhang, Zifeng Zhuang, Wei Zhao, Siteng Huang, Jinkui Shi, Donglin Wang

entry.summary: Presents MMaDA-VLA, a native discrete diffusion VLA model that unifies language, images, and continuous robot controls in a single discrete token space trained with masked token denoising. Eliminates architectural overhead of hierarchical VLA approaches.

entry.title: Experiential Reflective Learning for Self-Improving LLM Agents

author.name: Marc-Antoine Allard, Arnaud Teinturier, Victor Xing, Gautier Viaud

entry.summary: Introduces Experiential Reflective Learning (ERL), enabling LLM agents to self-improve by reflecting on task trajectories to generate transferable heuristics that are retrieved and injected at test time for rapid environment adaptation.

entry.title: SliderQuant: Accurate Post-Training Quantization for LLMs

author.name: Shigeng Wang, Chao Li, Yangyuxuan Kang, Jiawei Fan, Zhonghong Ou, Anbang Yao

entry.summary: SliderQuant addresses post-training quantization for LLMs by observing that shallow/deep layers are more sensitive to quantization than intermediate layers, and proposes layer-differentiated quantization strategies accordingly.

entry.title: A Public Theory of Distillation Resistance via Constraint-Coupled Reasoning Architectures

author.name: Peng Wei, Wesley Shu

entry.summary: Introduces a theoretical framework for making AI models resistant to knowledge distillation by coupling high-level capabilities to internal stability constraints that are hard to transfer cheaply. Aims to address the asymmetry between capability transfer and governance.

entry.title: EcoThink: A Green Adaptive Inference Framework for Sustainable and Accessible Agents

author.name: Linxiao Li, Zhixiang Lu

entry.summary: EcoThink is an energy-aware adaptive inference framework that reduces unnecessary computation by avoiding indiscriminate Chain-of-Thought reasoning for simple queries, aiming to balance AI performance with environmental sustainability.

entry.title: GoldiCLIP: The Goldilocks Approach for Balancing Explicit Supervision for Language-Image Pretraining

author.name: Deen Dayal Mohan, Hossein Souri, Vitali Petsiuk, Juhong Min, Gopal Sharma, Luowei Zhou, Suren Kumar

entry.summary: Presents GoldiCLIP, a framework for vision-language pretraining that balances multiple supervision signals including text-conditioned self-distillation, an encoder-integrated decoder with VQA objective, and contrastive soft-label distillation. Aims to close the data gap in CLIP-style training.

entry.title: From Logic Monopoly to Social Contract: Separation of Power and the Institutional Foundations for Autonomous Agent Economies

author.name: Anbang Ruan

entry.summary: Proposes the AE4E paradigm for multi-agent systems based on constitutional separation of powers, addressing the 'Logic Monopoly' where agents simultaneously plan, execute, and evaluate. Reports 84% attack success rates in current frameworks.

entry.title: Probing the Lack of Stable Internal Beliefs in LLMs

author.name: Yifan Luo, Kangping Xu, Yanzhen Lu, Yang Yuan, Andrew Chi-Chih Yao

entry.summary: Probes whether LLMs can maintain implicit consistency in multi-turn interactions using a 20-questions game paradigm. Finds that LLMs struggle to preserve latent goals across turns without explicit anchoring.

entry.title: Adaptive Chunking: Optimizing Chunking-Method Selection for RAG

author.name: Paulo Roberto de Moura J\'unior, Jean Lelong, Annabelle Blangero

entry.summary: Introduces Adaptive Chunking for RAG, a framework that selects the most suitable chunking strategy per document using five novel intrinsic metrics, challenging the one-size-fits-all chunking paradigm.

entry.title: From Manipulation to Mistrust: Explaining Diverse Micro-Video Misinformation for Robust Debunking in the Wild

author.name: Zhi Zeng, Yifei Yang, Jiaying Wu, Xulang Zhang, Xiangzheng Kong, Herun Wan, Zihan Ma, Minnan Luo

entry.summary: Introduces WildFakeBench, a large-scale benchmark of 10K+ real-world micro-videos covering diverse misinformation types, and FakeAgent, a multi-agent system for misinformation detection with fine-grained attribution. Addresses a real gap in multimodal misinformation detection by covering AI-generated content, cognitive bias, and out-of-context reuse.

entry.title: Vega: Learning to Drive with Natural Language Instructions

author.name: Sicheng Zuo, Yuxuan Li, Wenzhao Zheng, Zheng Zhu, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu

entry.summary: Proposes Vega, a unified Vision-Language-World-Action model for instruction-based autonomous driving, with a 100K-scene dataset (InstructScene) annotated with diverse driving instructions and trajectories. Combines autoregressive and diffusion paradigms.

entry.title: Transformers in the Dark: Navigating Unknown Search Spaces via Bandit Feedback

author.name: Jungtaek Kim, Thomas Zeng, Ziqian Lin, Minjae Lee, Chungpa Lee, Jy-yong Sohn, Hyung Il Koo, Kangwook Lee

entry.summary: Investigates whether Transformers can approximate search algorithms (like bandit feedback-guided tree search) without external search components. Introduces a simplified framework pairing LLMs with bandit feedback for navigating unknown search spaces.

entry.title: From Intent to Evidence: A Categorical Approach for Structural Evaluation of Deep Research Agents

author.name: Shuoling Liu, Zhiquan Tan, Kun Yi, Hui Wu, Yihan Li, Jiangpeng Yan, Liyuan Chen, Kai Chen, Qiang Yang

entry.summary: Formalizes deep research agent behavior using category theory, modeling workflows as compositions of structure-preserving maps. Introduces a 296-question mechanism-aware benchmark for evaluating DRAs along four interpretable axes.

entry.title: Conformal Selective Prediction with General Risk Control

author.name: Tian Bai, Ying Jin

entry.summary: Proposes SCoRE, a framework for selective conformal prediction with general risk control using e-values. Provides strict error control for cases where the model is trusted, with guarantees built on conformal inference and hypothesis testing.

entry.title: Ultra-fast Traffic Nowcasting and Control via Differentiable Agent-based Simulation

author.name: Fumiyasu Makinoshima, Yuya Yamaguchi, Eigo Segawa, Koichiro Niinuma, Sean Qian

entry.summary: Presents a differentiable agent-based traffic simulator enabling ultra-fast calibration, nowcasting, and control on large-scale networks. Develops differentiable computing techniques for individual vehicle movement simulation.

entry.title: Supercharging Federated Intelligence Retrieval

author.name: Dimitris Stripelis, Patrick Foley, Mohammad Naseri, William Lindskog-M\"unzing, Chong Shen Ng, Daniel Janes Beutel, Nicholas D. Lane

entry.summary: Proposes a federated RAG system using Flower with confidential compute for server-side aggregation and LLM inference, enabling private retrieval across data silos with a cascading inference approach.

entry.title: TAPO: Translation Augmented Policy Optimization for Multilingual Mathematical Reasoning

author.name: Xu Huang, Zhejian Lai, Zixian Huang, Jiajun Chen, Shujian Huang

entry.summary: Introduces TAPO, a reinforcement learning framework extending GRPO for multilingual mathematical reasoning that uses English as a pivot language with step-level relative advantages decoupling understanding from reasoning.

entry.title: Self-Improvement of Large Language Models: A Technical Overview and Future Outlook

author.name: Haoyan Yang, Mario Xerri, Solha Park, Huajian Zhang, Yiyang Feng, Sai Akhil Kogilathota, Jiawei Zhou

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey of LLM self-improvement techniques covering autonomous data generation, self-evaluation, and iterative refinement of capabilities.

entry.title: A Framework for Generating Semantically Ambiguous Images to Probe Human and Machine Perception

author.name: Yuqi Hu, Vasha DuTell, Ahna R. Girshick, Jennifer E. Corbett

entry.summary: Uses semantically ambiguous images generated by CLIP embedding space interpolation to probe where humans and machine classifiers draw semantic boundaries, revealing machines are more biased toward specific concepts.

entry.title: DRoPS: Dynamic 3D Reconstruction of Pre-Scanned Objects

author.name: Narek Tumanyan, Samuel Rota Bul\`o, Denis Rozumny, Lorenzo Porzi, Adam Harley, Tali Dekel, Peter Kontschieder, Jonathon Luiten

entry.summary: DRoPS uses a static pre-scan of a dynamic object as an explicit geometric and appearance prior to improve dynamic scene reconstruction from casual videos. This addresses the ill-posedness of dynamic reconstruction, particularly for extreme viewpoints and articulated motions.

entry.title: Towards Video Anomaly Detection from Event Streams: A Baseline and Benchmark Datasets

author.name: Peng Wu, Yuting Yan, Guansong Pang, Yujia Sun, Qingsen Yan, Peng Wang, Yanning Zhang

entry.summary: Establishes the first event-stream benchmarks for video anomaly detection with synchronized event and RGB recordings, and proposes EWAD, an event-centric spatiotemporal framework for VAD.

entry.title: GaussFusion: Improving 3D Reconstruction in the Wild with A Geometry-Informed Video Generator

author.name: Liyuan Zhu, Manjunath Narayana, Michal Stary, Will Hutchcroft, Gordon Wetzstein, Iro Armeni

entry.summary: GaussFusion improves 3D Gaussian splatting reconstructions using a geometry-informed video generator that refines renderings by conditioning on Gaussian primitive buffers (depth, normals, opacity, covariance).

entry.title: GIFT: Global Irreplaceability Frame Targeting for Efficient Video Understanding

author.name: Junpeng Ma, Sashuai Zhou, Guanghao Li, Xin Gao, Yue Cao, Hengyu Zeng, Yuxiang Yan, Zhibin Wang, Jun Song, Bo Zheng, Shanghang Zhang, Jian Pu

entry.summary: GIFT proposes a training-free keyframe selection method for video LLMs based on frame 'irreplaceability' rather than greedy relevance/diversity scoring, achieving better global frame selection.

entry.title: Towards Foundation Models for 3D Scene Understanding: Instance-Aware Self-Supervised Learning for Point Clouds

author.name: Bin Yang, Mohamed Abdelsamad, Miao Zhang, Alexandru Paul Condurache

entry.summary: PointINS introduces instance-aware self-supervised learning for 3D point clouds, enriching representations with geometric instance-level features to improve transfer to instance localization tasks.

entry.title: VolDiT: Controllable Volumetric Medical Image Synthesis with Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Marvin Seyfarth, Salman Ul Hassan Dar, Yannik Frisch, Philipp Wild, Norbert Frey, Florian Andr\'e, Sandy Engelhardt

entry.summary: VolDiT is the first purely transformer-based 3D diffusion transformer for volumetric medical image synthesis, extending DiTs to native 3D data through volumetric patch embeddings and global self-attention.

entry.title: GridVAD: Open-Set Video Anomaly Detection via Spatial Reasoning over Stratified Frame Grids

author.name: Mohamed Eltahir, Ahmed O. Ibrahim, Obada Siralkhatim, Tabarak Abdallah, Sondos Mohamed

entry.summary: GridVAD uses VLMs as anomaly proposers rather than direct detectors, applying a propose-ground-propagate pipeline with stratified grid representations for training-free pixel-level video anomaly detection.

entry.title: Beyond the Golden Data: Resolving the Motion-Vision Quality Dilemma via Timestep Selective Training

author.name: Xiangyang Luo, Qingyu Li, Yuming Li, Guanbo Huang, Yongjie Zhu, Wenyu Qin, Meng Wang, Pengfei Wan, Shao-Lun Huang

entry.summary: Identifies a fundamental 'Motion-Vision Quality Dilemma' in video generation data where visual quality and motion intensity are negatively correlated. Proposes timestep-selective training that uses quality-imbalanced data at appropriate diffusion timesteps, showing gradients can match those from ideal 'golden data'.

entry.title: SABER: A Stealthy Agentic Black-Box Attack Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Xiyang Wu, Guangyao Shi, Qingzi Wang, Zongxia Li, Amrit Singh Bedi, Dinesh Manocha

entry.summary: Presents SABER, a black-box adversarial attack framework for Vision-Language-Action models that uses a GRPO-trained ReAct agent to generate minimal, plausible instruction perturbations that alter robot behavior. Tests across multiple VLA models.

entry.title: Towards Embodied AI with MuscleMimic: Unlocking full-body musculoskeletal motor learning at scale

author.name: Chengkun Li, Cheryl Wang, Bianca Ziliotto, Merkourios Simos, Jozsef Kovecses, Guillaume Durandau, Alexander Mathis

entry.summary: Presents MuscleMimic, an open-source framework for scalable motor learning with physiologically realistic musculoskeletal humanoids featuring 126-416 muscles. Provides validated models, retargeting pipeline, and massively parallel GPU simulation for motion imitation.

entry.title: SoftMimicGen: A Data Generation System for Scalable Robot Learning in Deformable Object Manipulation

author.name: Masoud Moghani, Mahdi Azizian, Animesh Garg, Yuke Zhu, Sean Huver, Ajay Mandlekar

entry.summary: Presents SoftMimicGen, a data generation system for scaling robot learning to deformable object manipulation, extending synthetic data generation paradigms from rigid-body to deformable tasks. From NVIDIA Research (Ajay Mandlekar).

entry.title: Can MLLMs Read Students' Minds? Unpacking Multimodal Error Analysis in Handwritten Math

author.name: Dingjie Song, Tianlong Xu, Yi-Fan Zhang, Hang Li, Zhiling Yan, Xing Fan, Haoyang Li, Lichao Sun, Qingsong Wen

entry.summary: Introduces ScratchMath, a benchmark for MLLMs to diagnose errors in student handwritten mathematics scratchwork. Challenges models to adopt an 'assessor perspective' rather than just solving problems, evaluating error explanation and classification capabilities.

entry.title: Reconstructing Spiking Neural Networks Using a Single Neuron with Autapses

author.name: Wuque Cai, Hongze Sun, Quan Tang, Shifeng Mao, Zhenxing Wang, Jiayi He, Duo Chen, Dezhong Yao, Daqing Guo

entry.summary: Proposes TDA-SNN, a framework that reconstructs spiking neural networks using a single leaky integrate-and-fire neuron with time-delayed autapses, realizing reservoir, MLP, and convolution-like architectures within a unified framework.

entry.title: Gaze patterns predict preference and confidence in pairwise AI image evaluation

author.name: Nikolas Papadopoulos, Shreenithi Navaneethan, Sheng Bai, Ankur Samanta, Paul Sajda

entry.summary: Uses eye-tracking to study how humans form preferences during pairwise AI image evaluation, finding that gaze patterns predict binary choice with 68% accuracy. Demonstrates the gaze cascade effect shifts toward chosen images ~1 second before decision.

entry.title: Photon: Speedup Volume Understanding with Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Chengyu Fang, Heng Guo, Zheng Jiang, Chunming He, Xiu Li, Minfeng Xu

entry.summary: Presents Photon, a framework for 3D medical volume understanding with MLLMs using variable-length token sequences, instruction-conditioned scheduling, and surrogate gradient propagation to reduce computational costs while maintaining quality.

entry.title: Free-Lunch Long Video Generation via Layer-Adaptive O.O.D Correction

author.name: Jiahao Tian, Chenxi Song, Wei Cheng, Chi Zhang

entry.summary: Identifies two out-of-distribution problems causing quality degradation in long video generation from short-clip models: frame-level relative position OOD and context-length OOD. Proposes FreeLOC, a training-free framework with layer-adaptive corrections.

entry.title: Does Explanation Correctness Matter? Linking Computational XAI Evaluation to Human Understanding

author.name: Gregor Baer, Chao Zhang, Isel Grau, Pieter Van Gorp

entry.summary: User study (N=200) testing whether computational XAI correctness metrics actually predict human understanding. Finds correctness affects understanding but not at every level, with thresholds and context-dependent effects.

entry.title: Are LLMs Overkill for Databases?: A Study on the Finiteness of SQL

author.name: Yue Li, David Mimno, Unso Eun Seo Jo

entry.summary: Analyzes the practical complexity of SQL queries across 376 databases, finding that SQL queries follow a Power Law distribution where 70% can be covered by just 13% of template types. Questions whether LLMs are overkill for text-to-SQL tasks.

entry.title: The Kitchen Loop: User-Spec-Driven Development for a Self-Evolving Codebase

author.name: Yannick Roy

entry.summary: Presents the Kitchen Loop, a framework for autonomous self-evolving software where LLM agents act as synthetic power users testing at 1000x human cadence. Validated across 285+ iterations with 1094+ merged PRs and zero regressions detected.

entry.title: Local learning for stable backpropagation-free neural network training towards physical learning

author.name: Yaqi Guo, Fabian Braun, Bastiaan Ketelaar, Stephanie Tan, Richard Norte, Siddhant Kumar

entry.summary: Introduces FFzero, a forward-only learning framework for neural network training without backpropagation, combining layer-wise local learning with prototype-based representations and directional derivatives. Targets physical neural network implementations.

entry.title: GraphER: An Efficient Graph-Based Enrichment and Reranking Method for Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Ruizhong Miao, Yuying Wang, Rongguang Wang, Chenyang Li, Tao Sheng, Sujith Ravi, Dan Roth

entry.summary: Proposes GraphER, a graph-based method for enriching and reranking in RAG systems that leverages document organizational structure without requiring knowledge graph maintenance. Addresses limitations of both semantic search and KG-based approaches.

entry.title: Spectral methods: crucial for machine learning, natural for quantum computers?

author.name: Vasilis Belis, Joseph Bowles, Rishabh Gupta, Evan Peters, Maria Schuld

entry.summary: Argues that spectral methods in ML are naturally suited for quantum computers, since the Quantum Fourier Transform enables efficient manipulation of Fourier spectra in quantum states. Connects the spectral bias hypothesis to quantum ML advantages.

entry.title: Learning to Rank Caption Chains for Video-Text Alignment

author.name: Ansel Blume, Burak Uzkent, Shalini Chaudhuri, Garin Kessler

entry.summary: Investigates ranking optimization as an alternative to binary DPO for training vision-language models on video-text alignment. Shows that ranking approaches better capture nuanced response quality dependent on visual content.

entry.title: The Geometry of Efficient Nonconvex Sampling

author.name: Santosh S. Vempala, Andre Wibisono

entry.summary: Presents an efficient algorithm for uniform sampling from arbitrary compact bodies under isoperimetry and volume growth conditions, generalizing results for convex and star-shaped bodies.

entry.title: Synthetic Rewriting as a Quality Multiplier: Evidence from Portuguese Continued Pretraining

author.name: Thales Sales Almeida, Rodrigo Nogueira, H\'elio Pedrini

entry.summary: Studies how synthetic document rewriting interacts with source data quality for Portuguese continued pretraining, showing that rewriting amplifies gains from already high-quality data more than low-quality data.

entry.title: Beyond Attention Magnitude: Leveraging Inter-layer Rank Consistency for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Peiju Liu, Jinming Liu, Xipeng Qiu, Xuanjing Huang

entry.summary: Introduces TIES, a dynamic token selection framework for Vision-Language-Action models that uses inter-layer token ranking consistency rather than just attention magnitude, improving efficiency without retraining.

entry.title: CORA: A Pathology Synthesis Driven Foundation Model for Coronary CT Angiography Analysis and MACE Risk Assessment

author.name: Jinkui Hao, Gorkem Durak, Halil Ertugrul Aktas, Ulas Bagci, Bradley D. Allen, Nilay S. Shah, Bo Zhou

entry.summary: CORA is a 3D vision foundation model for coronary CT angiography analysis that uses pathology-centric synthesis-driven pretraining to learn from volumetric CCTA data, addressing the scarcity of expert annotations in cardiovascular imaging.

entry.title: Select, Hypothesize and Verify: Towards Verified Neuron Concept Interpretation

author.name: ZeBin Ji, Yang Hu, Xiuli Bi, Bo Liu, Bin Xiao

entry.summary: Introduces a verification step for neuron concept interpretation, checking whether generated natural language descriptions of neuron functions actually correspond to meaningful, non-redundant features for network decisions.

entry.title: EgoXtreme: A Dataset for Robust Object Pose Estimation in Egocentric Views under Extreme Conditions

author.name: Taegyoon Yoon, Yegyu Han, Seojin Ji, Jaewoo Park, Sojeong Kim, Taein Kwon, Hyung-Sin Kim

entry.summary: EgoXtreme is a large-scale 6D pose estimation dataset from egocentric perspectives featuring extreme conditions: severe motion blur, dynamic illumination, and visual obstructions from smart glasses.

entry.title: Adaptive Learned Image Compression with Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Yunuo Chen, Bing He, Zezheng Lyu, Hongwei Hu, Qunshan Gu, Yuan Tian, Guo Lu

entry.summary: Proposes content-adaptive image compression using Graph Neural Networks that construct dual-scale graphs to capture spatially varying redundancy, moving beyond fixed CNN/Transformer receptive fields.

entry.title: DC-Reg: Globally Optimal Point Cloud Registration via Tight Bounding with Difference of Convex Programming

author.name: Wei Lian, Fei Ma, Hang Pan, Zhesen Cui, Wangmeng Zuo

entry.summary: DC-Reg achieves globally optimal point cloud registration under partial overlaps using difference of convex programming to derive tight bounds for Branch-and-Bound search.

entry.title: Persistent Robot World Models: Stabilizing Multi-Step Rollouts via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jai Bardhan, Patrik Drozdik, Josef Sivic, Vladimir Petrik

entry.summary: Proposes using reinforcement learning post-training for robot world models to stabilize multi-step autoregressive rollouts. Trains the world model on its own rollouts rather than ground-truth histories using contrastive RL, preventing quality degradation.

entry.title: $\pi$, But Make It Fly: Physics-Guided Transfer of VLA Models to Aerial Manipulation

author.name: Johnathan Tucker, Denis Liu, Aiden Swann, Allen Ren, Javier Yu, Jiankai Sun, Brandon Kim, Lachlain McGranahan, Quan Vuong, Mac Schwager

entry.summary: Introduces AirVLA, a system investigating transfer of manipulation-pretrained VLA models (like π₀) to aerial pick-and-place tasks. Finds visual representations transfer well but control dynamics don't, proposing a Payload-Aware Guidance mechanism to bridge this 'dynamics gap'.

entry.title: Sen. Sanders (I-VT) and Rep. Ocasio-Cortez (D-NY) propose AI Data Center Moratorium Act

author.name: Matrice Jacobine

entry.summary: Reports on the AI Data Center Moratorium Act proposed by Sen. Sanders and Rep. Ocasio-Cortez, which would prohibit new AI datacenter construction until Congress passes comprehensive AI safety legislation, and impose export controls on advanced chips.

entry.title: Resisting Humanization: Ethical Front-End Design Choices in AI for Sensitive Contexts

author.name: Silvia Rossi, Diletta Huyskes, Mackenzie Jorgensen

entry.summary: Argues that humanization in AI front-end design (emotive language, personality modes, anthropomorphic metaphors) is an underexamined ethical concern, especially in sensitive contexts like mental health. Advocates for design choices that resist inappropriate anthropomorphism.

entry.title: LogitScope: A Framework for Analyzing LLM Uncertainty Through Information Metrics

author.name: Farhan Ahmed, Yuya Jeremy Ong, Chad DeLuca

entry.summary: LogitScope is a lightweight framework for analyzing LLM uncertainty through token-level information metrics like entropy and varentropy, identifying potential hallucinations and decision points without requiring labeled data.

entry.title: Scalable Object Relation Encoding for Better 3D Spatial Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Shengli Zhou, Minghang Zheng, Feng Zheng, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes scalable object relation encoding for 3D spatial reasoning in LLMs, addressing the quadratic cost of encoding all spatial relations between objects by using more efficient representations.

entry.title: Learning From Developers: Towards Reliable Patch Validation at Scale for Linux

author.name: Chih-En Lin, Attreyee Mukherjee, Ajay Rawat, Ruqi Zhang, Pedro Fonseca

entry.summary: Studies 10 years of Linux memory management patch reviews and introduces FLINT, an LLM-based patch validation system. Reveals that patch review is bottlenecked by a few developers and proposes AI-assisted scaling of the review process.

entry.title: Learning Rollout from Sampling:An R1-Style Tokenized Traffic Simulation Model

author.name: Ziyan Wang, Peng Chen, Ding Li, Chiwei Li, Qichao Zhang, Zhongpu Xia, Guizhen Yu

entry.summary: Proposes R1Sim, a tokenized traffic simulation model that applies R1-style reinforcement learning with entropy-driven exploration to improve traffic simulation diversity and fidelity beyond supervised fine-tuning.

entry.title: Reinforcement learning for quantum processes with memory

author.name: Josep Lumbreras, Ruo Cheng Huang, Yanglin Hu, Marco Fanizza, Mile Gu

entry.summary: Adapts classical RL exploration-exploitation framework to quantum systems with hidden quantum memory evolving via unknown quantum channels. Proposes an optimistic maximum-likelihood approach for sequential quantum instrument interventions.

entry.title: SAVe: Self-Supervised Audio-visual Deepfake Detection Exploiting Visual Artifacts and Audio-visual Misalignment

author.name: Sahibzada Adil Shahzad, Ammarah Hashmi, Junichi Yamagishi, Yusuke Yasuda, Yu Tsao, Chia-Wen Lin, Yan-Tsung Peng, Hsin-Min Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SAVe, a self-supervised audio-visual deepfake detection framework that learns entirely from authentic videos by generating on-the-fly pseudo-manipulations and modeling lip-speech synchronization.

entry.title: WebTestBench: Evaluating Computer-Use Agents towards End-to-End Automated Web Testing

author.name: Fanheng Kong, Jingyuan Zhang, Yang Yue, Chenxi Sun, Yang Tian, Shi Feng, Xiaocui Yang, Daling Wang, Yu Tian, Jun Du, Wenchong Zeng, Han Li, Kun Gai

entry.summary: Introduces WebTestBench for evaluating computer-use agents on end-to-end automated web testing, going beyond static visual similarity to test latent logical constraints in web functionality verification.

entry.title: GlowQ: Group-Shared LOw-Rank Approximation for Quantized LLMs

author.name: Selim An, Il hong Suh, Yeseong Kim

entry.summary: Proposes GlowQ, a group-shared low-rank correction for quantized LLMs that caches a single shared factor per input-sharing group and selectively restores only the most impactful layers, reducing overhead of existing correction methods.

entry.title: Decidable By Construction: Design-Time Verification for Trustworthy AI

author.name: Houston Haynes

entry.summary: Proposes 'decidable by construction' approach where AI model correctness properties are verified at design time before training, using constraints over finitely generated abelian groups with polynomial-time decidability.

entry.title: Temporally Decoupled Diffusion Planning for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Xiang Li, Bikun Wang, John Zhang, Jianjun Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Temporally Decoupled Diffusion Model (TDDM) for autonomous driving motion planning that treats near-term and far-term trajectory segments with different noise levels, enabling the model to balance immediate safety with long-term goals. Uses a noise-as-mask paradigm to handle heterogeneous temporal dependencies.

entry.title: Demographic Fairness in Multimodal LLMs: A Benchmark of Gender and Ethnicity Bias in Face Verification

author.name: \"Unsal \"Ozt\"urk, Hatef Otroshi Shahreza, S\'ebastien Marcel

entry.summary: Benchmarks nine open-source multimodal LLMs (2B-8B parameters) on face verification tasks, evaluating demographic fairness across ethnicity and gender groups using IJB-C and RFW protocols. Examines bias in MLLMs used as face verification systems.

entry.title: SIGMA: Structure-Invariant Generative Molecular Alignment for Chemical Language Models via Autoregressive Contrastive Learning

author.name: Xinyu Wang, Fei Dou, Jinbo Bi, Minghu Song

entry.summary: Proposes SIGMA, a structure-invariant molecular alignment method for chemical language models that resolves the one-graph-to-many-sequences ambiguity via token-level contrastive learning, aligning latent representations of structurally equivalent partial graphs.

entry.title: A CDF-First Framework for Free-Form Density Estimation

author.name: Chenglong Song, Mazharul Islam, Lin Wang, Bing Chen, Bo Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a CDF-first framework for conditional density estimation that avoids the ill-posedness of directly estimating PDFs. By estimating the CDF first, it sidesteps noise amplification from differentiation of empirical distributions.

entry.title: MobileDev-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Language Models on Mobile Application Development

author.name: Moshood A. Fakorede, Krishna Upadhyay, A. B. Siddique, Umar Farooq

entry.summary: Introduces MobileDev-Bench, a benchmark of 384 real-world issue-resolution tasks from 18 production mobile apps spanning Android, React Native, and Flutter. Fills a gap in evaluating LLMs for mobile development specifically.

entry.title: A Distribution-to-Distribution Neural Probabilistic Forecasting Framework for Dynamical Systems

author.name: Tianlin Yang, Hailiang Du, Louis Aslett

entry.summary: Develops a distribution-to-distribution (D2D) neural forecasting framework that operates directly on predictive distributions rather than trajectories, using kernel mean embeddings for encoding/decoding.

entry.title: Prompt Attack Detection with LLM-as-a-Judge and Mixture-of-Models

author.name: Hieu Xuan Le, Benjamin Goh, Quy Anh Tang

entry.summary: Proposes using lightweight LLMs as security judges for prompt attack detection with structured reasoning processes, addressing the deployment gap between fast but brittle classifiers and slow but capable LLM judges.

entry.title: Separate Before You Compress: The WWHO Tokenization Architecture

author.name: Kusal Darshana

entry.summary: Proposes WWHO tokenization architecture with Syllable-aware Grapheme Pair Encoding for Abugida scripts, addressing the 'Token Tax' where complex scripts require disproportionately more tokens.

entry.title: Translation Asymmetry in LLMs as a Data Augmentation Factor: A Case Study for 6 Romansh Language Varieties

author.name: Jannis Vamvas, Ignacio P\'erez Prat, Angela Heldstab, Dominic P. Fischer, Sina Ahmadi, Rico Sennrich

entry.summary: Exploits translation asymmetry in LLMs for low-resource Romansh MT, finding that data augmentation direction should align with the resource gradient. Surpasses Gemini 3 Pro by 23 BLEU for the lowest-resource variety.

entry.title: UniICL: Systematizing Unified Multimodal In-context Learning through a Capability-Oriented Taxonomy

author.name: Yicheng Xu, Jiangning Zhang, Zhucun Xue, Teng Hu, Ran Yi, Xiaobin Hu, Yong Liu, Dacheng Tao

entry.summary: Introduces a capability-oriented taxonomy for multimodal in-context learning with six cognitive levels, constructs UniICL-760K corpus with curated 8-shot episodes across 15 subtasks.

entry.title: OpenCap Monocular: 3D Human Kinematics and Musculoskeletal Dynamics from a Single Smartphone Video

author.name: Selim Gilon, Emily Y. Miller, Scott D. Uhlrich

entry.summary: Introduces OpenCap Monocular, estimating 3D skeletal kinematics and musculoskeletal kinetics from a single smartphone video, with clinical-grade accuracy potential for biomechanical assessment.

entry.title: Relaxed Rigidity with Ray-based Grouping for Dynamic Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Junoh Leea, Junmyeong Lee, Yeon-Ji Song, Inhwan Bae, Jisu Shin, Hae-Gon Jeon, Jin-Hwa Kim

entry.summary: Proposes relaxed rigidity constraints with ray-based grouping for dynamic Gaussian splatting, explicitly preserving local geometric structure of Gaussians across time without external priors like optical flow.

entry.title: MoRGS: Efficient Per-Gaussian Motion Reasoning for Streamable Dynamic 3D Scenes

author.name: Wonjoon Lee, Sungmin Woo, Donghyeong Kim, Jungho Lee, Sangheon Park, Sangyoun Lee

entry.summary: MoRGS proposes efficient online per-Gaussian motion reasoning for dynamic 3D scene reconstruction from streaming multi-view inputs, explicitly modeling per-Gaussian motion rather than just optimizing photometric loss.

entry.title: Learning Explicit Continuous Motion Representation for Dynamic Gaussian Splatting from Monocular Videos

author.name: Xuankai Zhang, Junjin Xiao, Shangwei Huang, Wei-shi Zheng, Qing Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes SE(3) B-spline motion bases with adaptive control for continuous motion modeling in dynamic Gaussian splatting from monocular videos, with soft segment reconstruction and multi-view diffusion guidance.

entry.title: AnyDoc: Enhancing Document Generation via Large-Scale HTML/CSS Data Synthesis and Height-Aware Reinforcement Optimization

author.name: Jiawei Lin, Wanrong Zhu, Vlad I Morariu, Christopher Tensmeyer

entry.summary: AnyDoc introduces a document generation framework with a scalable HTML/CSS synthesis pipeline yielding 265K document samples across 111 categories, plus height-aware RL optimization for proper document rendering.

entry.title: AirSplat: Alignment and Rating for Robust Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Minh-Quan Viet Bui, Jaeho Moon, Munchurl Kim

entry.summary: AirSplat adapts 3D Vision Foundation Models for pose-free novel view synthesis via self-consistent pose alignment and rating-based opacity matching with a teacher model.

entry.title: AnyID: Ultra-Fidelity Universal Identity-Preserving Video Generation from Any Visual References

author.name: Jiahao Wang, Hualian Sheng, Sijia Cai, Yuxiao Yang, Weizhan Zhang, Caixia Yan, Bing Deng, Jieping Ye

entry.summary: AnyID enables ultra-fidelity identity-preserving video generation from multiple visual references of varying formats, addressing limitations of single-reference methods.

entry.title: CardioDiT: Latent Diffusion Transformers for 4D Cardiac MRI Synthesis

author.name: Marvin Seyfarth, Sarah Kaye M\"uller, Arman Ghanaat, Isabelle Ayx, Fabian Fastenrath, Philipp Wild, Alexander Hertel, Theano Papavassiliu, Salman Ul Hassan Dar, Sandy Engelhardt

entry.summary: CardioDiT investigates unified 4D generative modeling for cine cardiac MRI using latent diffusion transformers, learning continuous cardiac dynamics without space-time factorization.

entry.title: Training-free Detection and 6D Pose Estimation of Unseen Surgical Instruments

author.name: Jonas Hein, Lilian Calvet, Matthias Seibold, Siyu Tang, Marc Pollefeys, Philipp F\"urnstahl

entry.summary: Introduces a training-free pipeline for multi-view 6D pose estimation of unseen surgical instruments, requiring only CAD models and using pre-trained features for detection and geometric verification.

entry.title: Semantic-Aware Prefix Learning for Token-Efficient Image Generation

author.name: Qingfeng Li, Haoxian Zhang, Xu He, Songlin Tang, Zhixue Fang, Xiaoqiang Liu, Pengfei Wan Guoqi Li

entry.summary: SMAP proposes semantic-aware prefix tokenization for image generation, injecting class-level semantics into 1D tokenization with tail token dropping to make semantic information functionally necessary.

entry.title: ViewSplat: View-Adaptive Dynamic Gaussian Splatting for Feed-Forward Synthesis

author.name: Moonyeon Jeong, Seunggi Min, Suhyeon Lee, Hongje Seong

entry.summary: ViewSplat shifts from static Gaussian primitive regression to view-adaptive dynamic splatting for feed-forward novel view synthesis, predicting base Gaussians that are refined per target view.

entry.title: Towards Controllable Low-Light Image Enhancement: A Continuous Multi-illumination Dataset and Efficient State Space Framework

author.name: Hongru Han, Tingrui Guo, Liming Zhang, Yan Su, Qiwen Xu, Zhuohua Ye

entry.summary: CLE-RWKV reformulates low-light enhancement as a controllable conditional problem with a new multi-illumination dataset (Light100) and state space model framework, addressing the ill-posed nature of fixed-target enhancement.

entry.title: HeSS: Head Sensitivity Score for Sparsity Redistribution in VGGT

author.name: Yongsung Kim, Wooseok Song, Jaihyun Lew, Hun Hwangbo, Jaehoon Lee, Sungroh Yoon

entry.summary: HeSS proposes head-wise sparsity redistribution for VGGT, finding that different attention heads have heterogeneous sensitivity to sparsification, and uses this to achieve acceleration with less accuracy loss.

entry.title: CIAR: Interval-based Collaborative Decoding for Image Generation Acceleration

author.name: Keming Ye, Zhou Zhao, Fan Wu, Shengyu Zhang

entry.summary: CIAR proposes a cloud-device collaboration framework for accelerating autoregressive image generation, using on-device self-verification to exploit spatial redundancy and handle the large token vocabulary.

entry.title: Seeing to Ground: Visual Attention for Hallucination-Resilient MDLLMs

author.name: Vishal Narnaware, Animesh Gupta, Kevin Zhai, Zhenyi Wang, Mubarak Shah

entry.summary: Addresses hallucination in Multimodal Diffusion Large Language Models (MDLLMs) by reinterpreting hallucination as a localized optimization error where the decoder exploits language shortcuts. Proposes visual attention mechanisms for hallucination-resilient generation.

entry.title: Less Gaussians, Texture More: 4K Feed-Forward Textured Splatting

author.name: Yixing Lao, Xuyang Bai, Xiaoyang Wu, Nuoyuan Yan, Zixin Luo, Tian Fang, Jean-Daniel Nahmias, Yanghai Tsin, Shiwei Li, Hengshuang Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces LGTM, a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting method that decouples geometric complexity from rendering resolution by predicting compact Gaussian primitives with per-primitive textures, enabling 4K novel view synthesis without per-scene optimization.

entry.title: Understanding and tracking developments in robotics

author.name: janvi

entry.summary: A research note from Coefficient Giving on tracking robotics progress for AI safety, arguing that physical embodiment creates new catastrophic risk pathways as robots become more capable and autonomous, changing the threat landscape from screen-bound AI.

entry.title: From Stateless to Situated: Building a Psychological World for LLM-Based Emotional Support

author.name: Boning Zhao, Clover Hu, Xinnuo Li

entry.summary: Proposes LEKIA 2.0, a framework for constructing external situational structures for LLMs in emotional support scenarios, addressing problems of premature advancement, stage misalignment, and boundary violations in continuous therapeutic dialogue.

entry.title: Natural-Language Agent Harnesses

author.name: Linyue Pan, Lexiao Zou, Shuo Guo, Jingchen Ni, Hai-Tao Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces Natural-Language Agent Harnesses (NLAHs), expressing agent control logic as portable natural language artifacts rather than code, with an Intelligent Harness Runtime (IHR) for execution. Evaluates on coding and computer-use benchmarks.

entry.title: Residual-as-Teacher: Mitigating Bias Propagation in Student--Teacher Estimation

author.name: Kakei Yamamoto, Martin J. Wainwright

entry.summary: Proposes Residual-as-Teacher (RaT) for student-teacher learning, where the teacher estimates residuals in student predictions rather than targets directly. Provably reduces bias propagation from misspecified teachers.

entry.title: Is Mathematical Problem-Solving Expertise in Large Language Models Associated with Assessment Performance?

author.name: Liang Zhang, Yu Fu, Xinyi Jin

entry.summary: Examines whether LLMs' math problem-solving ability correlates with their ability to assess student solutions, using GPT-4 and GPT-5 on PROCESSBENCH. Finds a consistent gap between solving and assessment performance.

entry.title: UniAI-GraphRAG: Synergizing Ontology-Guided Extraction, Multi-Dimensional Clustering, and Dual-Channel Fusion for Robust Multi-Hop Reasoning

author.name: Jie Wang, Honghua Huang, Xi Ge, Jianhui Su, Wen Liu, Shiguo Lian

entry.summary: UniAI-GraphRAG enhances GraphRAG with ontology-guided knowledge extraction, multi-dimensional community clustering, and dual-channel fusion for improved multi-hop reasoning and cross-industry adaptability.

entry.title: Retraining as Approximate Bayesian Inference

author.name: Harrison Katz

entry.summary: Reframes model retraining as approximate Bayesian inference, introducing 'learning debt' as the gap between a continuously updated belief state and a frozen deployed model, and deriving evidence-based retraining triggers from a decision-theoretic framework.

entry.title: Sketch2Simulation: Automating Flowsheet Generation via Multi Agent Large Language Models

author.name: Abdullah Bahamdan, Emma Pajak, John D. Hedengren, Antonio del Rio Chanona

entry.summary: Sketch2Simulation is a multi-agent LLM system that converts process engineering diagrams directly into executable Aspen HYSYS flowsheets, bridging the gap between diagram understanding and simulation generation.

entry.title: FODMP: Fast One-Step Diffusion of Movement Primitives Generation for Time-Dependent Robot Actions

author.name: Xirui Shi, Arya Ebrahimi, Yi Hu, Jun Jin

entry.summary: Proposes FODMP, a fast one-step diffusion model for generating movement primitives in robot learning. Addresses the trade-off between speed and temporal structure in diffusion-based robot policies by combining single-step diffusion with Probabilistic Dynamic Movement Primitives.

entry.title: AI Security in the Foundation Model Era: A Comprehensive Survey from a Unified Perspective

author.name: Zhenyi Wang, Siyu Luan

entry.summary: Surveys AI security in the foundation model era with a unified framework treating data and model vulnerabilities as bidirectional and interdependent, rather than isolated threats.

entry.title: Learning domain-invariant features through channel-level sparsification for Out-Of Distribution Generalization

author.name: Haoran Pei, Yuguang Yang, Kexin Liu, Juan Zhang, Baochang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Hierarchical Causal Dropout (HCD) using channel-level causal masks to enforce feature sparsity for out-of-distribution generalization, separating causal from non-causal features in deep latent spaces.

entry.title: Factors Influencing the Quality of AI-Generated Code: A Synthesis of Empirical Evidence

author.name: Vehid Geruslu, Zulfiyya Aliyeva, Eray T\"uz\"un

entry.summary: Systematic literature review identifying factors influencing AI-generated code quality across 83 empirical studies, finding 14 key factors across model selection, prompt engineering, evaluation context, and post-generation processing.

entry.title: Activation Matters: Test-time Activated Negative Labels for OOD Detection with Vision-Language Models

author.name: Yabin Zhang, Maya Varma, Yunhe Gao, Jean-Benoit Delbrouck, Jiaming Liu, Chong Wang, Curtis Langlotz

entry.summary: Proposes TANL (Test-time Activated Negative Labels) for OOD detection with vision-language models, dynamically mining negative labels with high activation responses during testing rather than using static distant labels.

entry.title: A Causal Framework for Evaluating ICU Discharge Strategies

author.name: Sagar Nagaraj Simha, Juliette Ortholand, Dave Dongelmans, Jessica D. Workum, Olivier W. M. Thijssens, Ameen Abu-Hanna, Giovanni Cin\`a

entry.summary: Proposes a causal framework for evaluating ICU discharge strategies as an optimal stopping problem, addressing challenges of observational data, composite objectives, and variable recording that stops at intervention discontinuation.

entry.title: NERO-Net: A Neuroevolutionary Approach for the Design of Adversarially Robust CNNs

author.name: In\^es Valentim, Nuno Antunes, Nuno Louren\c{c}o

entry.summary: Proposes NERO-Net, a neuroevolutionary approach that searches for CNN architectures with intrinsic adversarial robustness without using adversarial training during the evolutionary loop. The fitness function promotes candidates that achieve balanced clean and adversarial accuracy even with standard training.

entry.title: Just Zoom In: Cross-View Geo-Localization via Autoregressive Zooming

author.name: Yunus Talha Erzurumlu, Jiyong Kwag, Alper Yilmaz

entry.summary: Proposes 'Just Zoom In,' a new formulation for cross-view geo-localization that performs autoregressive zooming over overhead imagery instead of contrastive image retrieval. Addresses coverage mismatch between street-view and satellite imagery.

entry.title: Drive My Way: Preference Alignment of Vision-Language-Action Model for Personalized Driving

author.name: Zehao Wang, Huaide Jiang, Shuaiwu Dong, Yuping Wang, Hang Qiu, Jiachen Li

entry.summary: Proposes Drive My Way (DMW), a personalized Vision-Language-Action driving framework that learns user embeddings from individual driving styles and adapts to real-time natural language instructions for personalized autonomous driving.

entry.title: Offline Decision Transformers for Neural Combinatorial Optimization: Surpassing Heuristics on the Traveling Salesman Problem

author.name: Hironori Ohigashi, Shinichiro Hamada

entry.summary: Applies Decision Transformer (offline RL) to the Traveling Salesman Problem, integrating Pointer Networks and expectile regression to learn from heuristic solution datasets and surpass the heuristics themselves.

entry.title: Causal-INSIGHT: Probing Temporal Models to Extract Causal Structure

author.name: Benjamin Redden, Hui Wang, Shuyan Li

entry.summary: Presents Causal-INSIGHT, a model-agnostic post-hoc framework for extracting directed, time-lagged causal influence structure from trained temporal prediction models via intervention-inspired input clamping at inference time.

entry.title: Practical Efficient Global Optimization is No-regret

author.name: Jingyi Wang, Haowei Wang, Nai-Yuan Chiang, Juliane Mueller, Tucker Hartland, Cosmin G. Petra

entry.summary: Establishes the first cumulative regret bounds for practical Efficient Global Optimization (EGO with nugget/jitter), showing it achieves no-regret guarantees despite the numerical stability modification.

entry.title: Exons-Detect: Identifying and Amplifying Exonic Tokens via Hidden-State Discrepancy for Robust AI-Generated Text Detection

author.name: Xiaowei Zhu, Yubing Ren, Fang Fang, Shi Wang, Yanan Cao, Li Guo

entry.summary: Proposes Exons-Detect, a training-free AI-generated text detection method that identifies and amplifies discriminative 'exonic' tokens based on hidden-state discrepancy between layers.

entry.title: PICon: A Multi-Turn Interrogation Framework for Evaluating Persona Agent Consistency

author.name: Minseo Kim, Sujeong Im, Junseong Choi, Junhee Lee, Chaeeun Shim, Edward Choi

entry.summary: Introduces PICon, an evaluation framework that probes LLM persona agents through logically chained multi-turn questioning to detect contradictions and factual inaccuracies, inspired by interrogation methodology.

entry.title: Probabilistic Concept Graph Reasoning for Multimodal Misinformation Detection

author.name: Ruichao Yang, Wei Gao, Xiaobin Zhu, Jing Ma, Hongzhan Lin, Ziyang Luo, Bo-Wen Zhang, Xu-Cheng Yin

entry.summary: Proposes PCGR, an interpretable framework for multimodal misinformation detection that constructs concept graphs with MLLM-discovered concepts and applies hierarchical attention for claim verification.

entry.title: ReDiPrune: Relevance-Diversity Pre-Projection Token Pruning for Efficient Multimodal LLMs

author.name: An Yu, Ting Yu Tsai, Zhenfei Zhang, Weiheng Lu, Felix X. -F. Ye, Ming-Ching Chang

entry.summary: Presents ReDiPrune, a training-free token pruning method for multimodal LLMs that selects tokens before the vision-language projector based on text-conditioned relevance and max-min diversity.

entry.title: TIGeR: A Unified Framework for Time, Images and Geo-location Retrieval

author.name: David G. Shatwell, Sirnam Swetha, Mubarak Shah

entry.summary: Proposes TIGeR, a multi-modal transformer mapping images, geolocations, and time into a unified embedding space, with a 4.5M triplet training set for geo-time aware image retrieval.

entry.title: Infinite Gaze Generation for Videos with Autoregressive Diffusion

author.name: Jenna Kang, Colin Groth, Tong Wu, Finley Torrens, Patsorn Sangkloy, Gordon Wetzstein, Qi Sun

entry.summary: Presents a generative framework for infinite-horizon raw gaze prediction in videos of arbitrary length using autoregressive diffusion, moving beyond traditional short-term saliency maps and scanpaths.

entry.title: GDPO-Listener: Expressive Interactive Head Generation via Auto-Regressive Flow Matching and Group reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization

author.name: Zhangyu Jin, Maksim Siniukov, Deuksin Kwon, Ashutosh Chaubey, Mohammad Soleymani

entry.summary: GDPO-Listener generates expressive listener head motions using auto-regressive flow matching and a novel group reward-decoupled policy optimization to overcome the regression-to-mean problem in listener motion generation.

entry.title: Label What Matters: Modality-Balanced and Difficulty-Aware Multimodal Active Learning

author.name: Yuqiao Zeng, Xu Wang, Tengfei Liang, Yiqing Hao, Yi Jin, Hui Yu

entry.summary: RL-MBA uses reinforcement learning for modality-balanced, difficulty-aware active learning in multimodal settings, dynamically adjusting which modalities to annotate as training progresses.

entry.title: Towards Practical Lossless Neural Compression for LiDAR Point Clouds

author.name: Pengpeng Yu, Haoran Li, Runqing Jiang, Dingquan Li, Jing Wang, Liang Lin, Yulan Guo

entry.summary: Proposes practical lossless neural compression for LiDAR point clouds with geometry re-densification and cross-scale feature propagation, addressing the efficiency challenges of compressing highly sparse data.

entry.title: CLIP-RD: Relational Distillation for Efficient CLIP Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Jeannie Chung, Hanna Jang, Ingyeong Yang, Uiwon Hwang, Jaehyung Sim

entry.summary: CLIP-RD introduces vertical and cross relational distillation methods for CLIP knowledge distillation, explicitly modeling multi-directional relational dependencies between teacher and student embeddings.

entry.title: Designing Any Imaging System from Natural Language: Agent-Constrained Composition over a Finite Primitive Basis

author.name: Chengshuai Yang

entry.summary: Presents spec.md and a three-agent system (Plan, Judge, Execute) that translates natural language descriptions into validated computational imaging forward models. Provides a design-to-real error theorem decomposing reconstruction error into five independently bounded terms.

entry.title: MegaFlow: Zero-Shot Large Displacement Optical Flow

author.name: Dingxi Zhang, Fangjinhua Wang, Marc Pollefeys, Haofei Xu

entry.summary: Introduces MegaFlow for zero-shot large displacement optical flow estimation, adapting pre-trained Vision Transformer features for global matching rather than iterative local search. Achieves strong performance without domain-specific fine-tuning.

entry.title: Discrete Causal Representation Learning

author.name: Wenjin Zhang, Yixin Wang, Yuqi Gu

entry.summary: Proposes Discrete Causal Representation Learning (DCRL), a generative framework for discovering causal relationships among discrete latent variables from mixed-type observations, with formal identifiability guarantees without linearity assumptions.

entry.title: A Black Box Made Less Opaque (part 3)

author.name: Matthew McDonnell

entry.summary: The third installment of an interpretability series comparing sparse autoencoders (SAEs) applied to GPT-2 Small and Gemma 2 9b. Key findings include that specialist features focus on syntax over semantics in both models, a two-tier structure (syntax specialists + semantic overall representation) persists across scales, and semantic representation becomes denser and emerges in later layers in the larger model.

entry.title: DAGverse: Building Document-Grounded Semantic DAGs from Scientific Papers

author.name: Shu Wan, Saketh Vishnubhatla, Iskander Kushbay, Tom Heffernan, Aaron Belikoff, Raha Moraffah, Huan Liu

entry.summary: DAGverse constructs document-grounded semantic DAGs from scientific papers, leveraging papers with explicit DAG figures as natural supervision sources. Addresses the scarcity of real-world DAG datasets for knowledge representation.

entry.title: Sovereign AI at the Front Door of Care: A Physically Unidirectional Architecture for Secure Clinical Intelligence

author.name: Vasu Srinivasan, Dhriti Vasu

entry.summary: Presents a sovereign AI architecture for clinical triage where all inference runs on-device with physically unidirectional data channels (hardware data diodes), eliminating network attack surfaces by construction.

entry.title: MuRF: Unlocking the Multi-Scale Potential of Vision Foundation Models

author.name: Bocheng Zou, Mu Cai, Mark Stanley, Dingfu Lu, Yong Jae Lee

entry.summary: Proposes MuRF (Multi-Resolution Fusion), a simple inference-time strategy for Vision Foundation Models that fuses predictions from multiple input resolutions. Low-resolution captures global semantics while high-resolution provides fine-grained details.

entry.title: Instance-optimal stochastic convex optimization: Can we improve upon sample-average and robust stochastic approximation?

author.name: Liwei Jiang, Ashwin Pananjady

entry.summary: Studies instance-optimal stochastic convex optimization, showing that standard methods (SAA, robust SA) can be arbitrarily suboptimal in finite samples. Proposes VISOR, a variance reduction strategy that significantly outperforms standard approaches.

entry.title: Conformal Prediction for Nonparametric Instrumental Regression

author.name: Masahiro Kato

entry.summary: Proposes distribution-free prediction intervals for nonparametric instrumental variable regression with finite-sample coverage guarantees, reformulating conditional coverage as marginal coverage over IV shifts.

entry.title: Fast-dVLA: Accelerating Discrete Diffusion VLA to Real-Time Performance

author.name: Wenxuan Song, Jiayi Chen, Shuai Chen, Jingbo Wang, Pengxiang Ding, Han Zhao, Yikai Qin, Xinhu Zheng, Donglin Wang, Yan Wang, Haoang Li

entry.summary: Proposes Fast-dVLA, which accelerates discrete diffusion VLA models for real-time robot control by decoupling auxiliary training objectives in parameter space, achieving enhanced capabilities with the simplicity of standard supervised fine-tuning.

entry.title: Supervising Ralph Wiggum: Exploring a Metacognitive Co-Regulation Agentic AI Loop for Engineering Design

author.name: Zeda Xu, Nikolas Martelaro, Christopher McComb

entry.summary: Proposes metacognitive co-regulation loops for LLM design agents, where a separate agent monitors and corrects design fixation in engineering tasks. Introduces Self-Regulation Loop and Co-Regulation Design Agentic Loop to mitigate common design pathologies.

entry.title: ElephantBroker: A Knowledge-Grounded Cognitive Runtime for Trustworthy AI Agents

author.name: Cristian Lupascu, Alexandru Lupascu

entry.summary: ElephantBroker is an open-source cognitive runtime for AI agents that unifies a knowledge graph with a vector store, implementing a complete cognitive loop with hybrid retrieval, competitive scoring, evidence tracking, and provenance verification.

entry.title: A Practical Guide Towards Interpreting Time-Series Deep Clinical Predictive Models: A Reproducibility Study

author.name: Yongda Fan, John Wu, Andrea Fitzpatrick, Naveen Baskaran, Jimeng Sun, Adam Cross

entry.summary: Presents a comprehensive benchmark evaluating interpretability methods across diverse clinical tasks and model architectures, examining whether attention improves explainability and whether interpretability generalizes across tasks.

entry.title: Shaping the Future of Mathematics in the Age of AI

author.name: Johan Commelin, Mateja Jamnik, Rodrigo Ochigame, Lenny Taelman, Akshay Venkatesh

entry.summary: Examines how AI is transforming mathematics across five areas: values, practice, teaching, technology, and ethics. Offers recommendations for the mathematical community to maintain intellectual autonomy.

entry.title: Large Language Models as Optimization Controllers: Adaptive Continuation for SIMP Topology Optimization

author.name: Shaoliang Yang, Jun Wang, Yunsheng Wang

entry.summary: Uses an LLM as an online adaptive controller for topology optimization, replacing fixed continuation schedules with real-time state-conditioned parameter decisions in SIMP optimization.

entry.title: A Wireless World Model for AI-Native 6G Networks

author.name: Ziqi Chen, Yi Ren, Yixuan Huang, Qi Sun, Nan Li, Yuhong Huang, Chih-Lin I, Yifan Li, Liang Xia

entry.summary: Introduces the Wireless World Model, a multi-modal foundation framework for predicting wireless channel evolution in 6G networks by internalizing the causal relationship between 3D geometry and signal dynamics.

entry.title: FEAST: Fully Connected Expressive Attention for Spatial Transcriptomics

author.name: Taejin Jeong, Joohyeok Kim, Jinyeong Kim, Chanyoung Kim, Seong Jae Hwang

entry.summary: Proposes FEAST, an attention-based framework for spatial transcriptomics that models all pairwise spot interactions without pre-defined sparse graphs, overcoming structural limitations of graph neural networks for gene expression inference.

entry.title: Once-for-All Channel Mixers (HYPERTINYPW): Generative Compression for TinyML

author.name: Yassien Shaalan

entry.summary: Presents HYPER-TINYPW, a compression approach replacing pointwise convolution weights with generated weights from a shared micro-MLP, targeting microcontroller deployment. Achieves significant memory savings while matching INT8 baseline performance.

entry.title: Social Hippocampus Memory Learning

author.name: Liping Yi, Zhiming Zhao, Qinghua Hu

entry.summary: Proposes SoHip, a memory-centric federated learning framework inspired by social learning and hippocampal memory, enabling heterogeneous model collaboration through shared memories rather than parameter/representation sharing.

entry.title: Amortized Inference for Correlated Discrete Choice Models via Equivariant Neural Networks

author.name: Easton Huch, Michael Keane

entry.summary: Proposes neural network emulators for approximating choice probabilities in discrete choice models with correlated errors, using specialized equivariant architectures. Enables use of general error distributions beyond the restrictive logit assumption.

entry.title: Fair regression under localized demographic parity constraints

author.name: Arthur Charpentier (UQAM), Christophe Denis (SAMM), Romuald Elie (LAMA), Mohamed Hebiri (LAMA), Fran\c{c}ois HU (UdeM)

entry.summary: Proposes a relaxation of demographic parity for regression by enforcing parity only at finite quantile levels and score thresholds. Derives closed-form optimal fair predictors via Lagrangian duality.

entry.title: OMIND: Framework for Knowledge Grounded Finetuning and Multi-Turn Dialogue Benchmark for Mental Health LLMs

author.name: Suraj Racha, Prashant Harish Joshi, Utkarsh Maurya, Nitin Yadav, Mridul Sharma, Ananya Kunisetty, Saranya Darisipudi, Nirmal Punjabi, Ganesh Ramakrishnan

entry.summary: Presents oMind, a framework for knowledge-grounded fine-tuning of mental health LLMs with a 164k multi-task SFT dataset and multi-turn dialogue benchmark for evaluating mental health conversations.

entry.title: When Hate Meets Facts: LLMs-in-the-Loop for Check-worthiness Detection in Hate Speech

author.name: Nicol\'as Benjam\'in Ocampo, Tommaso Caselli, Davide Ceolin

entry.summary: Releases WSF-ARG+, the first dataset combining hate speech with check-worthiness annotations, and introduces an LLM-in-the-loop framework for annotating check-worthy claims in hateful content.

entry.title: Confidence-Based Mesh Extraction from 3D Gaussians

author.name: Lukas Radl, Felix Windisch, Andreas Kurz, Thomas K\"ohler, Michael Steiner, Markus Steinberger

entry.summary: Introduces a self-supervised confidence framework for 3DGS that learns per-Gaussian confidence values to balance photometric and geometric supervision, improving mesh extraction in scenes with view-dependent effects.

entry.title: Interpretable Zero-shot Referring Expression Comprehension with Query-driven Scene Graphs

author.name: Yike Wu, Necva Bolucu, Stephen Wan, Dadong Wang, Jiahao Xia, Jian Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes query-driven scene graphs for interpretable zero-shot referring expression comprehension, combining VLMs and LLMs to capture fine-grained visual details and object relationships.

entry.title: CARE: Training-Free Controllable Restoration for Medical Images via Dual-Latent Steering

author.name: Xu Liu

entry.summary: CARE is a training-free controllable medical image restoration framework that balances structure preservation and prior-guided refinement using dual-latent steering during inference.

entry.title: A Semantically Disentangled Unified Model for Multi-category 3D Anomaly Detection

author.name: SuYeon Kim, Wongyu Lee, MyeongAh Cho

entry.summary: Proposes a semantically disentangled unified model for multi-category 3D anomaly detection that addresses inter-category entanglement in shared latent spaces through coarse-to-fine tokenization.

entry.title: ET-SAM: Efficient Point Prompt Prediction in SAM for Unified Scene Text Detection and Layout Analysis

author.name: Xike Zhang, Maoyuan Ye, Juhua Liu, Bo Du

entry.summary: ET-SAM builds an efficient SAM-based framework for unified scene text detection and layout analysis, using a lightweight point decoder for word heatmaps instead of pixel-level segmentation for point prompts.

entry.title: A Unified Spatial Alignment Framework for Highly Transferable Transformation-Based Attacks on Spatially Structured Tasks

author.name: Jiaming Liang, Chi-Man Pun

entry.summary: Proposes a unified spatial alignment framework for making transformation-based adversarial attacks work on spatially structured tasks like segmentation and detection, not just classification.

entry.title: InstanceAnimator: Multi-Instance Sketch Video Colorization

author.name: Yinhan Zhang, Yue Ma, Bingyuan Wang, Kunyu Feng, Yeying Jin, Qifeng Chen, Anyi Rao, Zeyu Wang

entry.summary: InstanceAnimator proposes a Diffusion Transformer framework for multi-instance sketch video colorization with canvas guidance, instance matching, and detail fidelity modules.

entry.title: Multimodal Dataset Distillation via Phased Teacher Models

author.name: Shengbin Guo, Hang Zhao, Senqiao Yang, Chenyang Jiang, Yuhang Cheng, Xiangru Peng, Rui Shao, Zhuotao Tian

entry.summary: PTM-ST proposes phased teacher model distillation with shortcut trajectories for multimodal dataset distillation, addressing the gap between early and late training stage knowledge.

entry.title: PAWS: Perception of Articulation in the Wild at Scale from Egocentric Videos

author.name: Yihao Wang, Yang Miao, Wenshuai Zhao, Wenyan Yang, Zihan Wang, Joni Pajarinen, Luc Van Gool, Danda Pani Paudel, Juho Kannala, Xi Wang, Arno Solin

entry.summary: Proposes PAWS, a method to extract articulated object motion and structure from large-scale egocentric videos of hand-object interactions, without requiring supervised 3D annotations. Shows improvements on benchmarks and benefits for downstream robotics tasks.

entry.title: ShotStream: Streaming Multi-Shot Video Generation for Interactive Storytelling

author.name: Yawen Luo, Xiaoyu Shi, Junhao Zhuang, Yutian Chen, Quande Liu, Xintao Wang, Pengfei Wan, Tianfan Xue

entry.summary: Proposes ShotStream, a causal multi-shot video architecture for interactive storytelling that enables streaming prompt-driven narrative generation. Uses distribution matching distillation to convert a bidirectional model into a causal streaming architecture.

entry.title: Towards Generalizable Robotic Data Flywheel: High-Dimensional Factorization and Composition

author.name: Yuyang Xiao, Yifei Zhou, Haoran Wang, Wenxuan Ou, Yuxiao Liu

entry.summary: Proposes F-ACIL, a factor-aware compositional iterative learning framework for robotic data collection that decomposes task diversity into factor spaces (object, action, environment) to enable structured data collection and compositional generalization.

entry.title: Identifiable Deep Latent Variable Models for MNAR Data

author.name: Huiming Xie, Fei Xue, Xiao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a deep latent variable framework for data imputation under missing-not-at-random (MNAR) conditions with formal nonparametric identifiability guarantees, bridging theoretical identifiability with deep learning methods.

entry.title: "What Exactly Would An International AI Treaty Say?" Is a Bad Objection

author.name: Davidmanheim

entry.summary: Argues that the objection 'we don't know what an AI treaty would say' is invalid, drawing parallels to pandemic and nuclear treaties where shared goals drove negotiations despite initially unclear technical details. Emphasizes verification feasibility.

entry.title: Design Once, Deploy at Scale: Template-Driven ML Development for Large Model Ecosystems

author.name: Jiang Liu, John Martabano Landy, Yao Xuan, Swamy Muddu, Nhat Le, Munaf Sahaf, Luc Kien Hang, Rupinder Khandpour, Kevin De Angeli, Chang Yang, Shouyuan Chen, Shiblee Sadik, Ani Agrawal, Djordje Gligorijevic, Jingzheng Qin, Peggy Yao, Alireza Vahdatpour

entry.summary: Presents a template-driven approach to ML model development for large advertising model ecosystems, comparing performance and efficiency between template-based and individually-developed models at scale.
