Challenges the assumption that penultimate-layer activations are most informative, showing intermediate layers encode equally rich discriminative information.

entry.title: Semantic Iterative Reconstruction: One-Shot Universal Anomaly Detection

author.name: Ning Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes SIR (Semantic Iterative Reconstruction), a one-shot universal anomaly detection framework for medical imaging that uses a pretrained teacher encoder and iterative refinement to detect anomalies across diverse medical domains with extremely few normal samples.

entry.title: BioVITA: Biological Dataset, Model, and Benchmark for Visual-Textual-Acoustic Alignment

author.name: Risa Shinoda, Kaede Shiohara, Nakamasa Inoue, Kuniaki Saito, Hiroaki Santo, Fumio Okura

entry.summary: Introduces BioVITA, a visual-textual-acoustic alignment framework for biological species identification, with a 1.3M audio clip and 2.3M image dataset covering 14,133 species, extending BioCLIP-style models to include audio modality.

entry.title: VOLMO: Versatile and Open Large Models for Ophthalmology

author.name: Zhenyue Qin, Younjoon Chung, Elijah Lee, Wanyue Feng, Xuguang Ai, Serina Applebaum, Minjie Zou, Yang Liu, Pan Xiao, Mac Singer, Amisha Dave, Aidan Gilson, Tiarnan D. L. Keenan, Emily Y. Chew, Zhiyong Lu, Yih-Chung Tham, Ron Adelman, Luciano V. Del Priore, Qingyu Chen

entry.summary: Introduces VOLMO, a model-agnostic, data-open framework for developing ophthalmology-specific multimodal LLMs, with three-stage training on 86,965+ image-text pairs and multiple clinical data types for eye disease diagnosis.

entry.title: SpectralSplats: Robust Differentiable Tracking via Spectral Moment Supervision

author.name: Avigail Cohen Rimon, Amir Mann, Mirela Ben Chen, Or Litany

entry.summary: Introduces SpectralSplats, a robust 3DGS tracking framework that shifts optimization from spatial to frequency domain to resolve vanishing gradient problems when camera misalignment is severe.

entry.title: Unlocking Few-Shot Capabilities in LVLMs via Prompt Conditioning and Head Selection

author.name: Adhemar de Senneville, Xavier Bou, J\'er\'emy Anger, Rafael Grompone, Gabriele Facciolo

entry.summary: Shows that LVLMs can improve visual classification via prompt conditioning and internal head selection at inference time, despite appearing to underperform CLIP on standard classification tasks.

entry.title: Video-Only ToM: Enhancing Theory of Mind in Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Siqi Liu, Xinyang Li, Bochao Zou, Junbao Zhuo, Huimin Ma, Jiansheng Chen

entry.summary: Introduces VisionToM, a video-only Theory of Mind benchmark for multimodal LLMs, probing how models infer human mental states from visual information alone and analyzing internal attention patterns and hallucination effects.

entry.title: Latent-WAM: Latent World Action Modeling for End-to-End Autonomous Driving

author.name: Linbo Wang, Yupeng Zheng, Qiang Chen, Shiwei Li, Yichen Zhang, Zebin Xing, Qichao Zhang, Xiang Li, Deheng Qian, Pengxuan Yang, Yihang Dong, Ce Hao, Xiaoqing Ye, Junyu han, Yifeng Pan, Dongbin Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces Latent-WAM, an end-to-end autonomous driving framework with spatially-aware compressed world representations and dynamic latent world modeling using causal transformers for trajectory planning.

entry.title: AgentChemist: A Multi-Agent Experimental Robotic Platform Integrating Chemical Perception and Precise Control

author.name: Xiangyi Wei, Fei Wang, Haotian Zhang, Xin An, Haitian Zhu, Lianrui Hu, Yang Li, Changbo Wang, Xiao He

entry.summary: Presents a multi-agent robotic platform for chemistry lab automation that handles diverse experimental tasks through collaborative task decomposition, dynamic scheduling, and adaptive control with chemical perception.

entry.title: QuadFM: Foundational Text-Driven Quadruped Motion Dataset for Generation and Control

author.name: Li Gao, Fuzhi Yang, Jianhui Chen, Liu Liu, Yao Zheng, Yang Cai, Ziqiao Li

entry.summary: Introduces QuadFM, the first large-scale quadruped motion dataset with 11,784 clips spanning locomotion, interactive, and emotion-expressive behaviors with rich language annotations for text-to-motion generation.

entry.title: Learning-guided Prioritized Planning for Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding in Warehouse Automation

author.name: Han Zheng, Yining Ma, Brandon Araki, Jingkai Chen, Cathy Wu

entry.summary: Introduces RL-RH-PP, integrating reinforcement learning with prioritized planning for lifelong multi-agent path finding in warehouse automation, claiming to be the first framework combining RL with search-based planning for this problem.

entry.title: Can Large Language Models Reason and Optimize Under Constraints?

author.name: Fabien Bernier, Salah Ghamizi, Pantelis Dogoulis, Maxime Cordy

entry.summary: Evaluates whether LLMs can reason and optimize under physical constraints using the Optimal Power Flow problem. Finds that even SOTA reasoning LLMs fail in the most complex constrained optimization settings.

entry.title: Reasoning over Semantic IDs Enhances Generative Recommendation

author.name: Yingzhi He, Yan Sun, Junfei Tan, Yuxin Chen, Xiaoyu Kong, Chunxu Shen, Xiang Wang, An Zhang, Tat-Seng Chua

entry.summary: Explores reasoning-enhanced generative recommendation over Semantic IDs, showing that reasoning capabilities in LLMs can improve sequential recommendation when properly adapted to work with discrete item tokens.

entry.title: Project and Generate: Divergence-Free Neural Operators for Incompressible Flows

author.name: Xigui Li, Hongwei Zhang, Ruoxi Jiang, Deshu Chen, Chensen Lin, Limei Han, Yuan Qi, Xin Guo, Yuan Cheng

entry.summary: Introduces a framework enforcing the incompressibility constraint as a hard constraint for neural operators via differentiable spectral Leray projection, ensuring divergence-free velocity fields for both deterministic and generative fluid models.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Vision-based Risk Object Identification via Conformal Risk Tube Prediction

author.name: Kai-Yu Fu, Yi-Ting Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Conformal Risk Tube Prediction for vision-based risk object identification in driving, capturing spatiotemporal risk uncertainty with statistical coverage guarantees rather than deterministic thresholds.

entry.title: SLAT-Phys: Fast Material Property Field Prediction from Structured 3D Latents

author.name: Rocktim Jyoti Das, Dinesh Manocha

entry.summary: Presents SLAT-Phys, which predicts spatially varying material properties (Young's modulus, density, Poisson's ratio) of 3D assets from a single RGB image by leveraging latent features from a pretrained 3D generation model.

entry.title: LightSplat: Fast and Memory-Efficient Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding in Five Seconds

author.name: Jaehun Bang, Jinhyeok Kim, Minji Kim, Seungheon Jeong, Kyungdon Joo

entry.summary: Proposes LightSplat, a training-free framework for open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding that injects compact 2-byte semantic indices into 3D Gaussian representations, achieving fast (5-second) processing with low memory.

entry.title: Anti-I2V: Safeguarding your photos from malicious image-to-video generation

author.name: Duc Vu, Anh Nguyen, Chi Tran, Anh Tran

entry.summary: Proposes Anti-I2V, adversarial perturbation methods to protect images from malicious image-to-video diffusion generation, specifically addressing Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architectures which are underexplored in this context.

entry.title: PERMA: Benchmarking Personalized Memory Agents via Event-Driven Preference and Realistic Task Environments

author.name: Shuochen Liu, Junyi Zhu, Long Shu, Junda Lin, Yuhao Chen, Haotian Zhang, Chao Zhang, Derong Xu, Jia Li, Bo Tang, Zhiyu Li, Feiyu Xiong, Enhong Chen, Tong Xu

entry.summary: Introduces PERMA benchmark for evaluating personalized memory agents, focusing on how preferences emerge gradually across interactions rather than static recall. Incorporates text variability and linguistic alignment testing.

entry.title: DISCO: Document Intelligence Suite for COmparative Evaluation

author.name: Kenza Benkirane, Dan Goldwater, Martin Asenov, Aneiss Ghodsi

entry.summary: DISCO is a document intelligence evaluation suite that separately benchmarks OCR pipelines and vision-language models on parsing and QA across diverse document types, finding that OCR is more reliable for handwriting and long documents.

entry.title: Benchmarking Multi-Agent LLM Architectures for Financial Document Processing: A Comparative Study of Orchestration Patterns, Cost-Accuracy Tradeoffs and Production Scaling Strategies

author.name: Siddhant Kulkarni, Yukta Kulkarni

entry.summary: Benchmarks four multi-agent orchestration architectures for financial document processing across five LLMs on 10,000 SEC filings, evaluating 25 extraction field types along five axes including cost-accuracy tradeoffs.

entry.title: Dynamical Systems Theory Behind a Hierarchical Reasoning Model

author.name: Vasiliy A. Es'kin, Mikhail E. Smorkalov

entry.summary: Proposes Contraction Mapping Model (CMM) reformulating discrete recursive reasoning into continuous Neural ODEs/SDEs with mathematical guarantees against instability and representational collapse. Addresses training dynamics issues in hierarchical reasoning models.

entry.title: SAiW: Source-Attributable Invisible Watermarking for Proactive Deepfake Defense

author.name: Bibek Das, Chandranath Adak, Soumi Chattopadhyay, Zahid Akhtar, Soumya Dutta

entry.summary: Introduces SAiW, a source-attributed invisible watermarking framework for proactive deepfake defense that embeds source-conditioned watermarks during creation rather than reactively detecting manipulations after the fact.

entry.title: Beyond Hard Constraints: Budget-Conditioned Reachability For Safe Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Janaka Chathuranga Brahmanage, Akshat Kumar

entry.summary: Proposes budget-conditioned safety reachability analysis for offline RL, extending reachability methods beyond hard constraints to handle cumulative cost budgets. Computes forward-invariant safe state-action sets conditioned on remaining safety budgets.

entry.title: Sparsely-Supervised Data Assimilation via Physics-Informed Schr\"odinger Bridge

author.name: Dohyun Bu, Chanho Kim, Seokun Choi, Jong-Seok Lee

entry.summary: Proposes physics-informed Schrödinger bridge for data assimilation, reconstructing full spatiotemporal fields from sparse observations without full-field supervision. Addresses the computational bottleneck of per-instance optimization.

entry.title: AEGIS: An Operational Infrastructure for Post-Market Governance of Adaptive Medical AI Under US and EU Regulations

author.name: Fardin Afdideh, Mehdi Astaraki, Fernando Seoane, Farhad Abtahi

entry.summary: Presents AEGIS, a governance framework for adaptive medical AI implementing FDA PCCP and EU AI Act provisions with three modules: dataset retraining, model monitoring, and conditional decision-making with four-category deployment states.

entry.title: Trained Persistent Memory for Frozen Decoder-Only LLMs

author.name: Hong Jeong

entry.summary: Explores whether persistent memory adapters can work for frozen decoder-only LLMs (GPT-2), adapting six memory injection methods from encoder-decoder settings where no cross-attention pathway exists. Tests prefix, parallel cross-attention, KV extension, Hebbian memory, context-gated branch, and slot-based sparse write approaches.

entry.title: Symbolic Graph Networks for Robust PDE Discovery from Noisy Sparse Data

author.name: Xingyu Chen, Junxiu An, Jun Guo, Yuqian Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Symbolic Graph Networks for PDE discovery from noisy, sparse data, using graph message passing for non-local spatial interaction modeling that is more robust to noise than local differential approximations.

entry.title: Generalizing Dynamics Modeling More Easily from Representation Perspective

author.name: Yiming Wang, Zhengnan Zhang, Genghe Zhang, Jiawen Dan, Changchun Li, Chenlong Hu, Chris Nugent, Jun Liu, Ximing Li, Bo Yang

entry.summary: Proposes PDEDER, a pre-trained dynamics encoder that can generalize across different complex systems by embedding state observations into a latent space, inspired by pre-trained foundation models.

entry.title: DBAutoDoc: Automated Discovery and Documentation of Undocumented Database Schemas via Statistical Analysis and Iterative LLM Refinement

author.name: Amith Nagarajan, Thomas Altman

entry.summary: Presents DBAutoDoc, a system that automates discovery and documentation of undocumented database schemas by combining statistical analysis with iterative LLM refinement, propagating semantic corrections through dependency graphs.

entry.title: General Machine Learning: Theory for Learning Under Variable Regimes

author.name: Aomar Osmani

entry.summary: Develops a foundational learning-theoretic framework for regime-varying settings where the learner, memory state, and evaluation conditions evolve over time. Introduces concepts of admissible transport and protected-core preservation.

entry.title: Neural ODE and SDE Models for Adaptation and Planning in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Chao Han, Stefanos Ioannou, Luca Manneschi, T. J. Hayward, Michael Mangan, Aditya Gilra, Eleni Vasilaki

entry.summary: Investigates neural ODEs and SDEs for model-based RL, showing neural SDEs better capture stochastic dynamics. Introduces latent SDE model for partial observability and demonstrates efficient policy adaptation via inverse models.

entry.title: InverFill: One-Step Inversion for Enhanced Few-Step Diffusion Inpainting

author.name: Duc Vu, Kien Nguyen, Trong-Tung Nguyen, Ngan Nguyen, Phong Nguyen, Khoi Nguyen, Cuong Pham, Anh Tran

entry.summary: Proposes InverFill, a one-step inversion method for few-step diffusion inpainting that injects semantic information from the masked image into initial noise, enabling high-fidelity inpainting with very few denoising steps.

entry.title: BXRL: Behavior-Explainable Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ram Rachum, Yotam Amitai, Yonatan Nakar, Reuth Mirsky, Cameron Allen

entry.summary: Introduces BXRL (Behavior-Explainable RL), which formalizes 'behavior' as a pattern of actions across episodes as a first-class object in explainable RL. Enables a new query type: explaining why a behavior emerges.

entry.title: Why the Maximum Second Derivative of Activations Matters for Adversarial Robustness

author.name: Yunrui Yu, Hang Su, Jun Zhu

entry.summary: Investigates the role of activation function curvature (max second derivative) in adversarial robustness, revealing a non-monotonic sweet spot around 4-10 that balances expressivity and loss landscape smoothness.

entry.title: Diet Your LLM: Dimension-wise Global Pruning of LLMs via Merging Task-specific Importance Score

author.name: Jimyung Hong, Jaehyung Kim

entry.summary: Proposes DIET, a training-free structured pruning method for LLMs that profiles activation magnitudes across tasks and uses majority voting to merge task-wise importance scores for dimension-level global pruning.

entry.title: Energy Efficient Software Hardware CoDesign for Machine Learning: From TinyML to Large Language Models

author.name: Mohammad Saleh Vahdatpour, Yanqing Zhang

entry.summary: A survey reviewing energy-efficient software-hardware co-design methods spanning TinyML to LLM serving, covering accelerator architectures, quantization, scheduling, and runtime adaptation across the full scale spectrum.

entry.title: Estimating Individual Tree Height and Species from UAV Imagery

author.name: Jannik Endres, Etienne Lalibert\'e, David Rolnick, Arthur Ouaknine

entry.summary: Introduces BIRCH-Trees, the first benchmark for individual tree height and species estimation from UAV images, along with DINOvTree, a vision foundation model approach for simultaneous height and species prediction across temperate, tropical, and boreal forests.

entry.title: Dialogue to Question Generation for Evidence-based Medical Guideline Agent Development

author.name: Zongliang Ji, Ziyang Zhang, Xincheng Tan, Matthew Thompson, Anna Goldenberg, Carl Yang, Rahul G. Krishnan, Fan Zhang

entry.summary: Investigates using LLMs as ambient clinical assistants that generate evidence-based questions during physician-patient encounters, focusing on scaffolding physician reasoning rather than answering questions.

entry.title: ChargeFlow: Flow-Matching Refinement of Charge-Conditioned Electron Densities

author.name: Tri Minh Nguyen, Sherif Abdulkader Tawfik, Truyen Tran, Svetha Venkatesh

entry.summary: ChargeFlow uses flow-matching to refine charge-conditioned electron densities from atomic superpositions to DFT-quality predictions, enabling efficient charge-state-dependent density calculations for materials screening.

entry.title: Quantum Neural Physics: Solving Partial Differential Equations on Quantum Simulators using Quantum Convolutional Neural Networks

author.name: Jucai Zhai, Muhammad Abdullah, Boyang Chen, Fazal Chaudry, Paul N. Smith, Claire E. Heaney, Yanghua Wang, Jiansheng Xiang, Christopher C. Pain

entry.summary: Proposes Quantum Neural Physics, mapping analytically-determined PDE discretization stencils into parameter-free quantum convolutional layers to create a hybrid quantum-classical CNN multigrid solver for PDEs.

entry.title: UniScale: Synergistic Entire Space Data and Model Scaling for Search Ranking

author.name: Liren Yu, Caiyuan Li, Feiyi Dong, Tao Zhang, Zhixuan Zhang, Dan Ou, Haihong Tang, Bo Zheng

entry.summary: UniScale proposes a co-design framework jointly optimizing data and model architecture for search ranking, addressing diminishing returns from parameter scaling alone in industrial recommendation systems.

entry.title: S-Path-RAG: Semantic-Aware Shortest-Path Retrieval Augmented Generation for Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph Question Answering

author.name: Rong Fu, Yemin Wang, Tianxiang Xu, Yongtai Liu, Weizhi Tang, Wangyu Wu, Xiaowen Ma, Simon Fong

entry.summary: S-Path-RAG introduces a semantic-aware shortest-path RAG framework for multi-hop question answering over knowledge graphs. It uses hybrid weighted k-shortest, beam, and constrained random-walk strategies with a differentiable path scorer and cross-attention injection into language models. The iterative Neural-Socratic Graph Dialogue loop adds a novel interactive reasoning component.

entry.title: CoCR-RAG: Enhancing Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Web Q&A via Concept-oriented Context Reconstruction

author.name: Kaize Shi, Xueyao Sun, Qika Lin, Firoj Alam, Qing Li, Xiaohui Tao, Guandong Xu

entry.summary: CoCR-RAG addresses multi-source information fusion in RAG by using concept-oriented context reconstruction. It tackles the challenge of fusing heterogeneous web documents with diverse styles, formats, and granularity into coherent, knowledge-intensive context.

entry.title: FinToolSyn: A forward synthesis Framework for Financial Tool-Use Dialogue Data with Dynamic Tool Retrieval

author.name: Caishuang Huang, Yang Qiao, Rongyu Zhang, Junjie Ye, Pu Lu, Wenxi Wu, Meng Zhou, Xiku Du, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang

entry.summary: FinToolSyn is a forward synthesis framework for generating financial tool-use dialogue data, progressing from persona to naturally implicit queries rather than reverse-engineering from pre-sampled tools. Includes dynamic retrieval to navigate massive tool spaces for financial LLMs.

entry.title: Optimizing Multilingual LLMs via Federated Learning: A Study of Client Language Composition

author.name: Aleix Sant, Jordi Luque, Carlos Escolano

entry.summary: Extends FederatedScope-LLM for multilingual instruction tuning and introduces Local Dynamic Early Stopping (LDES-FL) for federated learning of multilingual LLMs. Studies how client language composition affects performance from monolingual to multilingual settings.

entry.title: Towards Reward Modeling for AI Tutors in Math Mistake Remediation

author.name: Kseniia Petukhova, Ekaterina Kochmar

entry.summary: Develops Bradley-Terry preference models for evaluating AI math tutors on mistake remediation, deriving a hierarchy of pedagogical aspects from human preferences. Best model reaches 0.69 pairwise accuracy using only synthetic data, addressing the challenge of evaluating scaffolding quality.

entry.title: SpinGQE: A Generative Quantum Eigensolver for Spin Hamiltonians

author.name: Alexander Holden, Moinul Hossain Rahat, Nii Osae Osae Dade

entry.summary: SpinGQE extends the Generative Quantum Eigensolver framework to spin Hamiltonians using a transformer-based decoder to learn distributions over quantum circuits for ground state search. Reframes circuit design as a generative modeling task.

entry.title: MoCHA: Denoising Caption Supervision for Motion-Text Retrieval

author.name: Nikolai Warner, Cameron Ethan Taylor, Irfan Essa, Apaar Sadhwani

entry.summary: MoCHA proposes text canonicalization to reduce within-motion embedding variance caused by annotator-specific style in motion-caption pairs. Addresses the distributional nature of captions where different annotators produce different valid descriptions for the same motion.

entry.title: MLE-UVAD: Minimal Latent Entropy Autoencoder for Fully Unsupervised Video Anomaly Detection

author.name: Yuang Geng, Junkai Zhou, Kang Yang, Pan He, Zhuoyang Zhou, Jose C. Principe, Joel Harley, Ivan Ruchkin

entry.summary: Proposes MLE-UVAD, an entropy-guided autoencoder for fully unsupervised video anomaly detection that uses a novel Minimal Latent Entropy loss to separate normal from anomalous events without any labels.

entry.title: UW-VOS: A Large-Scale Dataset for Underwater Video Object Segmentation

author.name: Hongshen Zhao, Jingkang Tai, Yuhang Wu, Wenkang Zhang, Xi Lan, Shangyan Wang, Tianyu Zhang, Wankou Yang

entry.summary: Introduces UW-VOS, the first large-scale underwater video object segmentation benchmark with 1,431 sequences across 409 categories and 309K mask annotations, plus SAM-U, a parameter-efficient SAM2 adaptation for underwater scenes.

entry.title: Memory-Augmented Vision-Language Agents for Persistent and Semantically Consistent Object Captioning

author.name: Tommaso Galliena, Stefano Rosa, Tommaso Apicella, Pietro Morerio, Alessio Del Bue, Lorenzo Natale

entry.summary: Introduces a unified, memory-augmented vision-language agent for persistent and consistent object captioning across viewpoints, handling data association, captioning, and exploration in a single autoregressive framework.

entry.title: Accelerating Diffusion-based Video Editing via Heterogeneous Caching: Beyond Full Computing at Sampled Denoising Timestep

author.name: Tianyi Liu, Ye Lu, Linfeng Zhang, Chen Cai, Jianjun Gao, Yi Wang, Kim-Hui Yap, Lap-Pui Chau

entry.summary: Introduces HetCache for accelerating diffusion-based video editing by exploiting both timestep-level and architecture-level redundancy in Diffusion Transformers, caching attention computations heterogeneously.

entry.title: Cross-Modal Prototype Alignment and Mixing for Training-Free Few-Shot Classification

author.name: Dipam Goswami, Simone Magistri, Gido M. van de Ven, Bart{\l}omiej Twardowski, Andrew D. Bagdanov, Tinne Tuytelaars, Joost van de Weijer

entry.summary: Analyzes mixing image and text prototypes for CLIP-based few-shot classification from a bias-variance perspective, showing mixed prototypes act as shrinkage estimators and proposing cross-modal prototype alignment to reduce noise.

entry.title: VFIG: Vectorizing Complex Figures in SVG with Vision-Language Models

author.name: Qijia He, Xunmei Liu, Hammaad Memon, Ziang Li, Zixian Ma, Jaemin Cho, Jason Ren, Daniel S Weld, Ranjay Krishna

entry.summary: Proposes VFIG, vision-language models trained for complex figure-to-SVG vectorization, with a new large-scale synthetic dataset. Addresses the practical problem of converting rasterized figures back to editable vector format.

entry.title: Modeling Spatiotemporal Neural Frames for High Resolution Brain Dynamic

author.name: Wanying Qu, Jianxiong Gao, Wei Wang, Yanwei Fu

entry.summary: Presents an EEG-conditioned framework for reconstructing dynamic fMRI sequences with high spatial fidelity and temporal coherence, leveraging the complementary temporal resolution of EEG and spatial resolution of fMRI.

entry.title: Detection of local geometry in random graphs: information-theoretic and computational limits

author.name: Jinho Bok, Shuangping Li, Sophie H. Yu

entry.summary: Studies detecting local geometric structure in random graphs, introducing a model where a hidden community has geometric graph edges while remaining edges are Erdős-Rényi, and characterizing information-theoretic and computational detection limits.

entry.title: Galaxy-brained model-chat: ASI constitutions & the cosmic host
entry.summary: Exploratory study testing whether frontier LLMs can be steered toward Bostrom's 'cosmic host' values via constitutional prompting. Finds Gemini is uniquely steerable among closed models, and this steerability responds to decision-theoretic structure rather than cosmic content. Anthropic and OpenAI models resist steering, defaulting to provider-specific attractor behaviors.

entry.title: Continuous Optimization for Satisfiability Modulo Theories on Linear Real Arithmetic

author.name: Yunuo Cen, Daniel Ebler, Xuanyao Fong

entry.summary: Introduces FourierSMT, a parallelizable continuous optimization framework for SMT solving using an extended Walsh-Fourier expansion generalized to mixed Boolean-real domains. Enables gradient-based methods for satisfiability problems.

entry.title: Beyond Preset Identities: How Agents Form Stances and Boundaries in Generative Societies

author.name: Hanzhong Zhang, Siyang Song, Jindong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a novel mixed-methods framework combining virtual ethnography with quantitative profiling to study how LLM agents form stances and boundaries in generative multi-agent societies. Introduces metrics for value bias, persuasion sensitivity, and trust-action decoupling.

entry.title: From Arithmetic to Logic: The Resilience of Logic and Lookup-Based Neural Networks Under Parameter Bit-Flips

author.name: Alan T. L. Bacellar, Sathvik Chemudupati, Shashank Nag, Allison Seigler, Priscila M. V. Lima, Felipe M. G. Fran\c{c}a, Lizy K. John

entry.summary: Derives theoretical expected MSE under parameter bit-flips across numerical formats and layer primitives, showing lower precision, higher sparsity, bounded activations, and shallow depth improve fault tolerance. Validates on logic/lookup-based networks.

entry.title: Parametric Knowledge and Retrieval Behavior in RAG Fine-Tuning for Electronic Design Automation

author.name: Julian Oestreich, Maximilian Bley, Frank Binder, Lydia M\"uller, Maksym Sydorenko, Andr\'e Alcalde

entry.summary: Evaluates RAG fine-tuning for long-form text generation in electronic design automation, introducing TriFEX evaluation pipeline and Parametric Knowledge Precision metric. Shows ROUGE and BERTScore fail to capture factual differences.

entry.title: Symbolic--KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Discrete Symbolic Structure for Interpretable Learning

author.name: Salah A Faroughi, Farinaz Mostajeran, Amirhossein Arzani, Shirko Faroughi

entry.summary: Introduces Symbolic-KAN, which embeds discrete symbolic structure into Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks to bridge the gap between interpretable symbolic regression and scalable neural networks for scientific equation discovery.

entry.title: Lagrangian Relaxation Score-based Generation for Mixed Integer linear Programming

author.name: Ruobing Wang, Xin Li, Yujie Fang, Mingzhong Wang

entry.summary: Introduces SRG, a generative framework for MILP solving using Lagrangian relaxation-guided SDEs that capture inter-variable dependencies and guide sampling toward feasible near-optimal regions.

entry.title: High-Fidelity Face Content Recovery via Tamper-Resilient Versatile Watermarking

author.name: Peipeng Yu, Jinfeng Xie, Chengfu Ou, Xiaoyu Zhou, Jianwei Fei, Yunshu Dai, Zhihua Xia, Chip Hong Chang

entry.summary: Presents VeriFi, a versatile watermarking framework for face images that unifies copyright protection, pixel-level manipulation localization, and high-fidelity face content recovery against AIGC-driven deepfakes.

entry.title: LaDy: Lagrangian-Dynamic Informed Network for Skeleton-based Action Segmentation via Spatial-Temporal Modulation

author.name: Haoyu Ji, Xueting Liu, Yu Gao, Wenze Huang, Zhihao Yang, Weihong Ren, Zhiyong Wang, Honghai Liu

entry.summary: Proposes LaDy, a Lagrangian dynamics-informed network for skeleton-based temporal action segmentation that incorporates physical dynamics (forces, energies) beyond pure kinematics.

entry.title: Boosting Document Parsing Efficiency and Performance with Coarse-to-Fine Visual Processing

author.name: Cheng Cui, Ting Sun, Suyin Liang, Tingquan Gao, Zelun Zhang, Jiaxuan Liu, Xueqing Wang, Changda Zhou, Hongen Liu, Manhui Lin, Yue Zhang, Yubo Zhang, Jing Zhang, Jun Zhang, Xing Wei, Yi Liu, Dianhai Yu, Yanjun Ma

entry.summary: Proposes PaddleOCR-VL, a coarse-to-fine architecture for document parsing that focuses on semantically relevant regions while suppressing redundant ones (backgrounds), improving both efficiency and performance.

entry.title: Unleashing Vision-Language Semantics for Deepfake Video Detection

author.name: Jiawen Zhu, Yunqi Miao, Xueyi Zhang, Jiankang Deng, Guansong Pang

entry.summary: Proposes VLAForge, a deepfake video detection framework that leverages vision-language semantics from CLIP, including a ForgePerceiver module for capturing subtle forgery cues and cross-modal semantic alignment for improved detection.

entry.title: Environment-Grounded Multi-Agent Workflow for Autonomous Penetration Testing

author.name: Michael Somma, Markus Gro{\ss}pointner, Paul Zabalegui, Eppu Heilimo, Branka Stojanovi\'c

entry.summary: Proposes an environment-grounded multi-agent architecture using LLMs for automated penetration testing of robotic systems, with graph-based memory capturing network topology and system state.

entry.title: A Sensorless, Inherently Compliant Anthropomorphic Musculoskeletal Hand Driven by Electrohydraulic Actuators

author.name: Misato Sonoda, Ronan Hinchet, Amirhossein Kazemipour, Yasunori Toshimitsu, Robert K. Katzschmann

entry.summary: Presents a sensorless musculoskeletal robotic hand powered by remote Peano-HASEL electrohydraulic actuators, featuring anthropomorphic design with inherent compliance for safe manipulation without external sensors.

entry.title: Grounding Vision and Language to 3D Masks for Long-Horizon Box Rearrangement

author.name: Ashish Malik, Caleb Lowe, Aayam Shrestha, Stefan Lee, Fuxin Li, Alan Fern

entry.summary: Proposes RAMP-3D, a reactive action mask planner for long-horizon 3D box rearrangement that extends 3D grounding models to plan from under-specified natural language goals using visual observations.

entry.title: Circuit Complexity of Hierarchical Knowledge Tracing and Implications for Log-Precision Transformers

author.name: Naiming Liu, Richard Baraniuk, Shashank Sonkar

entry.summary: Analyzes hierarchical knowledge tracing through circuit complexity theory, showing that prerequisite propagation in concept hierarchies lies in NC^1 and establishing barriers for log-precision transformers under monotonicity restrictions.

entry.title: Towards Real-World Document Parsing via Realistic Scene Synthesis and Document-Aware Training

author.name: Gengluo Li, Chengquan Zhang, Yupu Liang, Huawen Shen, Yaping Zhang, Pengyuan Lyu, Weinong Wang, Xingyu Wan, Gangyan Zeng, Han Hu, Can Ma, Yu Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes a data-training co-design framework for robust end-to-end document parsing using MLLMs, with a realistic scene synthesis strategy and document-aware training to handle casually captured documents.

entry.title: SilLang: Improving Gait Recognition with Silhouette Language Encoding

author.name: Ruiyi Zhan, Guozhen Peng, Canyu Chen, Jian Lei, Annan Li

entry.summary: Explores using Large Language Models for gait recognition by encoding binary gait silhouettes as discrete sequences, bridging the discrete nature of silhouettes with LLM token processing capabilities.

entry.title: VERIA: Verification-Centric Multimodal Instance Augmentation for Long-Tailed 3D Object Detection

author.name: Jumin Lee, Siyeong Lee, Namil Kim, Sung-Eui Yoon

entry.summary: Proposes VERIA for long-tail 3D object detection in driving, using image-first multimodal augmentation with foundation models and sequential semantic/geometric verification to synthesize diverse rare-class instances.

entry.title: MIRROR: Visual Motion Imitation via Real-time Retargeting and Teleoperation with Parallel Differential Inverse Kinematics

author.name: Junheng Li, Lizhi Yang, Aaron D. Ames

entry.summary: Proposes MIRROR, a GPU-parallelized continuation-based differential IK system for real-time humanoid teleoperation that escapes constraint-induced local minima while preserving real-time performance and safety.

entry.title: LATS: Large Language Model Assisted Teacher-Student Framework for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning in Traffic Signal Control

author.name: Yifeng Zhang, Peizhuo Li, Tingguang Zhou, Mingfeng Fan, Guillaume Sartoretti

entry.summary: Proposes LATS, integrating LLMs with multi-agent RL for adaptive traffic signal control, where LLMs provide semantic reasoning as a teacher to guide MARL student policies without direct LLM inference at deployment.

entry.title: The Efficiency Attenuation Phenomenon: A Computational Challenge to the Language of Thought Hypothesis

author.name: Di Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces the 'Efficiency Attenuation Phenomenon' showing AI agents with emergent communication protocols achieve 50.5% higher efficiency than those using human-like symbolic protocols, challenging the Language of Thought hypothesis. Uses multi-agent reinforcement learning in cooperative navigation tasks.

entry.title: MuQ-Eval: An Open-Source Per-Sample Quality Metric for AI Music Generation Evaluation

author.name: Di Zhu, Zixuan Li

entry.summary: Introduces MUQ-EVAL, an open-source per-sample quality metric for AI-generated music, achieving system-level SRCC=0.957 with human judgments. Built on frozen MuQ-310M features with lightweight prediction heads, addressing the lack of open per-sample evaluation tools.

entry.title: CoMaTrack: Competitive Multi-Agent Game-Theoretic Tracking with Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Youzhi Liu, Li Gao, Liu Liu, Mingyang Lv, Yang Cai

entry.summary: Proposes CoMaTrack, a competitive game-theoretic multi-agent framework for embodied visual tracking that trains agents in adversarial settings. Introduces CoMaTrack-Bench, the first benchmark for competitive embodied visual tracking.

entry.title: Efficient Embedding-based Synthetic Data Generation for Complex Reasoning Tasks

author.name: Srideepika Jayaraman, Achille Fokoue, Dhaval Patel, Jayant Kalagnanam

entry.summary: Proposes an embedding-based sampling pipeline for synthetic data generation that analyzes diversity and distribution in embedding space, showing correlation between example density and prediction accuracy in specific neighborhoods.

entry.title: Geometric Mixture-of-Experts with Curvature-Guided Adaptive Routing for Graph Representation Learning

author.name: Haifang Cao, Yu Wang, Timing Li, Xinjie Yao, Pengfei Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes GeoMoE, a Geometric Mixture-of-Experts framework using Ollivier-Ricci Curvature as geometric prior to route node representations across diverse Riemannian spaces for graph learning.

entry.title: Large Language Models for Missing Data Imputation: Understanding Behavior, Hallucination Effects, and Control Mechanisms

author.name: Arthur Dantas Mangussi, Ricardo Cardoso Pereira, Ana Carolina Lorena, Pedro Henriques Abreu

entry.summary: Comprehensive benchmarking study of LLMs for zero-shot missing data imputation across tabular datasets, examining robustness across different missingness mechanisms (MCAR, MAR, MNAR) and analyzing hallucination effects on imputation quality.

entry.title: STRIATUM-CTF: A Protocol-Driven Agentic Framework for General-Purpose CTF Solving

author.name: James Hugglestone, Samuel Jacob Chacko, Dawson Stoller, Ryan Schmidt, Xiuwen Liu

entry.summary: Presents STRIATUM-CTF, a modular agent framework for CTF (Capture The Flag) cybersecurity challenges built on Model Context Protocol, standardizing tool interfaces for system introspection, decompilation, and runtime debugging.

entry.title: Toward Faithful Segmentation Attribution via Benchmarking and Dual-Evidence Fusion

author.name: Abu Noman Md Sakib, OFM Riaz Rahman Aranya, Kevin Desai, Zijie Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces a benchmark for evaluating segmentation attribution faithfulness through intervention-based tests, off-target leakage, and perturbation robustness, along with Dual-Evidence Attribution (DEA) that fuses gradient and intervention signals.

entry.title: WiFi2Cap: Semantic Action Captioning from Wi-Fi CSI via Limb-Level Semantic Alignment

author.name: Tzu-Ti Wei, Chu-Yu Huang, Yu-Chee Tseng, Jen-Jee Chen

entry.summary: Proposes WiFi2Cap, a framework for generating natural language action captions from WiFi CSI signals using a vision-language teacher-student approach with limb-level semantic alignment to address direction-sensitive ambiguities.

entry.title: The Coordinate System Problem in Persistent Structural Memory for Neural Architectures

author.name: Abhinaba Basu

entry.summary: Introduces the Dual-View Pheromone Pathway Network (DPPN) and discovers that persistent structural memory in neural networks requires a stable coordinate system that cannot be learned jointly with the model. Identifies three fundamental obstacles to persistent memory.

entry.title: Looking Beyond the Window: Global-Local Aligned CLIP for Training-free Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation

author.name: ByeongCheol Lee, Hyun Seok Seong, Sangeek Hyun, Gilhan Park, WonJun Moon, Jae-Pil Heo

entry.summary: Proposes GLA-CLIP for training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation that addresses semantic discrepancy across sliding windows by extending key-value tokens to incorporate contextual cues from all windows.

entry.title: MSR-HuBERT: Self-supervised Pre-training for Adaptation to Multiple Sampling Rates

author.name: Zikang Huang, Meng Ge, Tianrui Wang, Xuanchen Li, Xiaobao Wang, Longbiao Wang, Jianwu Dang

entry.summary: Proposes MSR-HuBERT, a multi-sampling-rate adaptive pre-training method for speech processing that handles mixed-rate data without resampling. Replaces single-rate CNN with adaptive downsampling for unified mixed-rate training.

entry.title: Designing Agentic AI-Based Screening for Portfolio Investment

author.name: Mehmet Caner, Agostino Capponi, Nathan Sun, Jonathan Y. Tan

entry.summary: Introduces an agentic AI platform for portfolio management where two specialized LLM agents (fundamentals screening and sentiment analysis) deliberate to generate buy/sell signals, followed by precision matrix estimation for optimal weights.

entry.title: Causal Reconstruction of Sentiment Signals from Sparse News Data

author.name: Stefania Stan, Marzio Lunghi, Vito Vargetto, Claudio Ricci, Rolands Repetto, Brayden Leo, Shao-Hong Gan

entry.summary: Proposes framing news sentiment analysis as causal signal reconstruction rather than classification, using a three-stage pipeline to produce stable temporal sentiment series robust to sparsity and redundancy.

entry.title: Probabilistic Geometric Alignment via Bayesian Latent Transport for Domain-Adaptive Foundation Models

author.name: Kuepon Aueawatthanaphisut, Kuepon Aueawatthanaphisut

entry.summary: Introduces an uncertainty-aware probabilistic latent transport framework for domain adaptation that uses Bayesian transport operators along Wasserstein geodesics with PAC-Bayesian regularization for foundation model adaptation.

entry.title: Off-Policy Safe Reinforcement Learning with Constrained Optimistic Exploration

author.name: Guopeng Li, Matthijs T. J. Spaan, Julian F. P. Kooij

entry.summary: Proposes COX-Q, an off-policy safe RL algorithm integrating cost-bounded optimistic exploration with conservative offline distributional value learning to reduce constraint violations while maintaining sample efficiency.

entry.title: Stochastic Dimension-Free Zeroth-Order Estimator for High-Dimensional and High-Order PINNs

author.name: Zhangyong Liang, Ji Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a stochastic zeroth-order estimator for high-dimensional PINNs that achieves dimension-free complexity by avoiding backpropagation entirely, addressing the O(d^k) spatial derivative and O(P) memory costs.

entry.title: Uncovering Memorization in Timeseries Imputation models: LBRM Membership Inference and its link to attribute Leakage

author.name: Faiz Taleb, Ivan Gazeau, Maryline Laurent

entry.summary: Demonstrates that time series imputation models are vulnerable to membership and attribute inference attacks in black-box settings, introducing a reference-model-based attack framework.

entry.title: TuneShift-KD: Knowledge Distillation and Transfer for Fine-tuned Models

author.name: Yushi Guan, Jeanine Ohene-Agyei, Daniel Kwan, Jean Sebastien Dandurand, Yifei Zhang, Nandita Vijaykumar

entry.summary: Presents TuneShift-KD for transferring specialized knowledge from fine-tuned LLMs to different pre-trained models without access to original training data, using only a few representative examples.

entry.title: PDGMM-VAE: A Variational Autoencoder with Adaptive Per-Dimension Gaussian Mixture Model Priors for Nonlinear ICA

author.name: Yuan-Hao Wei, Yan-Jie Sun

entry.summary: PDGMM-VAE assigns each latent dimension its own Gaussian mixture model prior for nonlinear independent component analysis, enabling capture of diverse non-Gaussian source statistics within a VAE framework.

entry.title: Tutor-Student Reinforcement Learning: A Dynamic Curriculum for Robust Deepfake Detection

author.name: Zhanhe Lei, Zhongyuan Wang, Jikang Cheng, Baojin Huang, Yuhong Yang, Zhen Han, Chao Liang, Dengpan Ye

entry.summary: TSRL uses a tutor-student RL framework for deepfake detection training curriculum optimization, where a PPO-based tutor agent dynamically adjusts sample importance based on learning dynamics.

entry.title: HEART-PFL: Stable Personalized Federated Learning under Heterogeneity with Hierarchical Directional Alignment and Adversarial Knowledge Transfer

author.name: Minjun Kim, Minje Kim

entry.summary: HEART-PFL combines depth-aware hierarchical directional alignment with adversarial knowledge transfer for personalized federated learning, using lightweight adapters with only 1.46M trainable parameters.

entry.title: C-STEP: Continuous Space-Time Empowerment for Physics-informed Safe Reinforcement Learning of Mobile Agents

author.name: Guihlerme Daubt, Adrian Redder

entry.summary: C-STEP introduces physics-informed intrinsic rewards for safe RL navigation by measuring continuous space-time empowerment, integrating agent dynamics to differentiate safe from risky behavior.

entry.title: Plato's Cave: A Human-Centered Research Verification System

author.name: Matheus Kunzler Maldaner, Raul Valle, Junsung Kim, Tonuka Sultan, Pranav Bhargava, Matthew Maloni, John Courtney, Hoang Nguyen, Aamogh Sawant, Kristian O'Connor, Stephen Wormald, Damon L. Woodard

entry.summary: Plato's Cave is an open-source research verification system that creates a directed acyclic graph from a document, uses web agents to assign credibility scores, and evaluates argumentative structure. Tested on 104 research papers for fact-checking and quality assessment.

entry.title: Large Language Models Unpack Complex Political Opinions through Target-Stance Extraction

author.name: \"Ozg\"ur Togay, Florian Kunneman, Javier Garcia-Bernardo, Anastasia Giachanou

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLMs can perform Target-Stance Extraction (TSE) to decompose political discourse into specific targets and stances, moving beyond coarse partisan labels. This enables more granular analysis of how political beliefs interact in online conversations.

entry.title: Ethio-ASR: Joint Multilingual Speech Recognition and Language Identification for Ethiopian Languages

author.name: Badr M. Abdullah, Israel Abebe Azime, Atnafu Lambebo Tonja, Jesujoba O. Alabi, Abel Mulat Alemu, Eyob G. Hagos, Bontu Fufa Balcha, Mulubrhan A. Nerea, Debela Desalegn Yadeta, Dagnachew Mekonnen Marilign, Amanuel Temesgen Fentahun, Tadesse Kebede, Israel D. Gebru, Michael Melese Woldeyohannis, Walelign Tewabe Sewunetie, Bernd M\"obius, Dietrich Klakow

entry.summary: Ethio-ASR presents multilingual CTC-based ASR models jointly trained on five Ethiopian languages (Amharic, Tigrinya, Oromo, Sidaama, Wolaytta). The best model achieves 30.48% WER, outperforming OmniASR with fewer parameters on the WAXAL corpus.

entry.title: VehicleMemBench: An Executable Benchmark for Multi-User Long-Term Memory in In-Vehicle Agents

author.name: Yuhao Chen, Yi Xu, Xinyun Ding, Xiang Fang, Shuochen Liu, Luxi Lin, Qingyu Zhang, Ya Li, Quan Liu, Tong Xu

entry.summary: VehicleMemBench is a multi-user long-context memory benchmark for in-vehicle agents built on an executable simulation environment. Evaluates tool use and memory with temporal preference evolution and inter-user preference conflicts.

entry.title: Bi-CRCL: Bidirectional Conservative-Radical Complementary Learning with Pre-trained Foundation Models for Class-incremental Medical Image Analysis

author.name: Xinyao Wu, Zhe Xu, Cheng Chen, Jiawei Ma, Yefeng Zheng, Raymond Kai-yu Tong

entry.summary: Proposes Bi-CRCL for class-incremental learning in medical imaging using pretrained foundation models, addressing the challenge of learning new disease categories without forgetting old ones and without memory replay due to privacy constraints.

entry.title: Learning Cross-Joint Attention for Generalizable Video-Based Seizure Detection

author.name: Omar Zamzam, Takfarinas Medani, Chinmay Chinara, Richard Leahy

entry.summary: Proposes a joint-centric attention model for automated seizure detection from clinical video, focusing on body joint dynamics rather than appearance to improve cross-subject generalization and reduce background bias.

entry.title: MMTIT-Bench: A Multilingual and Multi-Scenario Benchmark with Cognition-Perception-Reasoning Guided Text-Image Machine Translation

author.name: Gengluo Li, Chengquan Zhang, Yupu Liang, Huawen Shen, Yaping Zhang, Pengyuan Lyu, Weinong Wang, Xingyu Wan, Gangyan Zeng, Han Hu, Can Ma, Yu Zhou

entry.summary: Presents MMTIT-Bench, a multilingual benchmark for text-image machine translation covering 14 non-English/non-Chinese languages, with 1,400 images across diverse visual settings, evaluating VLLMs on end-to-end translation.

entry.title: Leave No Stone Unturned: Uncovering Holistic Audio-Visual Intrinsic Coherence for Deepfake Detection

author.name: Jielun Peng, Yabin Wang, Yaqi Li, Long Kong, Xiaopeng Hong

entry.summary: Proposes HAVIC for deepfake detection that leverages holistic audio-visual intrinsic coherence rather than generator-specific artifacts, learning both intra-modal and cross-modal coherence priors for improved generalization.

entry.title: Decompose and Transfer: CoT-Prompting Enhanced Alignment for Open-Vocabulary Temporal Action Detection

author.name: Sa Zhu, Wanqian Zhang, Lin Wang, Xiaohua Chen, Chenxu Cui, Jinchao Zhang, Bo Li

entry.summary: Proposes PDA framework for open-vocabulary temporal action detection using CoT-prompting with LLMs to decompose action labels into phase descriptions for fine-grained alignment between text and video features.

entry.title: Heuristic-inspired Reasoning Priors Facilitate Data-Efficient Referring Object Detection

author.name: Xu Zhang, Zhe Chen, Jing Zhang, Dacheng Tao

entry.summary: Introduces De-ROD task and HeROD framework for data-efficient referring object detection, using explicit heuristic reasoning priors to improve learning in low-data and few-shot settings.

entry.title: RefReward-SR: LR-Conditioned Reward Modeling for Preference-Aligned Super-Resolution

author.name: Yushuai Song, Weize Quan, Weining Wang, Jiahui Sun, Jing Liu, Meng Li, Pengbin Yu, Zhentao Chen, Wei Shen, Lunxi Yuan, Dong-ming Yan

entry.summary: Proposes RefReward-SR, an LR-reference-aware reward model for preference-aligned super-resolution that moves beyond GT-dependent metrics to better match human perceptual preferences.

entry.title: Le MuMo JEPA: Multi-Modal Self-Supervised Representation Learning with Learnable Fusion Tokens

author.name: Ciem Cornelissen, Sam Leroux, Pieter Simoens

entry.summary: Presents Le MuMo JEPA, a self-supervised framework that learns unified representations from RGB images and companion modalities (LiDAR depth, thermal) using learnable fusion tokens as a latent bottleneck in a shared transformer. Extends the JEPA paradigm to multi-modal settings for driving and ADAS applications.

entry.title: The Gait Signature of Frailty: Transfer Learning based Deep Gait Models for Scalable Frailty Assessment

author.name: Laura McDaniel, Basudha Pal, Crystal Szczesny, Yuxiang Guo, Ryan Roemmich, Peter Abadir, Rama Chellappa

entry.summary: Introduces a publicly available silhouette-based frailty gait dataset and uses transfer learning from large gait recognition models to assess frailty in older adults, including those using walking aids.

entry.title: Goal-Oriented Reactive Simulation for Closed-Loop Trajectory Prediction

author.name: Harsh Yadav, Tobias Meisen

entry.summary: Proposes a goal-oriented closed-loop training paradigm for trajectory prediction with a reactive transformer-based scene decoder, addressing covariate shift from open-loop training.

entry.title: Finding X-Risks and S-Risks by Gradient Descent

author.name: dspeyer

entry.summary: Proposes using gradient descent to find adversarial inputs (backdoors, failure modes) in neural networks as a way to search for X-risks and S-risks, drawing analogy from backdoor detection in image classifiers to broader AI safety concerns.

entry.title: Do 3D Large Language Models Really Understand 3D Spatial Relationships?

author.name: Xianzheng Ma, Tao Sun, Shuai Chen, Yash Bhalgat, Jindong Gu, Angel X Chang, Iro Armeni, Iro Laina, Songyou Peng, Victor Adrian Prisacariu

entry.summary: This paper reveals that fine-tuning a language model on text-only QA pairs can match or surpass 3D-LLMs on SQA3D without any 3D input, suggesting the benchmark allows textual shortcuts. They introduce Real-3DQA, a more rigorous benchmark filtering easy-to-guess questions with structured taxonomy for 3D reasoning assessment.

entry.title: Graph-Aware Late Chunking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Biomedical Literature

author.name: Pouria Mortezaagha, Arya Rahgozar

entry.summary: Proposes GraLC-RAG, a framework combining late chunking with graph-aware structural intelligence for biomedical RAG, including structure-aware chunking, UMLS knowledge graph infusion, and graph-guided hybrid retrieval. Argues MRR is insufficient for full-text scientific documents.

entry.title: Graphs RAG at Scale: Beyond Retrieval-Augmented Generation With Labeled Property Graphs and Resource Description Framework for Complex and Unknown Search Spaces

author.name: Manie Tadayon, Mayank Gupta

entry.summary: Introduces a Graph RAG framework combining Labeled Property Graphs and RDF architectures for handling unknown or semi-structured search spaces, with a novel method for converting documents into RDF triplets using JSON key-value pairs.

entry.title: Do Consumers Accept AIs as Moral Compliance Agents?

author.name: Greg Nyilasy, Abraham Ryan Ade Putra Hito, Jennifer Overbeck, Brock Bastian, Darren W. Dahl

entry.summary: Studies whether consumers accept AI in moral compliance roles (upholding pre-existing norms) versus moral agency roles, finding consumers prefer AI over humans for compliance due to perceived lack of ulterior motives. Five studies provide evidence.

entry.title: URA-Net: Uncertainty-Integrated Anomaly Perception and Restoration Attention Network for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection

author.name: Wei Luo, Peng Xing, Yunkang Cao, Haiming Yao, Weiming Shen, Zechao Li

entry.summary: Proposes URA-Net for unsupervised anomaly detection that explicitly restores abnormal patterns to normality rather than just reconstructing normal patterns, using uncertainty-integrated multi-level semantic features.

entry.title: HUydra: Full-Range Lung CT Synthesis via Multiple HU Interval Generative Modelling

author.name: Ant\'onio Cardoso, Pedro Sousa, Tania Pereira, H\'elder P. Oliveira

entry.summary: Introduces a novel decomposition strategy for synthesizing lung CT images one Hounsfield Unit interval at a time, reducing computational demands of full-range CT synthesis for medical imaging data augmentation.

entry.title: AuthorMix: Modular Authorship Style Transfer via Layer-wise Adapter Mixing

author.name: Sarubi Thillainathan, Ji-Ung Lee, Michael Sullivan, Alexander Koller

entry.summary: Proposes AuthorMix, a modular framework for authorship style transfer using individual LoRA adapters trained on high-resource authors, combined via learned layer-wise mixing for new target styles from few examples.

entry.title: Biased Error Attribution in Multi-Agent Human-AI Systems Under Delayed Feedback

author.name: Teerthaa Parakh, Karen M. Feigh

entry.summary: Studies biased error attribution in multi-agent human-AI systems with delayed feedback, finding asymmetric responses to gains and losses consistent with loss aversion in how humans attribute blame across multiple AI agents.

entry.title: AscendOptimizer: Episodic Agent for Ascend NPU Operator Optimization

author.name: Jiehao Wu, Zixiao Huang, Wenhao Li, Chuyun Shen, Junjie Sheng, Xiangfeng Wang

entry.summary: Presents AscendOptimizer, an episodic agent that optimizes operator performance on Huawei Ascend NPUs through profiling-driven evolutionary search and experience transfer, addressing the knowledge gap in non-CUDA AI accelerators.

entry.title: APreQEL: Adaptive Mixed Precision Quantization For Edge LLMs

author.name: Meriem Bouzouad, Yuan-Hao Chang, Jalil Boukhobza

entry.summary: Proposes APreQEL, an adaptive mixed-precision quantization method for deploying LLMs on edge devices, accounting for different layers' sensitivity to reduced precision.

entry.title: Lightweight Fairness for LLM-Based Recommendations via Kernelized Projection and Gated Adapters

author.name: Nan Cui, Wendy Hui Wang, Yue Ning

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight bias mitigation method for LLM-based recommender systems combining kernelized null-space projection with gated Mixture-of-Experts adapters to remove sensitive attributes without additional training.

entry.title: Unveiling Hidden Convexity in Deep Learning: a Sparse Signal Processing Perspective

author.name: Emi Zeger, Mert Pilanci

entry.summary: Survey/review paper highlighting how convex equivalences of ReLU neural networks connect to sparse signal processing, potentially addressing optimization challenges in deep learning through hidden convexity in loss landscapes.

entry.title: Causality-Driven Disentangled Representation Learning in Multiplex Graphs

author.name: Saba Nasiri, Selin Aviyente, Dorina Thanou

entry.summary: Introduces CaDeM, a causal inference-based framework for disentangling shared and layer-specific representations in multiplex graphs using backdoor adjustment to ensure proper separation.

entry.title: Cost-Sensitive Neighborhood Aggregation for Heterophilous Graphs: When Does Per-Edge Routing Help?

author.name: Eyal Weiss

entry.summary: Introduces CSNA, a GNN layer with per-edge routing through concordant/discordant channels based on learned pairwise distances, with theoretical analysis distinguishing adversarial vs. informative heterophily regimes.

entry.title: Large Language Model Guided Incentive Aware Reward Design for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Dogan Urgun, Gokhan Gungor

entry.summary: Proposes using LLMs to automatically synthesize reward programs for cooperative multi-agent RL, evaluating candidates by training policies from scratch under fixed compute budgets.

entry.title: No Single Metric Tells the Whole Story: A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation Framework for Uncertainty Attributions

author.name: Emily Schiller, Teodor Chiaburu, Marco Zullich, Luca Longo

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-dimensional evaluation framework for uncertainty attributions in XAI, aligned with the Co-12 framework, introducing metrics for correctness, consistency, continuity, compactness, and a new conveyance property.

entry.title: LLMORPH: Automated Metamorphic Testing of Large Language Models

author.name: Steven Cho, Stefano Ruberto, Valerio Terragni

entry.summary: LLMORPH is an automated testing tool for LLMs performing NLP tasks that uses metamorphic testing to detect faulty behaviors without human-labeled data, leveraging metamorphic relations to generate follow-up test inputs.

entry.title: {\lambda}Split: Self-Supervised Content-Aware Spectral Unmixing for Fluorescence Microscopy

author.name: Federico Carrara, Talley Lambert, Mehdi Seifi, Florian Jug

entry.summary: λSplit is a self-supervised, physics-informed deep generative model for spectral unmixing in fluorescence microscopy, recovering individual fluorophore concentrations from mixed emission spectra without ground truth data.

entry.title: Object Search in Partially-Known Environments via LLM-informed Model-based Planning and Prompt Selection

author.name: Abhishek Paudel, Abhish Khanal, Raihan I. Arnob, Shahriar Hossain, Gregory J. Stein

entry.summary: Presents an LLM-informed model-based planning framework for object search in partially-known environments, using LLMs to estimate object location likelihoods combined with travel costs for efficient search planning.

entry.title: MedAidDialog: A Multilingual Multi-Turn Medical Dialogue Dataset for Accessible Healthcare

author.name: Shubham Kumar Nigam, Suparnojit Sarkar, Piyush Patel

entry.summary: MedAidDialog is a multilingual multi-turn medical dialogue dataset covering seven languages, generated using LLMs to simulate physician-patient consultations, extending the MDDial corpus.

entry.title: A Neuro-Symbolic System for Interpretable Multimodal Physiological Signals Integration in Human Fatigue Detection

author.name: Mohammadreza Jamalifard, Yaxiong Lei, Parasto Azizinezhad, Javier Fumanal-Idocin, Javier Andreu-Perez

entry.summary: Proposes a neuro-symbolic architecture for fatigue detection from eye-tracking and fNIRS data, combining attention-based encoders with differentiable approximate reasoning rules for interpretable multimodal physiological signal integration.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Reasoning with Consistency Verification Improves Uncertainty Calibration in Medical MCQA

author.name: John Ray B. Martinez

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent framework with domain-specific specialist agents and two-phase self-verification for improving uncertainty calibration in medical multiple-choice QA, using S-Score weighted fusion.

entry.title: From Physician Expertise to Clinical Agents: Preserving, Standardizing, and Scaling Physicians' Medical Expertise with Lightweight LLM

author.name: Chanyong Luo, Jirui Dai, Zhendong Wang, Kui Chen, Jiaxi Yang, Bingjie Lu, Jing Wang, Jiaxin Hao, Bing Li, Ruiyang He, Yiyu Qiao, Chenkai Zhang, Kaiyu Wang, Zhi Liu, Zeyu Zheng, Yan Li, Xiaohong Gu

entry.summary: Med-Shicheng proposes a framework for LLMs to learn and transfer distinguished physicians' diagnostic-and-therapeutic philosophy using lightweight models. It aims to standardize and scale expert clinical knowledge that is typically slow to develop and hard to transmit. Built on a specific medical knowledge architecture.

entry.title: Revisiting Real-Time Digging-In Effects: No Evidence from NP/Z Garden-Paths

author.name: Amani Maina-Kilaas, Roger Levy

entry.summary: Two experiments on English NP/Z garden-path sentences investigate 'digging-in effects' in human sentence processing, comparing human behavior with LLM predictions. Finds no evidence for real-time digging-in effects, supporting surprisal theory over self-organized processing accounts.

entry.title: Swiss-Bench SBP-002: A Frontier Model Comparison on Swiss Legal and Regulatory Tasks

author.name: Fatih Uenal

entry.summary: Swiss-Bench SBP-002 is a trilingual benchmark of 395 expert-crafted items covering Swiss regulatory compliance across FINMA, Legal-CH, and EFK domains. Evaluates ten frontier models from March 2026 using a structured three-dimension scoring framework with LLM panel judges.

entry.title: PLACID: Privacy-preserving Large language models for Acronym Clinical Inference and Disambiguation

author.name: Manjushree B. Aithal, Ph. D., Alexander Kotz, James Mitchell, Ph. D

entry.summary: PLACID introduces a privacy-preserving cascaded pipeline using small on-device models for clinical acronym disambiguation, avoiding the need to transmit Protected Health Information to external servers. Addresses a practical safety concern in healthcare NLP deployment.

entry.title: When AI Meets Early Childhood Education: Large Language Models as Assessment Teammates in Chinese Preschools

author.name: Xingming Li, Runke Huang, Yanan Bao, Yuye Jin, Yuru Jiao, Qingyong Hu

entry.summary: Investigates whether AI can serve as scalable assessment tool for teacher-child interaction quality in Chinese preschools. Creates TEPE-TCI-370h dataset and validates AI-extracted quality indicators against human expert judgments across 250,000+ kindergartens.

entry.title: Foundation Model Embeddings Meet Blended Emotions: A Multimodal Fusion Approach for the BLEMORE Challenge

author.name: Masoumeh Chapariniya, Aref Farhadipour, Sarah Ebling, Volker Dellwo, Teodora Vukovic

entry.summary: System for blended emotion recognition combining six encoder families through late fusion. Notable for first use of Gemini Embedding 2.0 for emotion recognition, achieving competitive results from only 2 seconds of video input.

entry.title: Mind the Hitch: Dynamic Calibration and Articulated Perception for Autonomous Trucks

author.name: Morui Zhu, Yongqi Zhu, Song Fu, Qing Yang

entry.summary: Introduces dCAP, a vision-based framework for autonomous trucking that continuously estimates the 6-DoF relative pose between tractor and trailer cameras, addressing the unique articulated geometry challenge of autonomous trucks.

entry.title: An Adapter-free Fine-tuning Approach for Tuning 3D Foundation Models

author.name: Sneha Paul, Zachary Patterson, Nizar Bouguila

entry.summary: Proposes MCFT, an adapter-free fine-tuning approach for 3D point cloud foundation models that selectively fine-tunes parts of the encoder while enforcing momentum-based consistency constraints to prevent overfitting in low-data regimes.

entry.title: 3D-LLDM: Label-Guided 3D Latent Diffusion Model for Improving High-Resolution Synthetic MR Imaging in Hepatic Structure Segmentation

author.name: Kyeonghun Kim, Jaehyeok Bae, Youngung Han, Joo Young Bae, Seoyoung Ju, Junsu Lim, Gyeongmin Kim, Nam-Joon Kim, Woo Kyoung Jeong, Ken Ying-Kai Liao, Won Jae Lee, Pa Hong, Hyuk-Jae Lee

entry.summary: Proposes 3D-LLDM, a label-guided 3D latent diffusion model that generates synthetic MR volumes with corresponding segmentation masks for hepatic structure segmentation, using ControlNet-based architecture guided by structural masks.

entry.title: Latent Bias Alignment for High-Fidelity Diffusion Inversion in Real-World Image Reconstruction and Manipulation

author.name: Weiming Chen, Qifan Liu, Siyi Liu, Yushun Tang, Yijia Wang, Zhihan Zhu, Zhihai He

entry.summary: Proposes Latent Bias Alignment for diffusion model inversion, addressing trajectory misalignment between inversion and generation and mismatch with VQ autoencoder reconstruction for high-fidelity real image reconstruction.

entry.title: DecepGPT: Schema-Driven Deception Detection with Multicultural Datasets and Robust Multimodal Learning

author.name: Jiajian Huang, Dongliang Zhu, Zitong YU, Hui Ma, Jiayu Zhang, Chunmei Zhu, Xiaochun Cao

entry.summary: Introduces DecepGPT for multimodal deception detection with structured reasoning chains, along with a new multicultural dataset T4-Deception spanning diverse cultural contexts and scenarios.

entry.title: HyDRA: Hybrid Domain-Aware Robust Architecture for Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception

author.name: Minwoo Song, Minhee Kang, Heejin Ahn

entry.summary: Proposes HyDRA for collaborative perception that handles heterogeneity in model architectures and data distributions via a unified pipeline integrating intermediate and late fusion with domain-aware routing.

entry.title: HGGT: Robust and Flexible 3D Hand Mesh Reconstruction from Uncalibrated Images

author.name: Yumeng Liu, Xiao-Xiao Long, Marc Habermann, Xuanze Yang, Cheng Lin, Yuan Liu, Yuexin Ma, Wenping Wang, Ligang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes HGGT for 3D hand mesh reconstruction that works with both calibrated and uncalibrated multi-view images, bridging the gap between single-view ease of deployment and multi-view accuracy.

entry.title: A convergent Plug-and-Play Majorization-Minimization algorithm for Poisson inverse problems

author.name: Thibaut Modrzyk (CREATIS), Ane Etxebeste (CREATIS), \'Elie Bretin (ICJ, MMCS), Voichita Maxim (CREATIS)

entry.summary: Presents a convergent plug-and-play algorithm for Poisson inverse problems using majorization-minimization framework with pre-trained Gaussian denoisers, providing convergence guarantees.

entry.title: Heuristic Self-Paced Learning for Domain Adaptive Semantic Segmentation under Adverse Conditions

author.name: Shiqin Wang, Haoyang Chen, Huaizhou Huang, Yinkan He, Dongfang Sun, Xiaoqing Chen, Xingyu Liu, Zheng Wang, Kaiyan Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes an RL-based autonomous class scheduler for domain adaptive semantic segmentation under adverse weather, casting curriculum learning as a sequential decision problem with a policy-gradient approach.

entry.title: GeoRouter: Dynamic Paradigm Routing for Worldwide Image Geolocalization

author.name: Pengyue Jia, Derong Xu, Yingyi Zhang, Xiaopeng Li, Wenlin Zhang, Yi Wen, Yuanshao Zhu, Xiangyu Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes GeoRouter, a dynamic routing framework for image geolocalization that adaptively selects between retrieval-based and generation-based paradigms depending on the query. Exploits complementary error profiles between the two approaches.

entry.title: CliPPER: Contextual Video-Language Pretraining on Long-form Intraoperative Surgical Procedures for Event Recognition

author.name: Florian Stilz, Vinkle Srivastav, Nassir Navab, Nicolas Padoy

entry.summary: Introduces CliPPER, a video-language pretraining framework for surgical procedure understanding trained on surgical lecture videos, designed for fine-grained temporal recognition in intraoperative settings.

entry.title: Vision-Language Models vs Human: Perceptual Image Quality Assessment

author.name: Imran Mehmood, Imad Ali Shah, Ming Ronnier Luo, Brian Deegan

entry.summary: Benchmarks six VLMs against human psychophysical data for perceptual image quality assessment across contrast, colorfulness, and preference scales. Finds strong attribute-dependent variability in VLM-human alignment.

entry.title: Decentralized End-to-End Multi-AAV Pursuit Using Predictive Spatio-Temporal Observation via Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yude Li, Zhexuan Zhou, Huizhe Li, Yanke Sun, Yenan Wu, Yichen Lai, Yiming Wang, Youmin Gong, Jie Mei

entry.summary: Proposes a decentralized end-to-end MARL framework for cooperative aerial pursuit using raw LiDAR observations, with a Predictive Spatio-Temporal Observation representation that unifies obstacle geometry with adversarial intent prediction.

entry.title: Toward Generalist Neural Motion Planners for Robotic Manipulators: Challenges and Opportunities

author.name: Davood Soleymanzadeh, Ivan Lopez-Sanchez, Hao Su, Yunzhu Li, Xiao Liang, Minghui Zheng

entry.summary: A survey paper on generalist neural motion planners for robotic manipulators, analyzing challenges and opportunities in achieving out-of-distribution generalization for motion planning in cluttered environments.

entry.title: Don't Write Off Human Labor, Yet

author.name: burnssa

entry.summary: Argues that human labor may remain necessary even with aligned AI, challenging the assumption of wholesale labor substitution. The post identifies two key conditions: market demand must be defined by human preferences, and human labor must remain complementary to AI capital. Points to labor data suggesting growing demand for human 'specification' inputs.

entry.title: SEGAR: Selective Enhancement for Generative Augmented Reality

author.name: Fanjun Bu, Chenyang Yuan, Hiroshi Yasuda

entry.summary: Presents SEGAR, a framework combining diffusion-based world models with selective correction for augmented reality, generating augmented future frames with region-specific edits while maintaining safety-critical alignment with real observations.

entry.title: HyFI: Hyperbolic Feature Interpolation for Brain-Vision Alignment

author.name: Sangmin Jo, Wootaek Jeong, Da-Woon Heo, Yoohwan Hwang, Heung-Il Suk

entry.summary: Uses hyperbolic space for brain-vision alignment, addressing the modality gap between brain signals and images and the entanglement of semantic/perceptual features in neural activity through hyperbolic feature interpolation.

entry.title: PersonalQ: Select, Quantize, and Serve Personalized Diffusion Models for Efficient Inference

author.name: Qirui Wang, Qi Guo, Yiding Sun, Junkai Yang, Dongxu Zhang, Shanmin Pang, Qing Guo

entry.summary: Presents PersonalQ, a framework for serving personalized diffusion model checkpoints that connects checkpoint selection and quantization through trigger tokens, addressing ambiguous routing and quantization distortion of personalized concepts.

entry.title: MERIT: Memory-Enhanced Retrieval for Interpretable Knowledge Tracing

author.name: Runze Li, Kedi Chen, Guwei Feng, Mo Yu, Jun Wang, Wei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MERIT, a training-free knowledge tracing framework combining frozen LLM reasoning with structured pedagogical memory, transforming raw interaction logs into educational insights without fine-tuning.

entry.title: Enhancing AI-Based Tropical Cyclone Track and Intensity Forecasting via Systematic Bias Correction

author.name: Peisong Niu, Haifan Zhang, Yang Zhao, Tian Zhou, Ziqing Ma, Wenqiang Shen, Junping Zhao, Huiling Yuan, Liang Sun

entry.summary: Proposes systematic bias correction for AI-based tropical cyclone forecasting, addressing discretization errors from coarse ERA5 grids and intensity prediction biases from regression losses, especially for strong TCs.

entry.title: GraphRAG for Engineering Diagrams: ChatP&ID Enables LLM Interaction with P&IDs

author.name: Achmad Anggawirya Alimin, Artur M. Schweidtmann

entry.summary: Introduces ChatP&ID, an agentic framework for natural-language interaction with Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams using GraphRAG, transforming DEXPI-standard P&IDs into knowledge graphs for grounded, cost-effective querying.

entry.title: flexvec: SQL Vector Retrieval with Programmatic Embedding Modulation

author.name: Damian Delmas

entry.summary: Introduces flexvec, a retrieval system that exposes the embedding matrix and score array as a programmable surface for composable query-time operations (Programmatic Embedding Modulation), achieving 19ms end-to-end on 240K chunks.

entry.title: DALDALL: Data Augmentation for Lexical and Semantic Diverse in Legal Domain by leveraging LLM-Persona

author.name: Janghyeok Choi, Jaewon Lee, Sungzoon Cho

entry.summary: Introduces DALDALL, a persona-based data augmentation framework for legal information retrieval that uses LLM personas (attorneys, prosecutors, judges) to generate diverse synthetic queries, improving lexical and semantic diversity over vanilla prompting.

entry.title: From Overload to Convergence: Supporting Multi-Issue Human-AI Negotiation with Bayesian Visualization

author.name: Mehul Parmar, Chaklam Silpasuwanchai

entry.summary: Designs a Bayesian visualization tool for multi-issue human-AI negotiation that shows how the space of acceptable agreements narrows over time, finding it improves negotiation outcomes when issues exceed three.

entry.title: A Multimodal Framework for Human-Multi-Agent Interaction

author.name: Shaid Hasan, Breenice Lee, Sujan Sarker, Tariq Iqbal

entry.summary: Introduces a multimodal framework for human-multi-agent interaction where each robot operates as an autonomous cognitive agent with LLM-driven planning, coordinated through centralized turn-taking mechanisms.

entry.title: Unilateral Relationship Revision Power in Human-AI Companion Interaction

author.name: Benjamin Lange

entry.summary: Analyzes the ethics of Unilateral Relationship Revision Power (URRP) in human-AI companion interactions, arguing that providers' constitutive control over AI companions undermines the normative foundations of personal relationships.

entry.title: Planning over MAPF Agent Dependencies via Multi-Dependency PIBT

author.name: Zixiang Jiang, Yulun Zhang, Rishi Veerapaneni, Jiaoyang Li

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-Dependency PIBT for multi-agent path finding that generalizes PIBT by planning over agent dependencies, allowing paths that conflict with multiple agents simultaneously.

entry.title: PoiCGAN: A Targeted Poisoning Based on Feature-Label Joint Perturbation in Federated Learning

author.name: Tao Liu, Jiguang Lv, Dapeng Man, Weiye Xi, Yaole Li, Feiyu Zhao, Kuiming Wang, Yingchao Bian, Chen Xu, Wu Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a targeted poisoning attack on federated learning using conditional GANs for joint feature-label perturbation, designed to bypass model performance tests and anomaly detection defenses.

entry.title: CDMT-EHR: A Continuous-Time Diffusion Framework for Generating Mixed-Type Time-Series Electronic Health Records

author.name: Shaonan Liu, Yuichiro Iwashita, Soichiro Nakako, Masakazu Iwamura, Koichi Kise

entry.summary: Proposes CDMT-EHR, a continuous-time diffusion framework for generating synthetic mixed-type time-series electronic health records, using bidirectional GRUs and addressing limitations of discrete-time formulations.

entry.title: Kirchhoff-Inspired Neural Networks for Evolving High-Order Perception

author.name: Tongfei Chen, Jingying Yang, Linlin Yang, Jinhu L\"u, David Doermann, Chunyu Xie, Long He, Tian Wang, Juan Zhang, Guodong Guo, Baochang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Kirchhoff-inspired neural networks that draw on electrical circuit theory to model signal intensity, coupling structure, and state evolution, going beyond standard weight-bias parameterization inspired by biological neurons.

entry.title: Efficient Controller Learning from Human Preferences and Numerical Data Via Multi-Modal Surrogate Models

author.name: Lukas Theiner, Maik Pfefferkorn, Yongpeng Zhao, Sebastian Hirt, Rolf Findeisen

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-modal Bayesian optimization framework integrating low-fidelity numerical data with high-fidelity human preferences for controller tuning, using hierarchical multi-output GP surrogates.

entry.title: Embracing Heteroscedasticity for Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Yijun Wang, Qiyuan Zhuang, Xiu-Shen Wei

entry.summary: Proposes a heteroscedastic VAE framework (LSG-VAE) for probabilistic time series forecasting that models time-varying conditional variances, addressing the homoscedastic limitation of MSE-based training.

entry.title: MDKeyChunker: Single-Call LLM Enrichment with Rolling Keys and Key-Based Restructuring for High-Accuracy RAG

author.name: Bhavik Mangla

entry.summary: MDKeyChunker is a three-stage RAG pipeline for Markdown documents that performs structure-aware chunking, single-call LLM enrichment with rolling key dictionaries, and key-based restructuring via bin-packing for improved retrieval.

entry.title: Walma: Learning to See Memory Corruption in WebAssembly

author.name: Oussama Draissi, Mark G\"unzel, Ahmad-Reza Sadeghi, Lucas Davi

entry.summary: Walma uses machine learning to detect memory corruption and external tampering in WebAssembly by classifying memory snapshots, providing runtime integrity verification against adversarial hosts.

entry.title: Continuous-Time Learning of Probability Distributions: A Case Study in a Digital Trial of Young Children with Type 1 Diabetes

author.name: Antonio \'Alvarez-L\'opez, Marcos Matabuena

entry.summary: Proposes a probabilistic framework for modeling continuous-time evolution of glucose distributions using CGM data from a pediatric Type 1 diabetes trial, representing distributions as Gaussian mixtures with time-varying weights.

entry.title: IslamicMMLU: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Islamic Knowledge

author.name: Ali Abdelaal, Mohammed Nader Al Haffar, Mahmoud Fawzi, Walid Magdy

entry.summary: IslamicMMLU is a benchmark of 10,013 multiple-choice questions across Quran, Hadith, and Fiqh for evaluating LLMs on Islamic knowledge. Evaluation of 26 LLMs shows accuracy ranging from 39.8% to 93.8%, with the Quran track showing the widest performance spread.

entry.title: ConceptKT: A Benchmark for Concept-Level Deficiency Prediction in Knowledge Tracing

author.name: Yu-Chen Kang, Yu-Chien Tang, An-Zi Yen

entry.summary: ConceptKT introduces concept-level deficiency prediction in knowledge tracing, extending beyond binary correctness to identify specific concepts students struggle with. Includes a dataset with labels capturing both required and missing concepts.

entry.title: Variation is the Norm: Embracing Sociolinguistics in NLP

author.name: Anne-Marie Lutgen, Alistair Plum, Verena Blaschke, Barbara Plank, Christoph Purschke

entry.summary: Presents a framework combining sociolinguistics with NLP, arguing that language variation should be embraced rather than normalized away. Case study on Luxembourgish demonstrates how orthographic variation impacts NLP performance, with large discrepancies across models.

entry.title: Semantic Alignment across Ancient Egyptian Language Stages via Normalization-Aware Multitask Learning

author.name: He Huang

entry.summary: Studies word-level semantic alignment across four historical stages of Ancient Egyptian using multitask learning with a shared byte-level tokenizer. Combines MLM, TLM, translation, and POS tagging with Latin transliteration and IPA reconstruction as auxiliary views.

entry.title: A Sociolinguistic Analysis of Automatic Speech Recognition Bias in Newcastle English

author.name: Dana Serditova, Kevin Tang

entry.summary: Sociolinguistic analysis of ASR bias in Newcastle English using the DECTE corpus, classifying 3,000+ transcription errors by linguistic category. Shows how dialectal variation from mainstream accents degrades commercial ASR performance.

entry.title: Evaluating a Multi-Agent Voice-Enabled Smart Speaker for Care Homes: A Safety-Focused Framework

author.name: Zeinab Dehghani, Rameez Raja Kureshi, Koorosh Aslansefat, Faezeh Alsadat Abedi, Dhavalkumar Thakker, Lisa Greaves, Bhupesh Kumar Mishra, Baseer Ahmad, Tanaya Maslekar

entry.summary: Evaluates a multi-agent voice-enabled smart speaker for care homes using a safety-focused framework combining Whisper ASR with RAG. Tests 330 spoken transcripts across 11 care categories from supervised care-home trials.

entry.title: CoRe: Joint Optimization with Contrastive Learning for Medical Image Registration
