Uses a domain tree for exploration, retrieves web content, and performs Challenger-Solver self-play with verifiable rewards.

entry.title: Three Creates All: You Only Sample 3 Steps

author.name: Yuren Cai, Guangyi Wang, Zongqing Li, Li Li, Zhihui Liu, Songzhi Su

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-layer Time Embedding Optimization (MTEO) for few-step diffusion sampling, which freezes the pretrained backbone and distills step-wise, layer-wise time embeddings. Achieves SOTA few-step performance (3 steps) with minimal parameter training.

entry.title: Tiny Inference-Time Scaling with Latent Verifiers

author.name: Davide Bucciarelli, Evelyn Turri, Lorenzo Baraldi, Marcella Cornia, Lorenzo Baraldi, Rita Cucchiara

entry.summary: Proposes Verifier on Hidden States (VHS), which operates directly on intermediate DiT hidden representations for inference-time scaling of diffusion models, avoiding the costly decode-encode cycle of MLLM verifiers. Makes inference-time scaling practical.

entry.title: PopResume: Causal Fairness Evaluation of LLM/VLM Resume Screeners with Population-Representative Dataset

author.name: Sumin Yu, Juhyeon Park, Taesup Moon

entry.summary: Presents PopResume, a population-representative resume dataset for causal fairness auditing of LLM/VLM resume screeners. Decomposes screening effects into business necessity and redlining paths using path-specific effects.

entry.title: Grounding Sim-to-Real Generalization in Dexterous Manipulation: An Empirical Study with Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Ruixing Jin, Zicheng Zhu, Ruixiang Ouyang, Sheng Xu, Bo Yue, Zhizheng Wu, Guiliang Liu

entry.summary: Empirically examines sim-to-real transfer for dexterous manipulation using Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models across four dimensions. Provides principled analysis of what determines successful sim-to-real generalization for generalist robotic policies.

entry.title: Can Graph Foundation Models Generalize Over Architecture?

author.name: Benjamin Gutteridge, Michael Bronstein, Xiaowen Dong

entry.summary: Argues that graph foundation models need architecture adaptivity, not just a fixed message-passing backbone. Shows existing GFMs are non-robust to task-dependent architectural requirements, revealing a fundamental limitation.

entry.title: Not All Tokens Are Created Equal: Query-Efficient Jailbreak Fuzzing for LLMs

author.name: Wenyu Chen, Xiangtao Meng, Chuanchao Zang, Li Wang, Xinyu Gao, Jianing Wang, Peng Zhan, Zheng Li, Shanqing Guo

entry.summary: Proposes a query-efficient jailbreak fuzzing method for LLMs that recognizes token contributions to refusal are highly skewed, not uniform. Exploits cross-model consistency in refusal tendencies for efficient vulnerability assessment.

entry.title: Graph Energy Matching: Transport-Aligned Energy-Based Modeling for Graph Generation

author.name: Michal Balcerak, Suprosana Shit, Chinmay Prabhakar, Sebastian Kaltenbach, Michael S. Albergo, Yilun Du, Bjoern Menze

entry.summary: Introduces Graph Energy Matching (GEM), combining energy-based models with transport-aligned optimization for graph generation. Closes the fidelity gap between energy-based and diffusion models for discrete graph generation.

entry.title: VISion On Request: Enhanced VLLM efficiency with sparse, dynamically selected, vision-language interactions

author.name: Adrian Bulat, Alberto Baldrati, Ioannis Maniadis Metaxas, Yassine Ouali, Georgios Tzimiropoulos

entry.summary: Proposes VISOR, which reduces LVLM inference cost by sparsifying vision-language attention interactions rather than discarding visual tokens. Maintains full visual information while reducing compute.

entry.title: COMPASS-Hedge: Learning Safely Without Knowing the World

author.name: Ting Hu, Luanda Cai, Manolis Vlatakis

entry.summary: Introduces COMPASS-Hedge, the first full-information online learning algorithm achieving minimax-optimal adversarial regret, instance-optimal stochastic regret, and near-constant regret relative to a baseline policy simultaneously.

entry.title: Adversarial Vulnerabilities in Neural Operator Digital Twins: Gradient-Free Attacks on Nuclear Thermal-Hydraulic Surrogates

author.name: Samrendra Roy, Kazuma Kobayashi, Souvik Chakraborty, Rizwan-uddin, Syed Bahauddin Alam

entry.summary: Demonstrates that neural operator digital twins for nuclear systems are acutely vulnerable to sparse adversarial perturbations exploiting boundary condition sensitivity. Less than 1% of inputs can cause catastrophic prediction failures.

entry.title: Precision-Varying Prediction (PVP): Robustifying ASR systems against adversarial attacks

author.name: Mat\'ias Pizarro, Raghavan Narasimhan, Asja Fischer

entry.summary: Shows that changing numerical precision of ASR models during inference reduces adversarial attack success. Proposes random precision sampling during prediction and a Gaussian classifier for adversarial detection by comparing outputs across precisions.

entry.title: Conditionally Identifiable Latent Representation for Multivariate Time Series with Structural Dynamics

author.name: Minkey Chang, Jae-Young Kim

entry.summary: Proposes iVDFM for learning identifiable latent factors from multivariate time series by applying iVAE-style conditioning to innovation processes. Shows factors are identifiable up to permutation and affine transformations.

entry.title: Policy-based Tuning of Autoregressive Image Models with Instance- and Distribution-Level Rewards

author.name: Orhun Bu\u{g}ra Baran, Melih Kandemir, Ramazan Gokberk Cinbis

entry.summary: Proposes an RL framework using GRPO for autoregressive image generation that combines instance-level rewards with a novel distribution-level Leave-One-Out FID reward to prevent diversity collapse.

entry.title: A Schr\"odinger Eigenfunction Method for Long-Horizon Stochastic Optimal Control

author.name: Louis Claeys, Artur Goldman, Zebang Shen, Niao He

entry.summary: Proposes a Schrödinger eigenfunction method for long-horizon stochastic optimal control, proving that under gradient drift assumptions, the HJB equation reduces to a linear PDE with discrete spectrum, enabling efficient eigenfunction-based solutions.

entry.title: A One-Inclusion Graph Approach to Multi-Group Learning

author.name: Noah Bergam, Samuel Deng, Daniel Hsu

entry.summary: Proves tightest-known upper bounds on sample complexity of multi-group learning using one-inclusion graph prediction strategy with generalized bipartite b-matching, achieving optimal convergence rates.

entry.title: Byzantine-Robust and Differentially Private Federated Optimization under Weaker Assumptions

author.name: Rustem Islamov, Grigory Malinovsky, Alexander Gaponov, Aurelien Lucchi, Peter Richt\'arik, Eduard Gorbunov

entry.summary: Proposes Byz-Clip21-SGD2M for federated learning that integrates Byzantine robustness and differential privacy under weaker assumptions than prior work, without requiring bounded gradients or auxiliary server data.

entry.title: Fair splits flip the leaderboard: CHANRG reveals limited generalization in RNA secondary-structure prediction

author.name: Zhiyuan Chen, Zhenfeng Deng, Pan Deng, Yue Liao, Xiu Su, Peng Ye, Xihui Liu

entry.summary: Presents CHANRG, a comprehensive RNA secondary structure prediction benchmark of 170K non-redundant RNAs showing that foundation models lose most advantage out-of-distribution. Evaluates 29 predictors.

entry.title: Probabilistic modeling over permutations using quantum computers

author.name: Vasilis Belis, Giulio Crognaletti, Matteo Argenton, Michele Grossi, Maria Schuld

entry.summary: Leverages quantum computers' super-exponential speedup for Fourier transforms over the symmetric group to enable spectral methods for ML over permutation-structured data like multi-object tracking.

entry.title: Contextual Graph Matching with Correlated Gaussian Features

author.name: Mohammad Hassan Ahmad Yarandi, Luca Ganassali

entry.summary: Derives precise information-theoretic thresholds for exact recovery in contextual graph matching with correlated Gaussian features, showing that additional contextual information creates richer phase transition structure than standard graph matching.

entry.title: How Utilitarian Are OpenAI's Models Really? Replicating and Reinterpreting Pfeffer, Kr\"ugel, and Uhl (2025)

author.name: Johannes Himmelreich

entry.summary: Replicates a study claiming OpenAI's o1-mini is more utilitarian than GPT-4o on trolley problems. Finds the original result was an artifact of safety refusals triggered by prompt framing, not genuine ethical reasoning differences.

entry.title: Efficient Hallucination Detection: Adaptive Bayesian Estimation of Semantic Entropy with Guided Semantic Exploration

author.name: Qiyao Sun, Xingming Li, Xixiang He, Ao Cheng, Xuanyu Ji, Hailun Lu, Runke Huang, Qingyong Hu

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive Bayesian framework for hallucination detection that dynamically adjusts the number of LLM samples based on observed uncertainty, improving efficiency over fixed-budget semantic entropy approaches.

entry.title: EchoKV: Efficient KV Cache Compression via Similarity-Based Reconstruction

author.name: Yixuan Wang, Shiyu Ji, Yijun Liu, Qingfu Zhu, Wanxiang Che

entry.summary: Proposes EchoKV, a flexible KV cache compression scheme that enables on-demand switching between standard and compressed inference by reconstructing residual KV components using inter-layer and intra-layer similarities.

entry.title: The Evolution of Tool Use in LLM Agents: From Single-Tool Call to Multi-Tool Orchestration

author.name: Haoyuan Xu, Chang Li, Xinyan Ma, Xianhao Ou, Zihan Zhang, Tao He, Xiangyu Liu, Zixiang Wang, Jiafeng Liang, Zheng Chu, Runxuan Liu, Rongchuan Mu, Ming Liu, Bing Qin

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey reviewing the evolution of tool use in LLM agents from single-tool calls to multi-tool orchestration over long trajectories, analyzing formulations, architectures, safety, cost, and verifiability.

entry.title: Designing to Forget: Deep Semi-parametric Models for Unlearning

author.name: Amber Yijia Zheng, Yu-Shan Tai, Raymond A. Yeh

entry.summary: Introduces deep semi-parametric models (SPMs) designed for efficient machine unlearning, where a fusion module aggregates per-sample information enabling explicit test-time deletion without altering model parameters. Achieves competitive performance on ImageNet while being significantly more efficient for unlearning.

entry.title: Cog3DMap: Multi-View Vision-Language Reasoning with 3D Cognitive Maps

author.name: Chanyoung Gwak, Yoonwoo Jeong, Byungwoo Jeon, Hyunseok Lee, Jinwoo Shin, Minsu Cho

entry.summary: Introduces Cog3DMap, a framework that constructs explicit 3D cognitive maps from multi-view images where each token is grounded in 3D space with both semantic and geometric information, enabling better spatial reasoning in MLLMs.

entry.title: ViBe: Ultra-High-Resolution Video Synthesis Born from Pure Images

author.name: Yunfeng Wu, Hongying Cheng, Zihao He, Songhua Liu

entry.summary: Proposes ViBe, a pure image adaptation framework that upgrades video Diffusion Transformers to synthesize ultra-high-resolution videos using Relay LoRA for two-stage adaptation handling modality alignment and spatial extrapolation.

entry.title: One View Is Enough! Monocular Training for In-the-Wild Novel View Generation

author.name: Adrien Ramanana Rahary, Nicolas Dufour, Patrick Perez, David Picard

entry.summary: Presents OVIE for monocular novel-view synthesis trained entirely on unpaired internet images using monocular depth as geometric scaffold and masked training for disocclusions, trained on 30M images.

entry.title: Foveated Diffusion: Efficient Spatially Adaptive Image and Video Generation

author.name: Brian Chao, Lior Yariv, Howard Xiao, Gordon Wetzstein

entry.summary: Proposes Foveated Diffusion for spatially adaptive image and video generation that leverages human foveal vision characteristics, allocating more computation to gaze-centered regions and less to periphery.

entry.title: Session Risk Memory (SRM): Temporal Authorization for Deterministic Pre-Execution Safety Gates

author.name: Florin Adrian Chitan

entry.summary: Introduces Session Risk Memory (SRM), a lightweight module that extends stateless safety gates for AI agents with trajectory-level authorization by tracking behavioral profiles over sessions and accumulating risk signals. Addresses distributed attacks that decompose harmful intent across individually-compliant steps.

entry.title: ProGRank: Probe-Gradient Reranking to Defend Dense-Retriever RAG from Corpus Poisoning

author.name: Xiangyu Yin, Yi Qi, Chih-hong Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes ProGRank, a training-free retriever-side defense against corpus poisoning in dense-retriever RAG. Uses probe gradients from randomized perturbations to detect and rerank adversarial passages.

entry.title: Between Rules and Reality: On the Context Sensitivity of LLM Moral Judgment

author.name: Adrian Sauter, Mona Schirmer

entry.summary: Introduces Contextual MoralChoice dataset with systematic contextual variations (consequentialist, emotional, relational) to study LLM moral judgment sensitivity. Finds nearly all 22 evaluated LLMs are context-sensitive, but differently from humans.

entry.title: LLM Olympiad: Why Model Evaluation Needs a Sealed Exam

author.name: Jan Christian Blaise Cruz, Alham Fikri Aji

entry.summary: Argues for Olympiad-style sealed evaluation events for LLMs where problems are kept secret until evaluation, submissions frozen in advance, and all entries run through standardized harness. Addresses benchmark gaming and contamination.

entry.title: UniFluids: Unified Neural Operator Learning with Conditional Flow-matching

author.name: Haosen Li, Qi Meng, Jiahao Li, Rui Zhang, Ruihua Song, Liang Ma, Zhi-Ming Ma

entry.summary: Presents UniFluids, a conditional flow-matching framework using diffusion Transformer to unify PDE solution operator learning across diverse equations with varying dimensionality. First parallel sequence generation approach for unified operator learning.

entry.title: DAQ: Delta-Aware Quantization for Post-Training LLM Weight Compression

author.name: Xiaoming Yu, Shize Tang, Guanghua Yu, Linchuan Xie, Song Liu, Jianchen Zhu, Feng Li

entry.summary: Introduces Delta-Aware Quantization (DAQ), a data-free post-training quantization framework that preserves knowledge from post-training by optimizing for directional fidelity of weight deltas rather than reconstruction error. This addresses the problem of quantization noise disproportionately corrupting small-magnitude parameter deltas that encode post-training behavior.

entry.title: Reasoner-Executor-Synthesizer: Scalable Agentic Architecture with Static O(1) Context Window

author.name: Ivan Dobrovolskyi

entry.summary: Proposes the Reasoner-Executor-Synthesizer (RES) architecture for LLM agents that achieves O(1) token complexity by strictly separating intent parsing, deterministic data operations, and narrative generation. The Executor uses zero LLM tokens and passes only fixed-size statistical summaries.

entry.title: LLMON: An LLM-native Markup Language to Leverage Structure and Semantics at the LLM Interface

author.name: Michael Hind, Basel Shbita, Bo Wu, Farhan Ahmed, Chad DeLuca, Nathan Fulton, David Cox, Dan Gutfreund

entry.summary: Introduces LLMON (LLM Object Notation), a markup language for structuring LLM inputs/outputs that distinguishes instructions from data and conveys semantic metadata. Aims to reduce model confusion and prompt injection risks.

entry.title: Causal Discovery in Action: Learning Chain-Reaction Mechanisms from Interventions

author.name: Panayiotis Panayiotou, \"Ozg\"ur \c{S}im\c{s}ek

entry.summary: Studies causal discovery in chain-reaction systems where components activate sequentially, showing the causal structure is uniquely identifiable from blocking interventions. Provides finite-sample guarantees with exponential error decay and logarithmic sample complexity.

entry.title: Agent Audit: A Security Analysis System for LLM Agent Applications

author.name: Haiyue Zhang, Yi Nian, Yue Zhao

entry.summary: Presents Agent Audit, a security analysis system for LLM agent applications that analyzes Python agent code and deployment artifacts through dataflow analysis, credential detection, and MCP configuration checking.

entry.title: Confidence Calibration under Ambiguous Ground Truth

author.name: Linwei Tao, Haoyang Luo, Minjing Dong, Chang Xu

entry.summary: Shows that standard confidence calibration methods fail when ground-truth labels are ambiguous (annotators disagree). Demonstrates Temperature Scaling is biased toward underestimating annotator uncertainty, and proposes ambiguity-aware post-hoc calibrators.

entry.title: A Sobering Look at Tabular Data Generation via Probabilistic Circuits

author.name: Davide Scassola, Dylan Ponsford, Adri\'an Javaloy, Sebastiano Saccani, Luca Bortolussi, Henry Gouk, Antonio Vergari

entry.summary: Questions perceived progress in tabular data generation by highlighting evaluation limitations and showing that simple probabilistic circuits (hierarchical mixture models) match or beat SOTA diffusion models at a fraction of the cost.

entry.title: Code Review Agent Benchmark

author.name: Yuntong Zhang, Zhiyuan Pan, Imam Nur Bani Yusuf, Haifeng Ruan, Ridwan Shariffdeen, Abhik Roychoudhury

entry.summary: Introduces c-CRAB, a code review benchmark for AI agents evaluating pull request reviews. Addresses growing need for quality assurance as AI-generated code volumes increase.

entry.title: VTAM: Video-Tactile-Action Models for Complex Physical Interaction Beyond VLAs

author.name: Haoran Yuan, Weigang Yi, Zhenyu Zhang, Wendi Chen, Yuchen Mo, Jiashi Yin, Xinzhuo Li, Xiangyu Zeng, Chuan Wen, Cewu Lu, Katherine Driggs-Campbell, Ismini Lourentzou

entry.summary: Introduces VTAM, a Video-Tactile Action Model that adds tactile perception to video-based world models for robotics. Addresses the limitation that fine-grained force modulation is not reliably encoded in visual tokens alone.

entry.title: Failure of contextual invariance in gender inference with large language models

author.name: Sagar Kumar, Ariel Flint, Luca Maria Aiello, Andrea Baronchelli

entry.summary: Tests LLM gender inference stability under contextually equivalent task formulations. Finds that minimal, theoretically uninformative context causes large systematic shifts in model outputs, breaking contextual invariance.

entry.title: A Foundation Model for Instruction-Conditioned In-Context Time Series Tasks

author.name: Anish Saha, Konstantin Shmakov

entry.summary: Presents a foundation model for time-series tasks that uses explicit instruction-conditioned in-context learning with a quantile-regression T5 encoder-decoder. Uses structured tokenization to mark targets, covariates, and task-specific information.

entry.title: DAK-UCB: Diversity-Aware Prompt Routing for LLMs and Generative Models

author.name: Donya Jafari, Farzan Farnia

entry.summary: Introduces DAK-UCB, a contextual bandit algorithm for routing prompts to appropriate generative AI models that considers both fidelity and output diversity via kernel-based diversity scores.

entry.title: End-to-End Efficient RL for Linear Bellman Complete MDPs with Deterministic Transitions

author.name: Zakaria Mhammedi, Alexander Rakhlin, Nneka Okolo

entry.summary: Provides a computationally efficient algorithm for RL with linear Bellman completeness and deterministic transitions, achieving end-to-end efficiency for finite action spaces without strong oracle assumptions.

entry.title: mmFHE: mmWave Sensing with End-to-End Fully Homomorphic Encryption

author.name: Tanvir Ahmed, Yixuan Gao, Adnan Armouti, Rajalakshmi Nandakumar

entry.summary: Presents mmFHE, the first fully homomorphic encryption system for end-to-end mmWave radar sensing, executing signal processing and ML inference entirely on encrypted data with formal cryptographic guarantees.

entry.title: Improving LLM Predictions via Inter-Layer Structural Encoders

author.name: Tom Ulanovski (Tel Aviv University), Eyal Blyachman (Tel Aviv University), Maya Bechler-Speicher (Meta)

entry.summary: Introduces ILSE, a method to learn effective representations from all LLM internal layers using Cayley-Encoder, a geometric encoder based on expander Cayley graphs for inter-layer information propagation.

entry.title: A PAC-Bayesian approach to generalization for quantum models

author.name: Pablo Rodriguez-Grasa, Matthias C. Caro, Jens Eisert, Elies Gil-Fuster, Franz J. Schreiber, Carlos Bravo-Prieto

entry.summary: Derives first PAC-Bayesian generalization bounds for quantum ML models by analyzing layered quantum circuits, providing data-dependent, non-uniform bounds rather than worst-case capacity bounds.

entry.title: ARGENT: Adaptive Hierarchical Image-Text Representations

author.name: Chuong Huynh, Hossein Souri, Abhinav Kumar, Vitali Petsiuk, Deen Dayal Mohan, Suren Kumar

entry.summary: Proposes ARGENT, which embeds vision-language models in hyperbolic space to capture hierarchical structure of visual/linguistic concepts, solving the 'cone collapse' problem of prior hyperbolic VLMs with a new loss and evaluation framework.

entry.title: Knowledge Access Beats Model Size: Memory Augmented Routing for Persistent AI Agents

author.name: Xunzhuo Liu, Bowei He, Xue Liu, Andy Luo, Haichen Zhang, Huamin Chen

entry.summary: Proposes memory-augmented inference where a lightweight 8B model leverages retrieved conversational context to answer repetitive queries, recovering 69% of a 235B model's performance while reducing cost by 96%.

entry.title: CAM3R: Camera-Agnostic Model for 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Namitha Guruprasad, Abhay Yadav, Cheng Peng, Rama Chellappa

entry.summary: Presents CAM3R, a feed-forward model for 3D reconstruction from unposed images that handles wide-angle cameras (fisheye, panoramic) without prior calibration, using separate ray and depth estimation modules.

entry.title: GeoTikzBridge: Advancing Multimodal Code Generation for Geometric Perception and Reasoning

author.name: Jiayin Sun, Caixia Sun, Boyu Yang, Hailin Li, Xiao Chen, Yi Zhang, Errui Ding, Liang Li, Chao Deng, Junlan Feng

entry.summary: Proposes GeoTikzBridge framework that enhances geometric perception in MLLMs through TikZ-based code generation, building the largest image-to-TikZ dataset (2.5M pairs, 16× larger than existing) and achieving state-of-the-art results.

entry.title: Think 360{\deg}: Evaluating the Width-centric Reasoning Capability of MLLMs Beyond Depth

author.name: Mingrui Chen, Hexiong Yang, Haogeng Liu, Huaibo Huang, Ran He

entry.summary: Introduces Think 360°, a benchmark evaluating MLLM reasoning width (broad search, multi-constraint optimization) as complement to reasoning depth (sequential chains), testing models' ability to explore parallel reasoning paths.

entry.title: WorldMesh: Generating Navigable Multi-Room 3D Scenes via Mesh-Conditioned Image Diffusion

author.name: Manuel-Andreas Schneider, Angela Dai

entry.summary: Presents WorldMesh, a geometry-first approach to generating navigable multi-room 3D scenes via mesh-conditioned image diffusion. Decouples structure (mesh scaffold) from appearance synthesis for large-scale scene generation.

entry.title: MLLM-HWSI: A Multimodal Large Language Model for Hierarchical Whole Slide Image Understanding

author.name: Basit Alawode, Arif Mahmood, Muaz Khalifa Al-Radi, Shahad Albastaki, Asim Khan, Muhammad Bilal, Moshira Ali Abdalla, Mohammed Bennamoun, Sajid Javed

entry.summary: Introduces MLLM-HWSI, a hierarchical WSI-level multimodal LLM that aligns visual features with pathology language at four scales (cell→patch→region→WSI), analogous to word→phrase→sentence→paragraph for interpretable diagnostic reasoning.

entry.title: SIMART: Decomposing Monolithic Meshes into Sim-ready Articulated Assets via MLLM

author.name: Chuanrui Zhang, Minghan Qin, Yuang Wang, Baifeng Xie, Hang Li, Ziwei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SIMART, a unified MLLM framework that decomposes static meshes into sim-ready articulated assets via sparse voxel tokenization and joint part-level decomposition with kinematic prediction.

entry.title: GeoSANE: Learning Geospatial Representations from Models, Not Data

author.name: Joelle Hanna, Damian Falk, Stella X. Yu, Damian Borth

entry.summary: Introduces GeoSANE, a geospatial model foundry that learns unified neural representations from weights of existing foundation models and can generate novel network weights on demand for target architectures.

entry.title: RealMaster: Lifting Rendered Scenes into Photorealistic Video

author.name: Dana Cohen-Bar, Ido Sobol, Raphael Bensadoun, Shelly Sheynin, Oran Gafni, Or Patashnik, Daniel Cohen-Or, Amit Zohar

entry.summary: Presents RealMaster, a system for lifting rendered 3D engine scenes into photorealistic video, bridging the sim-to-real gap while preserving geometry and dynamics of the input.

entry.title: OccAny: Generalized Unconstrained Urban 3D Occupancy

author.name: Anh-Quan Cao, Tuan-Hung Vu

entry.summary: Presents OccAny, the first unconstrained urban 3D occupancy model that works on out-of-domain uncalibrated scenes for metric occupancy prediction with segmentation features, addressing scalability and generalization limitations.

entry.title: GIFT: Generalizing Intent for Flexible Test-Time Rewards

author.name: Fin Amin, Nathaniel Dennler, Andreea Bobu

entry.summary: GIFT uses language models to infer high-level human intent from demonstrations by contrasting preferred vs. non-preferred behaviors, then generates test-time reward functions grounded in intent rather than surface visual/semantic cues. Enables better reward generalization to new environments.

entry.title: Safe Recursive Self-Improvement with Verified Compilers

author.name: Adam Chlipala

entry.summary: Argues that formally verified compilers provide a concrete, practical setting for studying safe recursive self-improvement in AI. Compilers already undergo limited forms of self-improvement, and formal verification can establish safety properties that persist through the improvement process.

entry.title: Beyond Binary Correctness: Scaling Evaluation of Long-Horizon Agents on Subjective Enterprise Tasks

author.name: Abhishek Chandwani, Ishan Gupta

entry.summary: Introduces LH-Bench for evaluating autonomous agents on subjective, long-horizon enterprise tasks beyond binary correctness. Uses expert-grounded rubrics, curated ground-truth artifacts, and LLM-as-judge with weighted rubrics.

entry.title: Describe-Then-Act: Proactive Agent Steering via Distilled Language-Action World Models

author.name: Massimiliano Pappa, Luca Romani, Valentino Sacco, Alessio Palma, St\'ephane Lathuili\`ere, Fabio Galasso, Xavier Alameda-Pineda, Indro Spinelli

entry.summary: Introduces DILLO, a fast steering layer for safety-critical agents that predicts action outcomes from policy latent states without visual simulation, reducing world model inference from seconds to milliseconds. Shifts paradigm from 'simulate-then-act' to 'describe-then-act'.

entry.title: MemCollab: Cross-Agent Memory Collaboration via Contrastive Trajectory Distillation

author.name: Yurui Chang, Yiran Wu, Qingyun Wu, Lu Lin

entry.summary: Proposes MemCollab, a collaborative memory framework that enables memory sharing across heterogeneous LLM agents by contrasting reasoning trajectories to extract agent-agnostic task knowledge. Addresses the problem of agent-specific biases entangled in memory.

entry.title: Causal Direct Preference Optimization for Distributionally Robust Generative Recommendation

author.name: Chu Zhao, Enneng Yang, Jianzhe Zhao, Guibing Guo

entry.summary: Proposes CausalDPO, an extension of Direct Preference Optimization that incorporates causal invariance learning to mitigate spurious correlations amplified during alignment for LLM-based recommendation systems. Uses backdoor adjustment to improve OOD generalization.

entry.title: First-Mover Bias in Gradient Boosting Explanations: Mechanism, Detection, and Resolution

author.name: Drake Caraker, Bryan Arnold, David Rhoads

entry.summary: Isolates and characterizes 'first-mover bias' in gradient boosting—a path-dependent concentration of SHAP feature importance caused by sequential residual fitting under multicollinearity. Shows this creates self-reinforcing advantages for whichever feature is selected first.

entry.title: FAAR: Format-Aware Adaptive Rounding for NVFP4

author.name: Hanglin Li, Shuchang Tian, Chen Lin, Zhiyong Zhao, Kun Zhan

entry.summary: Proposes FAAR, a learnable rounding strategy tailored for the NVFP4 format that explicitly accounts for the non-uniform numerical grid. Targets ultra-low-bit quantization for deploying LLMs on edge devices.

entry.title: UniQueR: Unified Query-based Feedforward 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Chensheng Peng, Quentin Herau, Jiezhi Yang, Yichen Xie, Yihan Hu, Wenzhao Zheng, Matthew Strong, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Wei Zhan

entry.summary: Presents UniQueR, a unified query-based feedforward 3D reconstruction framework from unposed images that formulates reconstruction as sparse 3D query inference, enabling scene inference including occluded regions in a single forward pass.

entry.title: ForestPrune: High-ratio Visual Token Compression for Video Multimodal Large Language Models via Spatial-Temporal Forest Modeling

author.name: Shaobo Ju, Baiyang Song, Tao Chen, Jiapeng Zhang, Qiong Wu, Chao Chang, HuaiXi Wang, Yiyi Zhou, Rongrong Ji

entry.summary: Proposes ForestPrune, a training-free token pruning method for video MLLMs that constructs spatial-temporal token forests across frames for high-ratio compression. Achieves effective pruning by modeling temporal continuity.

entry.title: Assessing the Robustness of Climate Foundation Models under No-Analog Distribution Shifts

author.name: Maria Conchita Agana Navarro, Geng Li, Theo Wolf, Maria Perez-Ortiz

entry.summary: Assesses robustness of ML-based climate emulators under no-analog distribution shifts where future climate states fall outside training data. Addresses the critical question of whether these emulators can generalize to unprecedented conditions.

entry.title: Why AI-Generated Text Detection Fails: Evidence from Explainable AI Beyond Benchmark Accuracy

author.name: Shushanta Pudasaini, Luis Miralles-Pechu\'an, David Lillis, Marisa Llorens Salvador

entry.summary: Investigates whether AI-generated text detectors genuinely identify machine authorship or exploit dataset artifacts. Uses explainable AI to show detectors rely on spurious features, challenging reported benchmark accuracies.

entry.title: Model Predictive Control with Differentiable World Models for Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Rohan Deb, Stephen J. Wright, Arindam Banerjee

entry.summary: Introduces an MPC-inspired inference-time adaptation framework for offline RL that uses differentiable world models to optimize policy parameters on-the-fly during deployment.

entry.title: SkillRouter: Retrieve-and-Rerank Skill Selection for LLM Agents at Scale

author.name: YanZhao Zheng, ZhenTao Zhang, Chao Ma, YuanQiang Yu, JiHuan Zhu, Baohua Dong, Hangcheng Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes SkillRouter for retrieving and ranking relevant skills from large pools (tens of thousands) for LLM agents. Addresses the practical challenge that agent context windows cannot fit all available tools.

entry.title: VLGOR: Visual-Language Knowledge Guided Offline Reinforcement Learning for Generalizable Agents

author.name: Pengsen Liu, Maosen Zeng, Nan Tang, Kaiyuan Li, Jing-Cheng Pang, Yunan Liu, Yang Yu

entry.summary: Proposes VLGOR, combining vision-language models with offline RL to generate imaginary rollouts for unseen task generalization. Fine-tunes VLMs to predict future states conditioned on visual observations and language instructions.

entry.title: Weak-PDE-Net: Discovering Open-Form PDEs via Differentiable Symbolic Networks and Weak Formulation

author.name: Xinxin Li, Xingyu Cui, Jin Qi, Juan Zhang, Da Li, Junping Yin

entry.summary: Proposes Weak-PDE-Net for discovering PDEs from sparse noisy data using weak formulations combined with differentiable symbolic networks, avoiding numerical differentiation instabilities and fixed candidate libraries.

entry.title: SPDE Methods for Nonparametric Bayesian Posterior Contraction and Laplace Approximation

author.name: Enric Alberola-Boloix, Ioar Casado-Telletxea

entry.summary: Extends diffusion-based Bayesian framework to infinite dimensions using Langevin SPDEs, deriving posterior contraction rates and quantitative Laplace approximations in Hilbert spaces.

entry.title: Stepwise Variational Inference with Vine Copulas

author.name: Elisabeth Griesbauer, Leiv R{\o}nneberg, Arnoldo Frigessi, Claudia Czado, Ingrid Hob{\ae}k Haff

entry.summary: Proposes stepwise variational inference using vine copulas estimated tree-by-tree, showing that Rényi divergence is needed instead of standard KL, with a stopping criterion for adding trees.

entry.title: Generative Inversion of Spectroscopic Data for Amorphous Structure Elucidation

author.name: Jiawei Guo, Daniel Schwalbe-Koda

entry.summary: Introduces GLASS, a generative framework that inverts multi-modal spectroscopic measurements into realistic atomistic structures for amorphous materials using score-based models conditioned on differentiable spectral targets.

entry.title: Explanation Generation for Contradiction Reconciliation with LLMs

author.name: Jason Chan, Zhixue Zhao, Robert Gaizauskas

entry.summary: Introduces reconciliatory explanation generation as a new NLP task, where models must hypothesize explanations that make apparently contradictory statements compatible, rather than simply choosing which to accept or discard.

entry.title: TTQ: Activation-Aware Test-Time Quantization to Accelerate LLM Inference On The Fly

author.name: Toshiaki Koike-Akino, Jing Liu, Ye Wang

entry.summary: Proposes test-time quantization (TTQ) that compresses LLMs on-the-fly at inference time using efficient online calibration, addressing domain shift issues of static calibration-dependent compression methods.

entry.title: Unleashing Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models via Textual Representation Guided Reasoning

author.name: Jiacheng Hua, Yishu Yin, Yuhang Wu, Tai Wang, Yifei Huang, Miao Liu

entry.summary: Introduces TRACE, a prompting method that induces MLLMs to generate text-based representations of 3D environments from egocentric video as intermediate reasoning traces for spatial question answering, inspired by allocentric spatial reasoning theory.

entry.title: MAGICIAN: Efficient Long-Term Planning with Imagined Gaussians for Active Mapping

author.name: Shiyao Li, Antoine Gu\'edon, Shizhe Chen, Vincent Lepetit

entry.summary: Introduces MAGICIAN, a long-term planning framework for active mapping that uses Imagined Gaussians (from a pre-trained occupancy network) to efficiently compute surface coverage gain for any viewpoint via fast volumetric rendering.

entry.title: Predictive Photometric Uncertainty in Gaussian Splatting for Novel View Synthesis

author.name: Chamuditha Jayanga Galappaththige, Thomas Gottwald, Peter Stehr, Edgar Heinert, Niko Suenderhauf, Dimity Miller, Matthias Rottmann

entry.summary: Introduces a lightweight, plug-and-play framework for pixel-wise uncertainty estimation in Gaussian Splatting that formulates uncertainty as Bayesian-regularized linear least-squares optimization over reconstruction residuals.

entry.title: VLA-IAP: Training-Free Visual Token Pruning via Interaction Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Jintao Cheng, Haozhe Wang, Weibin Li, Gang Wang, Yipu Zhang, Xiaoyu Tang, Jin Wu, Xieyuanli Chen, Yunhui Liu, Wei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes VLA-IAP, a training-free visual token pruning method for Vision-Language-Action models that considers physical interaction relevance rather than just semantic saliency, preventing pruning of manipulation-critical regions.

entry.title: Gaze-Regularized Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Anupam Pani, Yanchao Yang

entry.summary: Introduces a gaze-regularized training framework for Vision-Language-Action models that aligns robot attention with human gaze patterns via KL divergence, improving manipulation success rates by 12.7% on average.

entry.title: DetPO: In-Context Learning with Multi-Modal LLMs for Few-Shot Object Detection

author.name: Gautam Rajendrakumar Gare, Neehar Peri, Matvei Popov, Shruti Jain, John Galeotti, Deva Ramanan

entry.summary: Proposes DetPO, using preference optimization to improve in-context learning for few-shot object detection with MLLMs. Addresses the finding that current MLLMs often perform worse with visual examples than class names alone.

entry.title: Learning Safe-Stoppability Monitors for Humanoid Robots

author.name: Yifan Sun, Yiyuan Pan, Shangtao Li, Caiwu Ding, Tao Cui, Lingyun Wang, Changliu Liu

entry.summary: Formalizes emergency stopping for humanoid robots as a policy-dependent safe-stoppability problem and introduces PRISM, a framework that learns a neural monitor predicting which states allow safe execution of a fallback controller. Addresses the fact that abruptly cutting power to humanoids can cause falls.

entry.title: SG-VLA: Learning Spatially-Grounded Vision-Language-Action Models for Mobile Manipulation

author.name: Ruisen Tu, Arth Shukla, Sohyun Yoo, Xuanlin Li, Junxi Li, Jianwen Xie, Hao Su, Zhuowen Tu

entry.summary: SG-VLA enhances Vision-Language-Action models for mobile manipulation by adding spatially-grounded perception through auxiliary task co-training and multi-modal inputs (multi-view RGB + depth). Controls a 13-DOF action space for coordinated base-arm-gripper operation.

entry.title: ABSTRAL: Automatic Design of Multi-Agent Systems Through Iterative Refinement and Topology Optimization

author.name: Weijia Song, Jiashu Yue, Zhe Pang

entry.summary: Introduces ABSTRAL, a framework that treats multi-agent system architecture as an evolving natural-language document refined through contrastive trace analysis. Measures 'multi-agent coordination tax' and demonstrates design knowledge transfer across domains.

entry.title: Dynamical Systems Theory Behind a Hierarchical Reasoning Model

author.name: Vasiliy A. Es'kin, Mikhail E. Smorkalov

entry.summary: Proposes the Contraction Mapping Model (CMM) that reformulates recursive reasoning into continuous Neural ODEs/SDEs with mathematical convergence guarantees. Addresses training instability in hierarchical reasoning models.

entry.title: Can Large Language Models Reason and Optimize Under Constraints?

author.name: Fabien Bernier, Salah Ghamizi, Pantelis Dogoulis, Maxime Cordy

entry.summary: Evaluates whether LLMs can reason under physical and operational constraints using Optimal Power Flow problems. Finds that even SoTA reasoning LLMs fail on the most complex constrained optimization settings.

entry.title: MedCausalX: Adaptive Causal Reasoning with Self-Reflection for Trustworthy Medical Vision-Language Models

author.name: Jianxin Lin, Chunzheng Zhu, Peter J. Kneuertz, Yunfei Bai, Yuan Xue

entry.summary: Proposes MedCausalX, an end-to-end framework for explicit causal reasoning in medical vision-language models. Introduces CRMed dataset and addresses adaptive causal correction triggering and causal-spurious contrastive sampling.

entry.title: RelayS2S: A Dual-Path Speculative Generation for Real-Time Dialogue

author.name: Long Mai

entry.summary: Presents RelayS2S, a hybrid speech dialogue architecture running parallel fast (S2S) and slow (ASR→LLM) paths. The fast path provides low-latency onset via speculative drafting while the slow path generates higher-quality completion that seamlessly replaces the prefix.

entry.title: Founder effects shape the evolutionary dynamics of multimodality in open LLM families

author.name: Manuel Cebrian

entry.summary: Analyzes the evolutionary dynamics of multimodality in open LLM families using 1.8M+ Hugging Face model entries. Finds founder effects shape how quickly multimodal capabilities propagate within model families, with vision-language dominating.

entry.title: Latent Semantic Manifolds in Large Language Models

author.name: Mohamed A. Mabrok

entry.summary: Develops a mathematical framework interpreting LLM hidden states as points on a latent semantic Riemannian manifold with Fisher information metric. Proves rate-distortion bounds on vocabulary discretization and volume scaling laws for the expressibility gap.

entry.title: Sample Transform Cost-Based Training-Free Hallucination Detector for Large Language Models

author.name: Zeyang Ding, Xinglin Hu, Jicong Fan

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free hallucination detector using optimal transport distances between token embeddings of LLM responses. Argues that distribution complexity indicates hallucination and uses Wasserstein distance matrices.

entry.title: Conformal Risk Control for Safety-Critical Wildfire Evacuation Mapping: A Comparative Study of Tabular, Spatial, and Graph-Based Models

author.name: Baljinnyam Dayan

entry.summary: First application of conformal risk control (CRC) to wildfire spread prediction, providing formal finite-sample guarantees on false negative rate (FNR ≤ 0.05) for evacuation planning. Tests across three model families and reveals that uncalibrated models can miss up to large fractions of fire spread.

entry.title: When Visuals Aren't the Problem: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Misleading Data Visualizations

author.name: Harsh Nishant Lalai, Raj Sanjay Shah, Hanspeter Pfister, Sashank Varma, Grace Guo

entry.summary: Evaluates VLMs on misleading data visualizations using a fine-grained taxonomy of reasoning errors and design errors. Finds that VLMs' failures stem more from reasoning-level errors (cherry-picking, causal inference) than visual perception failures.

entry.title: Vision-based Deep Learning Analysis of Unordered Biomedical Tabular Datasets via Optimal Spatial Cartography

author.name: Sakib Mostafa, Tarik Massoud, Maximilian Diehn, Lei Xing, Md Tauhidul Islam

entry.summary: Introduces Dynomap, an end-to-end framework that learns task-optimized spatial topology of tabular features to enable vision architectures to exploit local structure and feature interactions in non-spatial biomedical data.

entry.title: KARMA: Knowledge-Action Regularized Multimodal Alignment for Personalized Search at Taobao

author.name: Zhi Sun, Wenming Zhang, Yi Wei, Liren Yu, Zhixuan Zhang, Dan Ou, Haihong Tang

entry.summary: Introduces KARMA for personalized search at Taobao, addressing the 'Knowledge-Action Gap' when fine-tuning LLMs for personalization. Shows that action-only training causes semantic collapse and proposes knowledge-action regularization.

entry.title: Off-Policy Evaluation and Learning for Survival Outcomes under Censoring

author.name: Kohsuke Kubota, Mitsuhiro Takahashi, Yuta Saito

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for off-policy evaluation and learning with right-censored survival outcomes, introducing IPCW-IPS estimators that correct for systematic underestimation caused by censoring. Addresses a gap in causal inference for survival data.

entry.title: Emergence of Fragility in LLM-based Social Networks: the Case of Moltbook

author.name: Luca Sodano, Sofia Sciangula, Amulya Galmarini, Francesco Bertolotti

entry.summary: Analyzes the interaction network of Moltbook, a social platform of LLM-based agents, using network science tools. Finds strongly heterogeneous connectivity patterns suggesting structural fragility in AI agent social networks.

entry.title: 3DCity-LLM: Empowering Multi-modality Large Language Models for 3D City-scale Perception and Understanding

author.name: Yiping Chen, Jinpeng Li, Wenyu Ke, Yang Luo, Jie Ouyang, Zhongjie He, Li Liu, Hongchao Fan, Hao Wu

entry.summary: Proposes 3DCity-LLM, a framework for 3D city-scale vision-language understanding with coarse-to-fine feature encoding and a 1.2M sample dataset covering seven task categories from object analysis to scene planning.

entry.title: MIOFlow 2.0: A unified framework for inferring cellular stochastic dynamics from single cell and spatial transcriptomics data

author.name: Xingzhi Sun, Jo\~ao Felipe Rocha, Brett Phelan, Dhananjay Bhaskar, Guillaume Huguet, Yanlei Zhang, D. S. Magruder, Alexander Tong, Ke Xu, Oluwadamilola Fasina, Mark Gerstein, Guy Wolf, Natalia Ivanova, Christine L. Chaffer, Smita Krishnaswamy

entry.summary: MIOFlow 2.0 learns biologically informed cellular trajectories from single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data by integrating manifold learning, optimal transport, and stochastic dynamics. It captures probabilistic branching and population shifts that deterministic methods miss.

entry.title: Central Dogma Transformer III: Interpretable AI Across DNA, RNA, and Protein

author.name: Nobuyuki Ota

entry.summary: CDT-III extends mechanism-oriented AI across DNA, RNA, and protein, using a two-stage architecture mirroring cellular compartmentalization. Adding protein prediction improves RNA performance, showing cross-task regularization benefits.

entry.title: Similarity-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Data-Efficient Continual Learning

author.name: Connor Mclaughlin, Nigel Lee, Lili Su

entry.summary: Proposes a Mixture-of-Experts approach for continual learning that handles data-scarce, potentially overlapping tasks through similarity-aware expert routing and knowledge transfer.

entry.title: Overfitting and Generalizing with (PAC) Bayesian Prediction in Noisy Binary Classification

author.name: Xiaohan Zhu, Mesrob I. Ohannessian, Nathan Srebro

entry.summary: Studies PAC-Bayes learning rules for binary classification, showing that Bayesian prediction can overfit with non-vanishing excess loss, and identifies that tuning the balancing parameter below 1 enables consistency.

entry.title: REALITrees: Rashomon Ensemble Active Learning for Interpretable Trees

author.name: Simon D. Nguyen, Hayden McTavish, Kentaro Hoffman, Cynthia Rudin, Tyler H. McCormick

entry.summary: Proposes REALITrees, an active learning method that constructs query committees by enumerating the Rashomon set of near-optimal models, using PAC-Bayesian weighting for better epistemic uncertainty estimation.

entry.title: Reconstruction-Guided Slot Curriculum: Addressing Object Over-Fragmentation in Video Object-Centric Learning

author.name: WonJun Moon, Hyun Seok Seong, Jae-Pil Heo

entry.summary: Proposes SlotCurri, a reconstruction-guided curriculum for video object-centric learning that starts with few slots and progressively adds them where reconstruction error is high, preventing over-fragmentation.

entry.title: FixationFormer: Direct Utilization of Expert Gaze Trajectories for Chest X-Ray Classification

author.name: Daniel Beckmann, Benjamin Risse

entry.summary: Introduces FixationFormer, a transformer architecture that directly integrates expert eye movement trajectories for chest X-ray classification, naturally aligning gaze sequences with transformer attention.

entry.title: Conformal Cross-Modal Active Learning

author.name: Huy Hoang Nguyen, C\'edric Jung, Shirin Salehi, Tobias Gl\"uck, Anke Schmeink, Andreas Kugi

entry.summary: Introduces CCMA, a conformal prediction-based active learning framework bridging vision and language modalities through teacher-student architecture for data-efficient learning.

entry.title: Towards Automated Community Notes Generation with Large Vision Language Models for Combating Contextual Deception

author.name: Jin Ma, Jingwen Yan, Mohammed Aldeen, Ethan Anderson, Taran Kavuru, Jinkyung Katie Park, Feng Luo, Long Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes automated Community Notes generation using vision-language models to combat image-based contextual deception on social media, where authentic images are paired with misleading context. Addresses scalability limitations of human-driven fact-checking.

entry.title: Analysing LLM Persona Generation and Fairness Interpretation in Polarised Geopolitical Contexts

author.name: Maida Aizaz, Quang Minh Nguyen

entry.summary: Analyzes personas generated by 5 LLMs for Palestinian and Israeli identities across 640 conditions, finding significant biases: Palestinian profiles in war contexts get lower socioeconomic status while Israeli profiles retain professional attributes.

entry.title: TrajLoom: Dense Future Trajectory Generation from Video

author.name: Zewei Zhang, Jia Jun Cheng Xian, Kaiwen Liu, Ming Liang, Hang Chu, Jun Chen, Renjie Liao

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for predicting dense future point trajectories from video with Grid-Anchor Offset Encoding, a VAE for spatiotemporal latent space learning, and a flow model for future trajectory generation.

entry.title: Q-Tacit: Image Quality Assessment via Latent Visual Reasoning

author.name: Yuxuan Jiang, Yixuan Li, Hanwei Zhu, Siyue Teng, Fan Zhang, David Bull

entry.summary: Proposes Q-Tacit for image quality assessment that performs reasoning in latent visual space rather than text space, arguing that quality-related visual cues cannot be fully abstracted into text due to perception-text gap.

entry.title: MVPBench: A Multi-Video Perception Evaluation Benchmark for Multi-Modal Video Understanding

author.name: Purui Bai, Tao Wu, Jiayang Sun, Xinyue Liu, Huaibo Huang, Ran He

entry.summary: Introduces MVPBench, a multi-video perception benchmark with 14 subtasks and 5K QA tests designed to evaluate MLLMs on extracting and reasoning across multiple video sequences, going beyond single-video evaluation.

entry.title: Know3D: Prompting 3D Generation with Knowledge from Vision-Language Models

author.name: Wenyue Chen, Wenjue Chen, Peng Li, Qinghe Wang, Xu Jia, Heliang Zheng, Rongfei Jia, Yuan Liu, Ronggang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Know3D, which injects knowledge from multimodal LLMs into 3D generative processes via latent hidden-state injection, enabling language-controllable generation of unseen back-views for 3D assets.

entry.title: SLARM: Streaming and Language-Aligned Reconstruction Model for Dynamic Scenes

author.name: Zhicheng Qiu, Jiarui Meng, Tong-an Luo, Yican Huang, Xuan Feng, Xuanfu Li, ZHan Xu

entry.summary: Proposes SLARM, a feed-forward model unifying dynamic scene reconstruction, semantic understanding, and real-time streaming inference. Distills semantic features from LSeg for language-aligned representations with window-based causal attention for streaming.

entry.title: Cluster-Wise Spatio-Temporal Masking for Efficient Video-Language Pretraining

author.name: Weijun Zhuang, Yuqing Huang, Weikang Meng, Xin Li, Ming Liu, Xiaopeng Hong, Yaowei Wang, Wangmeng Zuo

entry.summary: Proposes ClusterSTM, a cluster-wise spatio-temporal masking strategy for efficient video-language pretraining that addresses visual information loss under high masking ratios and temporal information leakage from inter-frame correlations.

entry.title: Object Pose Transformer: Unifying Unseen Object Pose Estimation

author.name: Weihang Li, Lorenzo Garattoni, Fabien Despinoy, Nassir Navab, Benjamin Busam

entry.summary: Proposes Object Pose Transformer (OPT), unifying category-level absolute pose estimation and unseen-object relative pose estimation into a single feed-forward framework through task factorization.

entry.title: I3DM: Implicit 3D-aware Memory Retrieval and Injection for Consistent Video Scene Generation

author.name: Jia Li, Han Yan, Yihang Chen, Siqi Li, Xibin Song, Yifu Wang, Jianfei Cai, Tien-Tsin Wong, Pan Ji

entry.summary: Proposes I3DM, an implicit 3D-aware memory mechanism for consistent video scene generation that bypasses explicit 3D reconstruction by leveraging intermediate features of a feed-forward novel view synthesis model.

entry.title: Hebbian Attractor Networks for Robot Locomotion

author.name: Alexander Dittrich, Fuda van Diggelen, Dario Floreano

entry.summary: Introduces Hebbian Attractor Networks (HAN), plastic neural networks using dual-timescale Hebbian plasticity and temporal averaging to create emergent attractor dynamics for robot locomotion. Demonstrates rapid adaptation in simulated locomotion benchmarks. From Dario Floreano's lab at EPFL.

entry.title: Efficient Hybrid SE(3)-Equivariant Visuomotor Flow Policy via Spherical Harmonics for Robot Manipulation

author.name: Qinglun Zhang, Shen Cheng, Tian Dan, Haoqiang Fan, Guanghui Liu, Shuaicheng Liu

entry.summary: E3Flow proposes an SE(3)-equivariant visuomotor policy using spherical harmonic representations and rectified flow, with a novel invariant Feature Enhancement Module that fuses point clouds and images. First to unify efficient rectified flow with stable multi-modal equivariant learning.

entry.title: Comparing Across Possible Worlds

author.name: unruly abstractions

entry.summary: Fourth entry in a series exploring circuit faithfulness in mechanistic interpretability. Examines counterfactual faithfulness — whether subcircuit explanations correctly predict model behavior under counterfactual interventions (activation patching). Tests recovery and suppression criteria.

entry.title: Empirical Comparison of Agent Communication Protocols for Task Orchestration

author.name: Ivan Dobrovolskyi

entry.summary: Provides the first empirical comparison of agent communication protocols — tool integration vs. inter-agent delegation vs. hybrid — across standardized queries at three complexity levels.

entry.title: Learning When to Act: Interval-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Predictive Temporal Structure

author.name: Davide Di Gioia

entry.summary: Introduces an adaptive temporal control system for RL agents that learns optimal action intervals using a hyperbolic geometry-based 'curvature signal' to assess future uncertainty. Agents act sooner when futures are uncertain and rest longer when predictable.

entry.title: RadTimeline: Timeline Summarization for Longitudinal Radiological Lung Findings

author.name: Sitong Zhou, Meliha Yetisgen, Mari Ostendorf

entry.summary: Introduces RadTimeline, a structured summarization task that frames longitudinal radiology report summarization as timeline generation, with findings organized in a tabular format enabling temporal comparison and fact-checking.

entry.title: Poking and Editing the Circuits

author.name: unruly abstractions

entry.summary: Third entry in a series on circuit interpretability, exploring interventional faithfulness. Tests whether subcircuit explanations correctly predict model behavior under interventions (edits to network internals), building toward criteria for evaluating mechanistic interpretations.

entry.title: CATNAV: Cached Vision-Language Traversability for Efficient Zero-Shot Robot Navigation

author.name: Aditya Potnis, Francisco Affonso, Shreya Gummadi, Naveen Kumar Uppalapati, Girish Chowdhary

entry.summary: CATNAV enables zero-shot robot navigation using multimodal LLMs for embodiment-aware costmap generation. A visuosemantic caching mechanism reduces VLM queries by 85.7% by reusing risk assessments for semantically similar frames.

entry.title: The Efficiency Attenuation Phenomenon: A Computational Challenge to the Language of Thought Hypothesis

author.name: Di Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces the 'AI Private Language' thought experiment using multi-agent RL, demonstrating that agents with emergent communication protocols achieve 50.5% higher efficiency than those using human-like symbolic protocols. This 'Efficiency Attenuation Phenomenon' challenges the Language of Thought hypothesis from cognitive science.

entry.title: MuQ-Eval: An Open-Source Per-Sample Quality Metric for AI Music Generation Evaluation

author.name: Di Zhu, Zixuan Li

entry.summary: Introduces MUQ-EVAL, an open-source per-sample quality metric for AI-generated music that achieves 0.957 system-level correlation with human ratings. Built on frozen MuQ features with lightweight prediction heads, filling the gap left by closed-source alternatives.

entry.title: Learning What Matters Now: Dynamic Preference Inference under Contextual Shifts

author.name: Xianwei Cao, Dou Quan, Zhenliang Zhang, Shuang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Dynamic Preference Inference (DPI) for sequential decision-making when user preference weights are unobserved and shift with context. Uses variational posterior belief maintenance over preferences, inspired by cognitive science.

entry.title: Continuous Optimization for Satisfiability Modulo Theories on Linear Real Arithmetic

author.name: Yunuo Cen, Daniel Ebler, Xuanyao Fong

entry.summary: Introduces FourierSMT, a parallelizable continuous optimization framework for SMT solving on linear real arithmetic. Generalizes Walsh-Fourier expansion to mixed Boolean-real domains enabling gradient-based solving.

entry.title: Optimizing Small Language Models for NL2SQL via Chain-of-Thought Fine-Tuning

author.name: Anshul Solanki, Sanchit Latawa, Koushik Chakraborty, Navneet Kamboj

entry.summary: Finds that fine-tuning large models on NL2SQL yields negligible returns while small models (Qwen) show significant gains. Chain-of-thought fine-tuning improved small model performance from 36% to 45%, further to 51% with enriched training data.

entry.title: PERMA: Benchmarking Personalized Memory Agents via Event-Driven Preference and Realistic Task Environments

author.name: Shuochen Liu, Junyi Zhu, Long Shu, Junda Lin, Yuhao Chen, Haotian Zhang, Chao Zhang, Derong Xu, Jia Li, Bo Tang, Zhiyu Li, Feiyu Xiong, Enhong Chen, Tong Xu

entry.summary: Introduces PERMA benchmark for evaluating personalized memory agents, focusing on how preferences emerge gradually across interactions rather than static preference recall. Incorporates text variability and linguistic alignment challenges.

entry.title: Efficient Embedding-based Synthetic Data Generation for Complex Reasoning Tasks

author.name: Srideepika Jayaraman, Achille Fokoue, Dhaval Patel, Jayant Kalagnanam

entry.summary: Proposes embedding-based targeted sampling for synthetic data generation, showing strong correlation between example density in embedding neighborhoods and prediction accuracy. Pipeline enhances diversity and consistently improves reasoning task performance.

entry.title: AEGIS: An Operational Infrastructure for Post-Market Governance of Adaptive Medical AI Under US and EU Regulations

author.name: Fardin Afdideh, Mehdi Astaraki, Fernando Seoane, Farhad Abtahi

entry.summary: Presents AEGIS, a governance framework for post-market management of adaptive medical AI under FDA and EU regulations. Implements PCCP and EU AI Act provisions with four-category deployment decisions.

entry.title: Rethinking Multimodal Fusion for Time Series: Auxiliary Modalities Need Constrained Fusion

author.name: Seunghan Lee, Jun Seo, Jaehoon Lee, Sungdong Yoo, Minjae Kim, Tae Yoon Lim, Dongwan Kang, Hwanil Choi, SoonYoung Lee, Wonbin Ahn

entry.summary: Shows that multimodal fusion with naive strategies (addition, concatenation) often hurts time series forecasting performance compared to unimodal models due to uncontrolled integration of auxiliary modalities. Proposes constrained fusion methods that consistently outperform naive approaches.

entry.title: Instruction-Tuned, but Not More Verifiable Instruction-Following: A Cross-Task Diagnosis for LoRA Adapters

author.name: Junyi Zou

entry.summary: Tests whether nominal training labels (e.g., 'instruction-tuned') reliably predict cross-task capability gains for LoRA adapters. Finds that instruction-tuning labels often fail to predict improvements on verifiable instruction following tasks.

entry.title: Color When It Counts: Grayscale-Guided Online Triggering for Always-On Streaming Video Sensing

author.name: Weitong Cai, Hang Zhang, Yukai Huang, Shitong Sun, Jiankang Deng, Songcen Xu, Jifei Song, Zhensong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ColorTrigger, a grayscale-always/color-on-demand paradigm for edge video sensing that selectively activates RGB capture based on windowed grayscale affinity analysis. Discovers that sparse RGB frames suffice when temporal structure is preserved via continuous grayscale.

entry.title: Learning to Trust: How Humans Mentally Recalibrate AI Confidence Signals

author.name: ZhaoBin Li, Mark Steyvers

entry.summary: Investigates whether humans can learn to mentally recalibrate AI confidence signals through experience, including overconfident, underconfident, and reverse-confidence conditions. Finds robust learning across all conditions with significant improvement over 50 trials (N=200).

entry.title: Generalizing Dynamics Modeling More Easily from Representation Perspective

author.name: Yiming Wang, Zhengnan Zhang, Genghe Zhang, Jiawen Dan, Changchun Li, Chenlong Hu, Chris Nugent, Jun Liu, Ximing Li, Bo Yang

entry.summary: Proposes PDEDER, a pre-trained dynamics encoder that generalizes across different complex systems by embedding state observations into a latent space, rather than training separate models per system. Aims for transferable dynamics modeling.

entry.title: PhotoAgent: A Robotic Photographer with Spatial and Aesthetic Understanding

author.name: Lirong Che, Zhenfeng Gan, Yanbo Chen, Junbo Tan, Xueqian Wang

entry.summary: Introduces PhotoAgent, a robotic photographer that translates aesthetic goals into geometric constraints via LMM reasoning, then refines viewpoints through visual reflection in a 3DGS-based internal world model, replacing physical trial-and-error.

entry.title: Focus, Don't Prune: Identifying Instruction-Relevant Regions for Information-Rich Image Understanding

author.name: Mincheol Kwon, Minseung Lee, Seonga Choi, Miso Choi, Kyeong-Jin Oh, Hyunyoung Lee, Cheonyoung Park, Yongho Song, Seunghyun Park, Jinkyu Kim

entry.summary: Proposes PinPoint, a two-stage framework for VLMs that identifies instruction-relevant image regions then refines them for fine-grained feature extraction, reducing computational overhead for visually complex documents like infographics.

entry.title: Neural ODE and SDE Models for Adaptation and Planning in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Chao Han, Stefanos Ioannou, Luca Manneschi, T. J. Hayward, Michael Mangan, Aditya Gilra, Eleni Vasilaki

entry.summary: Investigates neural ODEs and SDEs as world models for model-based RL, showing SDEs better capture stochastic dynamics. Introduces latent SDE model for partially observable environments with policy adaptation via inverse models.

entry.title: Curriculum-Driven 3D CT Report Generation via Language-Free Visual Grafting and Zone-Constrained Compression

author.name: V. K. Cody Bumgardner, Mitchell A. Klusty, Mahmut S. Gokmen, Evan W. Damron

entry.summary: Presents Ker-VLJEPA-3B, a four-phase curriculum learning framework for generating radiology reports from 3D CT volumes. Uses a self-supervised visual backbone trained without text supervision to avoid linguistic prior bias.

entry.title: Evaluating LLM-Based Test Generation Under Software Evolution

author.name: Sabaat Haroon, Mohammad Taha Khan, Muhammad Ali Gulzar

entry.summary: Large-scale empirical study of LLM-based test generation under program evolution, analyzing how generated tests respond to semantic-altering vs semantic-preserving changes across multiple LLMs.

entry.title: Multimodal Training to Unimodal Deployment: Leveraging Unstructured Data During Training to Optimize Structured Data Only Deployment

author.name: Zigui Wang, Minghui Sun, Jiang Shu, Matthew M. Engelhard, Lauren Franz, Benjamin A. Goldstein

entry.summary: Introduces a multimodal learning framework that uses unstructured EHR data (clinical notes) during training but deploys using only structured data. Uses a teacher-student approach with BioClinicalBERT note embeddings to improve predictions for late-talking children evaluation.

entry.title: Towards The Implicit Bias on Multiclass Separable Data Under Norm Constraints

author.name: Shengping Xie, Zekun Wu, Quan Chen, Kaixu Tang

entry.summary: Investigates implicit bias in multiclass settings using Normalized Steepest Descent, introducing NucGD optimizer for enforcing low-rank structures via nuclear norm constraints with an SVD-free update rule.

entry.title: SpecXMaster Technical Report

author.name: Yutang Ge, Yaning Cui, Hanzheng Li, Jun-Jie Wang, Fanjie Xu, Jinhan Dong, Yongqi Jin, Dongxu Cui, Peng Jin, Guojiang Zhao, Hengxing Cai, Rong Zhu, Linfeng Zhang, Xiaohong Ji, Zhifeng Gao

entry.summary: Introduces SpecXMaster, an agentic RL framework for automated NMR spectral interpretation, extracting multiplicity information from raw FID data end-to-end.

entry.title: GEM: Guided Expectation-Maximization for Behavior-Normalized Candidate Action Selection in Offline RL

author.name: Haoyu Wang, Jingcheng Wang, Shunyu Wu, Xinwei Xiao

entry.summary: Introduces GEM for offline RL that uses Gaussian Mixture Model actors with critic-guided advantage-weighted EM updates to handle multimodal action landscapes while maintaining distinct action components.

entry.title: Combinatorial Privacy: Private Multi-Party Bitstream Grand Sum by Hiding in Birkhoff Polytopes

author.name: Praneeth Vepakomma

entry.summary: Introduces PolyVeil, a protocol for private Boolean summation that encodes bits as permutation matrices in Birkhoff polytopes, providing simulation-based security for servers and #P-hard inference for aggregators.

entry.title: Dual-Teacher Distillation with Subnetwork Rectification for Black-Box Domain Adaptation

author.name: Zhe Zhang, Jing Li, Wanli Xue, Xu Cheng, Jianhua Zhang, Qinghua Hu, Shengyong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes dual-teacher distillation with subnetwork rectification for black-box domain adaptation where neither source data nor model is accessible, combining pseudo-label refinement with vision-language model priors.

entry.title: HGNet: Scalable Foundation Model for Automated Knowledge Graph Generation from Scientific Literature

author.name: Devvrat Joshi, Islem Rekik

entry.summary: Proposes HGNet for automated knowledge graph construction from scientific literature with hierarchical extraction, zero-shot generalization, and Orthogonal Semantic Decomposition for long multi-word entities.

entry.title: PhysSkin: Real-Time and Generalizable Physics-Based Animation via Self-Supervised Neural Skinning

author.name: Yuanhang Lei, Tao Cheng, Xingxuan Li, Boming Zhao, Siyuan Huang, Ruizhen Hu, Peter Yichen Chen, Hujun Bao, Zhaopeng Cui

entry.summary: Introduces PhysSkin for real-time physics-based animation using learned continuous skinning fields as basis functions, with a transformer-based autoencoder that generalizes across diverse 3D shapes.

entry.title: Between Resolution Collapse and Variance Inflation: Weighted Conformal Anomaly Detection in Low-Data Regimes

author.name: Oliver Hennh\"ofer, Christine Preisach

entry.summary: Analyzes the trade-off between resolution and variance in weighted conformal anomaly detection for non-stationary data, proposing a continuous inference relaxation to balance these competing objectives.

entry.title: Less is More: Adapting Text Embeddings for Low-Resource Languages with Small Scale Noisy Synthetic Data

author.name: Zaruhi Navasardyan, Spartak Bughdaryan, Bagrat Minasyan, Hrant Davtyan

entry.summary: Demonstrates that small-scale noisy synthetic data from machine translation can effectively adapt text embedding models for Armenian, a low-resource language. Challenges the assumption that massive clean datasets are needed for semantic alignment.

entry.title: Synthetic or Authentic? Building Mental Patient Simulators from Longitudinal Evidence

author.name: Baihan Li, Bingrui Jin, Kunyao Lan, Ming Wang, Mengyue Wu

entry.summary: Proposes DEPROFILE, a patient simulation framework for mental health that constructs multi-source patient profiles from real longitudinal data, using a Chain-of-Change agent to create temporally grounded memory representations for more coherent simulation.

entry.title: Who Spoke What When? Evaluating Spoken Language Models for Conversational ASR with Semantic and Overlap-Aware Metrics

author.name: Naohiro Tawara, Samuele Cornell, Alexander Polok, Marc Delcroix, Luk\'a\v{s} Burget, Shinji Watanabe

entry.summary: Systematically compares LLM-based and modular pipeline approaches for conversational ASR along four axes, introducing tcpSemER metric for semantic fidelity and decomposing error by overlap/non-overlap regions.

entry.title: Beyond Hate: Differentiating Uncivil and Intolerant Speech in Multimodal Content Moderation

author.name: Nils A. Herrmann, Tobias Eder, Jingyi He, Georg Groh

entry.summary: Introduces a fine-grained annotation scheme that separates incivility (tone) from intolerance (content targeting groups) for meme moderation, applying it to 2,030 memes and evaluating vision-language models on this distinction.

entry.title: Beyond Theoretical Bounds: Empirical Privacy Loss Calibration for Text Rewriting Under Local Differential Privacy

author.name: Weijun Li, Arnaud Grivet S\'ebert, Qiongkai Xu, Annabelle McIver, Mark Dras

entry.summary: Proposes TeDA for empirically calibrating privacy loss across text rewriting mechanisms under Local Differential Privacy, using a hypothesis-testing framework to enable meaningful cross-mechanism comparison.

entry.title: OsteoFlow: Lyapunov-Guided Flow Distillation for Predicting Bone Remodeling after Mandibular Reconstruction

author.name: Hamidreza Aftabi, Faye Yu, Brooke Switzer, Zachary Fishman, Eitan Prisman, Antony Hodgson, Cari Whyne, Sidney Fels, Michael Hardisty

entry.summary: Introduces OsteoFlow, a flow-based framework predicting Year-1 post-operative CT scans from Day-5 scans after mandibular reconstruction, using Lyapunov-guided trajectory distillation for anatomical consistency.

entry.title: Sketch2CT: Multimodal Diffusion for Structure-Aware 3D Medical Volume Generation

author.name: Delin An, Chaoli Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Sketch2CT, a multimodal diffusion framework for generating 3D medical volumes guided by 2D sketches and text descriptions, first generating segmentation masks then synthesizing volumes with anatomical consistency.

entry.title: FullCircle: Effortless 3D Reconstruction from Casual 360$^\circ$ Captures

author.name: Yalda Foroutan, Ipek Oztas, Daniel Rebain, Aysegul Dundar, Kwang Moo Yi, Lily Goli, Andrea Tagliasacchi

entry.summary: Proposes a practical pipeline for 3D scene reconstruction from raw 360° camera captures, eliminating special protocols and pre-processing steps that typically undermine the ease of radiance field workflows.

entry.title: PIVM: Diffusion-Based Prior-Integrated Variation Modeling for Anatomically Precise Abdominal CT Synthesis

author.name: Dinglun He, Baoming Zhang, Xu Wang, Yao Hao, Deshan Yang, Ye Duan

entry.summary: Presents PIVM, a diffusion-based framework for anatomically accurate abdominal CT synthesis that predicts voxel-wise intensity variations relative to organ-specific priors, operating directly in image space to preserve HU range.

entry.title: Pretext Matters: An Empirical Study of SSL Methods in Medical Imaging

author.name: Vedrana Ivezi\'c, Mara Pleasure, Ashwath Radhachandran, Saarang Panchavati, Shreeram Athreya, Vivek Sant, Benjamin Emert, Gregory Fishbein, Corey Arnold, William Speier

entry.summary: Empirically investigates how the choice of self-supervised learning pretext task (JEA vs JEPA vs reconstruction) impacts learned representations in medical imaging, focusing on alignment with spatial organization of clinical signal.

entry.title: TimeWeaver: Age-Consistent Reference-Based Face Restoration with Identity Preservation

author.name: Teer Song, Yue Zhang, Yu Tian, Ziyang Wang, Xianlin Zhang, Guixuan Zhang, Xuan Liu, Xueming Li, Yasen Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes TimeWeaver, the first reference-based face restoration framework supporting cross-age references, decoupling identity and age information to produce restorations with both identity fidelity and age consistency.

entry.title: Cross-Slice Knowledge Transfer via Masked Multi-Modal Heterogeneous Graph Contrastive Learning for Spatial Gene Expression Inference

author.name: Zhiceng Shi, Changmiao Wang, Jun Wan, Wenwen Min

entry.summary: Proposes SpaHGC, a multi-modal heterogeneous graph model for predicting spatial transcriptomics from pathology images, capturing both intra-slice and inter-slice relationships using pathology foundation model embeddings.

entry.title: Gau-Occ: Geometry-Completed Gaussians for Multi-Modal 3D Occupancy Prediction

author.name: Chengxin Lv, Yihui Li, Hongyu Yang, YunHong Wang

entry.summary: Presents Gau-Occ, a multi-modal 3D occupancy prediction framework for autonomous driving that models scenes as semantic 3D Gaussians rather than dense voxels. Uses a LiDAR Completion Diffuser to recover missing structures and Gaussian Anchor Fusion for multi-view integration.

entry.title: Group Editing : Edit Multiple Images in One Go

author.name: Yue Ma, Xinyu Wang, Qianli Ma, Qinghe Wang, Mingzhe Zheng, Xiangpeng Yang, Hao Li, Chongbo Zhao, Jixuan Ying, Harry Yang, Hongyu Liu, Qifeng Chen

entry.summary: Proposes GroupEditing, a framework for performing consistent edits across a set of related images that vary in pose, viewpoint, and layout. Builds both explicit geometric correspondences (via VGGT) and implicit relationships through pseudo-video reformulation.

entry.title: Generative Event Pretraining with Foundation Model Alignment

author.name: Jianwen Cao, Jiaxu Xing, Nico Messikommer, Davide Scaramuzza

entry.summary: Proposes GEP (Generative Event Pretraining), a two-stage framework that transfers knowledge from image foundation models to event camera data while learning event-specific temporal dynamics through generative pretraining.

entry.title: VoDaSuRe: A Large-Scale Dataset Revealing Domain Shift in Volumetric Super-Resolution

author.name: August Leander H{\o}eg, Sophia Wiinberg Bardenfleth, Hans Martin Kjer, Tim Bj{\o}rn Dyrby, Vedrana Andersen Dahl, Anders Bjorholm Dahl

entry.summary: Introduces VoDaSuRe, a large-scale volumetric dataset with paired high- and low-resolution scans, revealing that SR models trained on downsampled data perform much better than those trained on real low-resolution data, exposing a significant domain shift.

entry.title: Multi-Modal Image Fusion via Intervention-Stable Feature Learning

author.name: Xue Wang, Zheng Guan, Wenhua Qian, Chengchao Wang, Runzhuo Ma

entry.summary: Proposes an intervention-based framework for multi-modal image fusion inspired by causal principles, using complementary masking, random masking, and modality-swapping interventions to learn robust cross-modal dependencies.

entry.title: TETO: Tracking Events with Teacher Observation for Motion Estimation and Frame Interpolation

author.name: Jini Yang, Eunbeen Hong, Soowon Son, Hyunkoo Lee, Sunghwan Hong, Sunok Kim, Seungryong Kim

entry.summary: Proposes TETO, a teacher-student framework learning event camera motion estimation from only ~25 minutes of unannotated real-world data via knowledge distillation from an RGB tracker, avoiding synthetic data sim-to-real gap.

entry.title: AgentRVOS: Reasoning over Object Tracks for Zero-Shot Referring Video Object Segmentation

author.name: Woojeong Jin, Jaeho Lee, Heeseong Shin, Seungho Jang, Junhwan Heo, Seungryong Kim

entry.summary: Proposes AgentRVOS, a training-free agentic pipeline for referring video object segmentation that builds on SAM3 and MLLM, performing temporal reasoning after obtaining object-level evidence rather than before.

entry.title: WildWorld: A Large-Scale Dataset for Dynamic World Modeling with Actions and Explicit State toward Generative ARPG

author.name: Zhen Li, Zian Meng, Shuwei Shi, Wenshuo Peng, Yuwei Wu, Bo Zheng, Chuanhao Li, Kaipeng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces WildWorld, a large-scale action-conditioned dataset from ARPGs with explicit state information for training world models, addressing the lack of structured action-state relationships in existing datasets.

entry.title: DA-Flow: Degradation-Aware Optical Flow Estimation with Diffusion Models

author.name: Jaewon Min, Jaeeun Lee, Yeji Choi, Paul Hyunbin Cho, Jin Hyeon Kim, Tae-Young Lee, Jongsik Ahn, Hwayeong Lee, Seonghyun Park, Seungryong Kim

entry.summary: Proposes DA-Flow for degradation-aware optical flow estimation using diffusion model features with spatio-temporal attention, showing that restoration diffusion model features have inherent corruption awareness.

entry.title: Rectify, Don't Regret: Avoiding Pitfalls of Differentiable Simulation in Trajectory Prediction

author.name: Harsh Yadav, Christian Bohn, Tobias Meisen

entry.summary: Identifies a critical flaw in differentiable closed-loop simulators for trajectory prediction: shortcut learning where loss gradients leak future ground truth. Proposes a detached receding horizon rollout that severs the computation graph to prevent non-causal exploitation.

entry.title: Gaussian mixtures and non-parametric likelihoods through the lens of statistical mechanics

author.name: Subhroshekhar Ghosh, Adityanand Guntuboyina, Satyaki Mukherjee, Hoang-Son Tran

entry.summary: Establishes stability guarantees for nonparametric maximum likelihood estimation (NPMLE) of Gaussian mixture models using statistical mechanics tools. Provides KL divergence upper bounds between NPMLE estimators and true density, advancing beyond prior state of the art.

entry.title: Agents Can Get Stuck in Self-distrusting Equilibria

author.name: Ashe Vazquez Nuñez

entry.summary: Formalizes how temporal instances of an embedded agent can enter conflict through self-distrust, modeled as intrapersonal cooperative games. Defines time-version Nash equilibria and shows stable self-punishing patterns. Conjectures that identity/consistency serves as a replacement for common knowledge of rationality. From MATS 9.0 under Richard Ngo.

entry.title: SMSP: A Plug-and-Play Strategy of Multi-Scale Perception for MLLMs to Perceive Visual Illusions

author.name: Jinzhe Tu, Ruilei Guo, Zihan Guo, Junxiao Yang, Shiyao Cui, Minlie Huang

entry.summary: Introduces SMSP, a plug-and-play multi-scale perception strategy that helps MLLMs perceive hidden-pattern visual illusions by addressing high-frequency attention bias. Also introduces IlluChar benchmark dataset.

entry.title: Learning Actuator-Aware Spectral Submanifolds for Precise Control of Continuum Robots

author.name: Paul Leonard Wolff, Hugo Buurmeijer, Luis Pabon, John Irvin Alora, Mark Leone, Roshan S. Kaundinya, Amirhossein Kazemipour, Robert K. Katzschmann, Marco Pavone

entry.summary: Introduces control-augmented Spectral Submanifold (caSSM) models for continuum robots that capture nonlinear state-input couplings. Learns compact models from controlled decay trajectories, eliminating the need for separate actuation calibration. From Pavone (Stanford) and Katzschmann (ETH) labs.

entry.title: DiSCo: Diffusion Sequence Copilots for Shared Autonomy

author.name: Andy Wang, Xu Yan, Brandon McMahan, Michael Zhou, Yuyang Yuan, Johannes Y. Lee, Ali Shreif, Matthew Li, Zhenghao Peng, Bolei Zhou, Yuchen Cui, Jonathan C. Kao

entry.summary: DiSCo uses diffusion policy for shared autonomy, planning action sequences consistent with past user actions. Seeds and inpaints the diffusion process with user-provided actions, balancing conformity to expert behavior with alignment to user intent.

entry.title: We cannot safely automate value alignment evaluation and research without thinking about delegation and discretion

author.name: Maria Federica Martino Lena
