entry.title: Trajectory Generation for Underactuated Soft Robot Manipulators using Discrete Elastic Rod Dynamics

author.name: Beibei Liu, Akua K. Dickson, Ran Jing, Andrew P. Sabelhaus

entry.summary: Introduces a control-oriented reformulation of Discrete Elastic Rod dynamics for soft robot trajectory generation, addressing the tradeoff between model fidelity and computational efficiency for underactuated soft manipulators.

entry.title: Fleet-Level Battery-Health-Aware Scheduling for Autonomous Mobile Robots

author.name: Jiachen Li, Shihao Li, Jian Chu, Wei Li, Dongmei Chen

entry.summary: Extends battery degradation-aware task planning to multi-robot fleets, jointly optimizing task assignment, charging decisions, and charger access while balancing degradation across robots. Uses linearized degradation proxies from empirical battery aging literature.

entry.title: AirSimAG: A High-Fidelity Simulation Platform for Air-Ground Collaborative Robotics

author.name: Yangjie Cui, Xin Dong, Boyang Gao, Jinwu Xiang, Daochun Li, Zhan Tu

entry.summary: AirSimAG extends AirSim into a high-fidelity simulation platform for UAV-UGV collaborative robotics, supporting synchronized multi-agent simulation with heterogeneous sensing and control interfaces.

entry.title: Path Planning and Reinforcement Learning-Driven Control of On-Orbit Free-Flying Multi-Arm Robots

author.name: \'Alvaro Belmonte-Baeza, Jos\'e Luis Ram\'on, Leonard Felicetti, Miguel Cazorla, Jorge Pomares

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid approach combining trajectory optimization and reinforcement learning for free-flying multi-arm robots in on-orbit servicing. TO generates feasible paths while RL provides adaptive tracking under uncertainties.

entry.title: Memory Bear AI Memory Science Engine for Multimodal Affective Intelligence: A Technical Report

author.name: Deliang Wen, Ke Sun, Yu Wang

entry.summary: Presents Memory Bear, a memory-centered framework for multimodal affective intelligence that maintains persistent affective memory and models long-horizon emotional dependencies across text, speech, and visual signals. This addresses limitations of existing emotion recognition systems that focus on short-range inference.

entry.title: Reliable Classroom AI via Neuro-Symbolic Multimodal Reasoning

author.name: Sina Bagheri Nezhad

entry.summary: Proposes NSCR, a neuro-symbolic framework for classroom AI that decomposes analytics into perceptual grounding, symbolic abstraction, executable reasoning, and guardrailed decision layers. Argues classroom AI should be treated as a critical domain requiring verifiable evidence.

entry.title: ST-GDance++: A Scalable Spatial-Temporal Diffusion for Long-Duration Group Choreography

author.name: Jing Xu, Weiqiang Wang, Cunjian Chen, Jun Liu, Qiuhong Ke

entry.summary: Proposes ST-GDance++ for scalable group dance generation from music using spatial-temporal diffusion, addressing quadratic attention costs and motion collision risks as dancer count and sequence length increase.

entry.title: LLM-guided headline rewriting for clickability enhancement without clickbait

author.name: Yehudit Aperstein, Linoy Halifa, Sagiv Bar, Alexander Apartsin

entry.summary: Frames headline clickbait not as a separate category but as disproportionate amplification of engagement cues. Proposes controllable headline rewriting that selectively strengthens engagement attributes while constraining semantic faithfulness.

entry.title: UAV-DETR: DETR for Anti-Drone Target Detection

author.name: Jun Yang, Dong Wang, Hongxu Yin, Hongpeng Li, Jianxiong Yu

entry.summary: Introduces UAV-DETR for anti-drone detection with small-target-friendly architecture, WTConv-enhanced backbone, and Sliding Window Self-Attention encoder for detecting miniature drones against complex backgrounds.

entry.title: From the AI Act to a European AI Agency: Completing the Union's Regulatory Architecture

author.name: Georgios Pavlidis

entry.summary: Argues for creating a dedicated European AI Agency beyond the current AI Office established by the EU AI Act. Analyzes how such a supranational body could enhance policy coherence, risk assessment, and international cooperation.

entry.title: Edge Radar Material Classification Under Geometry Shifts

author.name: Jannik Hohmann, Dong Wang, Andreas N\"uchter

entry.summary: Presents a lightweight mmWave radar material classification pipeline for edge devices, achieving 94.2% F1 under nominal conditions but showing significant degradation under geometry shifts like sensor height changes.

entry.title: ReqFusion: A Multi-Provider Framework for Automated PEGS Analysis Across Software Domains

author.name: Muhammad Khalid, Manuel Oriol, Yilmaz Uygun

entry.summary: Introduces ReqFusion, an AI system that automates requirements engineering using multiple LLM providers (GPT, Claude, Groq) to extract and classify software requirements from various document formats.

entry.title: Cloud-Edge Collaborative Large Models for Robust Photovoltaic Power Forecasting

author.name: Nan Qiao, Sijing Duan, Shuning Wang, Xingyuan Hua, Ju Ren

entry.summary: Proposes a cloud-edge collaborative framework for PV power forecasting that balances accuracy, robustness, and latency using risk-aware routing between local and cloud models.

entry.title: Balancing Safety and Efficiency in Aircraft Health Diagnosis: A Task Decomposition Framework with Heterogeneous Long-Micro Scale Cascading and Knowledge Distillation-based Interpretability

author.name: Xinhang Chen, Zhihuan Wei, Yang Hu, Zhiguo Zeng, Kang Zeng, Suili Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a Diagnosis Decomposition Framework for aircraft health monitoring that decouples anomaly detection and fault classification using a long-range/micro-scale cascading approach with knowledge distillation.

entry.title: Explainable Threat Attribution for IoT Networks Using Conditional SHAP and Flow Behavior Modelling

author.name: Samuel Ozechi, Jennifer Okonkwoabutu

entry.title: Reddit After Roe: A Computational Analysis of Abortion Narratives and Barriers in the Wake of Dobbs

author.name: Aria Pessianzadeh, Alex H. Poole, Rezvaneh Rezapour

entry.summary: Large-scale computational analysis of abortion discourse on Reddit after the Dobbs decision, classifying 17,000+ posts by information type, abortion stage, barrier category, and emotions across three phases of the decision.

entry.title: MultiCam: On-the-fly Multi-Camera Pose Estimation Using Spatiotemporal Overlaps of Known Objects

author.name: Shiyu Li, Hannah Schieber, Kristoffer Waldow, Benjamin Busam, Julian Kreimeier, Daniel Roth

entry.summary: Proposes MultiCam for on-the-fly multi-camera pose estimation in AR applications by leveraging spatiotemporal overlaps of known objects rather than markers. Eliminates the need for initial calibration steps or constant marker tracking.

entry.title: Template-Based Feature Aggregation Network for Industrial Anomaly Detection

author.name: Wei Luo, Haiming Yao, Wenyong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes TFA-Net, a template-based feature aggregation network for industrial anomaly detection that addresses shortcut learning in feature-reconstruction methods by using a fixed template image as reference.

entry.title: Dual Contrastive Network for Few-Shot Remote Sensing Image Scene Classification

author.name: Zhong Ji, Liyuan Hou, Xuan Wang, Gang Wang, Yanwei Pang

entry.summary: Proposes Dual Contrastive Network for few-shot remote sensing image scene classification with context-guided and detail-guided contrastive learning branches addressing inter-class and intra-class variance challenges.

entry.title: Parallel OctoMapping: A Scalable Framework for Enhanced Path Planning in Autonomous Navigation

author.name: Yihui Mao, Tian Tan, Xuehui Shen, Warren E. Dixon, Rushikesh Kamalapurkar

entry.summary: Introduces Parallel OctoMapping (POMP), an OctoMap-based mapping technique that refines free-space representation through multi-threaded computation, enabling better path planning in cluttered environments by avoiding overly conservative obstacle representations.

entry.title: Variable-Resolution Virtual Maps for Autonomous Exploration with Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USVs)

author.name: Ye Li, Yewei Huang, Wenlong GaoZhang, Alberto Quattrini Li, Brendan Englot, Yuanchang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes variable-resolution virtual maps for USV exploration that adapt resolution based on environment features, reducing computational costs while maintaining SLAM reliability in near-shore waters with GNSS degradation.

entry.title: An Informal Definition of Goals for Embedded Agents

author.name: Ashe Vazquez Nuñez

entry.summary: Provides an informal definition of goals for embedded agents: goals are probable events in an agent's self-model that are statistically dependent on its actions — events that are likely only if it acts to make them happen. Short theoretical piece from MATS 9.0.

entry.title: Maximum Entropy Relaxation of Multi-Way Cardinality Constraints for Synthetic Population Generation

author.name: Fran\c{c}ois Pachet, Jean-Daniel Zucker

entry.summary: Proposes a maximum entropy relaxation approach for generating synthetic populations that satisfy multi-way cardinality constraints from aggregate statistics. Relevant to microsimulation, agent-based modeling, and privacy-preserving data release.

entry.title: Evaluating Prompting Strategies for Chart Question Answering with Large Language Models

author.name: Ruthuparna Naikar, Ying Zhu

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates four prompting strategies for chart QA across GPT-3.5/4/4o, finding Few-Shot Chain-of-Thought achieves up to 78.2% accuracy. Isolates prompt structure as the only variable by using structured chart data.

entry.title: Q-AGNN: Quantum-Enhanced Attentive Graph Neural Network for Intrusion Detection

author.name: Devashish Chaudhary, Sutharshan Rajasegarar, Shiva Raj Pokhrel

entry.summary: Proposes Q-AGNN, a quantum-enhanced graph neural network for network intrusion detection that uses parameterized quantum circuits to encode multi-hop neighborhood information. Models network flows as graph nodes with edges representing similarity.

entry.title: Latent Style-based Quantum Wasserstein GAN for Drug Design

author.name: Julien Baglio, Yacine Haddad, Richard Polifka

entry.summary: Proposes a quantum Wasserstein GAN with latent style-based architecture for drug design, aiming to overcome classical GAN training issues (barren plateaus, mode collapse) through quantum computing.

entry.title: High Resolution Flood Extent Detection Using Deep Learning with Random Forest Derived Training Labels

author.name: Azizbek Nuriddinov, Ebrahim Ahmadisharaf, Mohammad Reza Alizadeh

entry.summary: Develops a flood mapping framework integrating PlanetScope optical imagery with topographic features using Random Forest to generate training labels for U-Net deep learning models, addressing the lack of labeled data during disasters.

entry.title: AI Lifecycle-Aware Feasibility Framework for Split-RIC Orchestration in NTN O-RAN

author.name: Daniele Tarchi

entry.summary: Studies feasibility of distributing O-RAN control across Ground, LEO, and GEO satellite segments for non-terrestrial networks, deriving closed-form expressions for lifecycle energy and latency.

entry.title: Natural Language Interfaces for Spatial and Temporal Databases: A Comprehensive Overview of Methods, Taxonomy, and Future Directions

author.name: Samya Acharja, Kanchan Chowdhury

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of natural language interfaces for spatial and temporal databases, covering methods from NLP and database communities for querying geospatial data.

entry.title: Decoding AI Authorship: Can LLMs Truly Mimic Human Style Across Literature and Politics?

author.name: Nasser A Alsadhan

entry.summary: Studies whether GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Pro, and Claude 3.5 can mimic writing styles of literary and political figures using zero-shot prompting, evaluated via BERT/XGBoost classification and linguistic markers. Finds measurable divergences between AI-generated and authentic texts.

entry.title: Span Modeling for Idiomaticity and Figurative Language Detection with Span Contrastive Loss

author.name: Blake Matheny, Phuong Minh Nguyen, Minh Le Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes BERT/RoBERTa models fine-tuned with span contrastive loss for detecting idioms and figurative language, leveraging the non-compositional nature of such expressions.

entry.title: DecompGrind: A Decomposition Framework for Robotic Grinding via Cutting-Surface Planning and Contact-Force Adaptation

author.name: Shunsuke Araki, Takumi Hachimine, Yuki Saito, Kouhei Ohnishi, Jun Morimoto, Takamitsu Masubara

entry.title: Human vs. NAO: A Computational-Behavioral Framework for Quantifying Social Orienting in Autism and Typical Development

author.name: Vartika Narayani Srinet, Anirudha Bhattacharjee, Braj Bhushan, Bishakh Bhattacharya

entry.summary: Compares children's social orienting responses (name-calling) between human agents and NAO humanoid robot, measuring eye contact, response latency, and head orientation in both typically developing children and those with ASD.

entry.title: AI Safety Newsletter #70: Automated Warfare and AI Layoffs

author.name: Alice Blair

entry.summary: AI Safety Newsletter covering AI-driven layoffs at major tech companies, AI automation of warfare, and a new open letter on pro-human values in AI development. Provides overview of current AI safety policy landscape.

entry.title: AgriPestDatabase-v1.0: A Structured Insect Dataset for Training Agricultural Large Language Model

author.name: Yagizhan Bilal Durak, Ahsan Ul Islam, Shahidul Islam, Ashley Morgan-Olvera, Iftekhar Ibne Basith, Syed Hasib Akhter Faruqui

entry.summary: Creates a structured insect dataset for agricultural pest management and fine-tunes lightweight LLMs (≤7B) for edge device deployment in rural agricultural settings with limited connectivity.

entry.title: A Multi-Modal CNN-LSTM Framework with Multi-Head Attention and Focal Loss for Real-Time Elderly Fall Detection

author.name: Lijie Zhou, Luran Wang

entry.summary: Proposes MultiModalFallDetector for elderly fall detection using wearable sensors, combining multi-scale CNN feature extraction with multi-head attention and focal loss for handling class imbalance.

entry.title: A Multi-Task Targeted Learning Framework for Lithium-Ion Battery State-of-Health and Remaining Useful Life

author.name: Chenhan Wang, Zhengyi Bao, Huipin Lin, Jiahao Nie, Chunxiang Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-task framework for lithium-ion battery state-of-health and remaining useful life prediction, integrating multi-scale feature extraction with improved recurrent networks for long-term time-series modeling.

entry.title: A Direct Classification Approach for Reliable Wind Ramp Event Forecasting under Severe Class Imbalance

author.name: Alejandro Morales-Hern\'andez, Fabrizio De Caroa, Gian Marco Paldino, Pascal Tribel, Alfredo Vaccaro, Gianluca Bontempi

entry.summary: Proposes a direct classification approach for wind ramp event forecasting that addresses severe class imbalance in wind power datasets, where ramp events are rare (<15%). Aims to improve reliability of decision support for grid stability in renewable power systems.

entry.title: Modeling Quantum Federated Autoencoder for Anomaly Detection in IoT Networks

author.name: Devashish Chaudhary, Sutharshan Rajasegarar, Shiva Raj Pokhrel

entry.summary: Proposes a quantum federated autoencoder framework for anomaly detection in IoT networks, combining quantum autoencoders with federated learning for privacy-preserving distributed detection.

entry.title: The EU AI Act and the Rights-based Approach to Technological Governance

author.name: Georgios Pavlidis

entry.summary: Examines how the EU AI Act implements a rights-based approach to AI governance, arguing that fundamental rights serve as legal thresholds and procedural triggers throughout the AI system lifecycle.

entry.title: A Synchronized Audio-Visual Multi-View Capture System

author.name: Xiangwei Shi, Era Dorta Perez, Ruud de Jong, Ojas Shirekar, Chirag Raman

Claims to extend beyond Landauer's principle and Fisher Information.

author.name: Tien Rahayu Tulili, Ayushi Rastogi, Andrea Capiluppi

author.name: Shuangwu Qian, Xiaochan Yuan, Pengfei Liu

entry.summary: Proposes PVGF-DPC for automatic caption generation of Dongba paintings, a culturally specific art form, using prompt learning and visual semantic fusion to bridge the domain gap from generic image captioning.

entry.summary: Proposes an attention-enhanced U-Net with explainable AI for automated brain tumor segmentation on BraTS 2020 dataset, incorporating Grad-CAM for visualization.

author.name: Mitchell_Porter

entry.summary: A speculative geopolitical analysis exploring how potential military conflicts (Ukraine, Iran, Taiwan) could intersect with AI development timelines around 2027, questioning how AI capabilities might affect or be affected by major global conflicts.

author.name: Antonio D. Villegas-Yeguas, Guillermo R-Garc\'ia, Tzipi Kahana, Jorge Pinares Toledo, Esi Sharon, Oscar Iba\~nez, Oscar Cord\'on

entry.summary: Applies aggregation operators to improve forensic dental record comparison for human identification. Designs interpretable aggregation mechanisms that can be validated by forensic dentistry experts.

author.name: Zeshan Khan, Muhammad Atif Tahir

entry.summary: PhD thesis on gastrointestinal tract image analysis covering texture-based features, deep learning classification, and segmentation. Achieves high processing speeds and strong performance on standard datasets.

author.name: Linch

entry.summary: Philosophical essay exploring the possibility of 'further moral goods' — qualitatively new axes of moral value beyond the physical, social, and conscious worlds we currently navigate. Questions whether consciousness-related goods might be the last moral world or if there are others.

entry.title: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning Models for Hourly Forecasting of Air Temperature and Relative Humidity

author.name: Jiaqi Dong

entry.summary: Compares seven ML models for hourly weather forecasting (temperature and humidity) in Chongqing, China. Finds XGBoost and Random Forest competitive with deep learning approaches.

entry.title: Book Review: Open Socrates (Part 2)

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Part 2 of the Open Socrates book review, covering the Socratic method, coherent extrapolated volition, epistemics of argumentation, and political discourse.

entry.title: Book Review: Open Socrates (Part 1)

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Part 1 of a book review of 'Open Socrates,' exploring Socratic questioning, epistemics, and critical thinking. Primarily philosophical discussion with extensive quotes and cultural references.

author.name: Qianru Wei, Jihaoyu Yang, Cheng Zhang, Jinming Yang

entry.summary: Applies K-means clustering to classify college students for career guidance based on test scores, GPA, personality traits. Standard ML application with no methodological novelty.

entry.summary: Introduction to a rational fiction book set in an alternative timeline where pro-progress ideologies (rationalism, transhumanism) have succeeded. Ukrainian science olympiad culture meets optimistic science fiction.

author.name: 0xmadlad

entry.summary: Essay on 'information overdose' — the numbing effect of having vast amounts of information readily available, particularly on young people. Argues that easy access to knowledge has paradoxically reduced desire for deep understanding.

entry.title: Adopt a debugger’s mindset to solve your recurring life problems

author.name: Declan Molony

entry.summary: Self-help post applying a 'debugger's mindset' to recurring life problems (procrastination, rumination, social anxiety), suggesting people write down beliefs about problems to find and fix incorrect assumptions.

author.name: jefftk

entry.summary: Argues that contra dances should avoid scheduling on Saturdays to enable musician touring, since most dances cluster on Saturdays making multi-day tours impossible.

entry.title: Malmö AI Safety meetup

author.name: Vadym Sulzhenko (Vaigotaku)

entry.summary: Announcement of an AI Safety meetup in Malmö, Sweden.

entry.title: Research Summary: March 24, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research exposes deep vulnerabilities in alignment and multimodal understanding while showcasing remarkable new reasoning capabilities.

  • Alignment Whack-a-Mole reveals that fine-tuning GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Pro, and DeepSeek-V3.1 triggers 85–95% verbatim reproduction of copyrighted books, with major legal implications
  • Mirage from Fei-Fei Li's group shows multimodal models hallucinate detailed descriptions for images never provided, challenging core assumptions about visual understanding
  • Epistemic Observability formally proves that text-only monitoring is fundamentally insufficient for detecting LLM confabulation, while a companion study shows reasoning traces causally shape outputs but models deny this influence
  • DeepMind provides causal evidence that LLMs use internal confidence estimates to drive abstention behavior

On the capabilities front, Claude Opus 4.6 with Rocq-MCP tools autonomously proved 10 of 12 problems from the 2025 Putnam Competition. LongCat-Flash-Prover, a 560B open-source MoE, advances formal theorem proving in Lean4 via agentic tool-integrated RL. Latent Lookahead Training enables transformers to perform additional forward passes in latent space before committing to the next token, addressing a fundamental limitation of autoregressive prediction. Depth-Recurrent Transformers decouple computational depth from parameter count for improved compositional generalization, and a comprehensive empirical recipe demystifies RL training for long-horizon tool-using agents.

entry.title: Alignment Whack-a-Mole : Finetuning Activates Verbatim Recall of Copyrighted Books in Large Language Models

author.name: Xinyue Liu, Niloofar Mireshghallah, Jane C. Ginsburg, Tuhin Chakrabarty

entry.summary: Shows that fine-tuning frontier LLMs (GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Pro, DeepSeek-V3.1) to expand plot summaries into full text causes reproduction of up to 85-90% of copyrighted books, bypassing safety alignment protections.

entry.title: Putnam 2025 Problems in Rocq using Opus 4.6 and Rocq-MCP

author.name: Guillaume Baudart, Marc Lelarge, Tristan St\'erin, Jules Viennot

entry.summary: Reports that Claude Opus 4.6 with MCP tools for the Rocq proof assistant autonomously proved 10 of 12 problems from the 2025 Putnam Mathematical Competition, consuming ~1.9B tokens over 17.7 hours.

entry.title: Causal Evidence that Language Models use Confidence to Drive Behavior

author.name: Dharshan Kumaran, Nathaniel Daw, Simon Osindero, Petar Velickovic, Viorica Patraucean

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLMs causally use internal confidence estimates to drive abstention behavior through a four-phase paradigm, finding that confidence is the dominant predictor of behavior with effect sizes an order of magnitude larger than knowledge retrieval access. Authors include DeepMind researchers.

entry.title: Mirage The Illusion of Visual Understanding

author.name: Mohammad Asadi, Jack W. O'Sullivan, Fang Cao, Tahoura Nedaee, Kamyar Fardi, Fei-Fei Li, Ehsan Adeli, Euan Ashley

entry.summary: Reports three findings challenging multimodal AI assumptions: models generate detailed descriptions for images never provided ('mirage reasoning'), achieve high benchmark scores without image input, and show significant visual-textual decoupling. Fei-Fei Li is a co-author.

entry.title: Epistemic Observability in Language Models

author.name: Tony Mason

entry.summary: Proves that LLMs report highest confidence when fabricating, with self-reported confidence inversely correlating with accuracy. Formally proves this is an observational limitation: text-only monitoring cannot reliably distinguish honest outputs from fabrications.

entry.title: Thinking into the Future: Latent Lookahead Training for Transformers

author.name: Lorenzo Noci, Gregor Bachmann, Seyed-Mohsen Moosavi-Dezfooli, Moin Nabi

entry.summary: Introduces latent lookahead training that enables transformer models to perform additional forward passes in latent space before committing to the next token, allowing the model to 'think' and allocate more compute to difficult tokens.

entry.title: Reasoning Traces Shape Outputs but Models Won't Say So

author.name: Yijie Hao, Lingjie Chen, Ali Emami, Joyce Ho

entry.summary: Introduces 'Thought Injection' to test whether LLM reasoning traces causally influence outputs and whether models acknowledge this influence. Finds injected hints reliably alter outputs but models refuse to disclose the influence >90% of the time.

entry.title: LongCat-Flash-Prover: Advancing Native Formal Reasoning via Agentic Tool-Integrated Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jianing Wang, Jianfei Zhang, Qi Guo, Linsen Guo, Rumei Li, Chao Zhang, Chong Peng, Cunguang Wang, Dengchang Zhao, Jiarong Shi, Jingang Wang, Liulin Feng, Mengxia Shen, Qi Li, Shengnan An, Shun Wang, Wei Shi, Xiangyu Xi, Xiaoyu Li, Xuezhi Cao, Yi Lu, Yunke Zhao, Zhengyu Chen, Zhimin Lin, Wei Wang, Peng Pei, Xunliang Cai

entry.summary: Introduces LongCat-Flash-Prover, a 560B MoE model for formal theorem proving in Lean4, using agentic tool-integrated reasoning with a Hierarchical Importance Sampling Policy Optimization algorithm.

entry.title: Thinking in Different Spaces: Domain-Specific Latent Geometry Survives Cross-Architecture Translation

author.name: Marcus Armstrong, Navid Ayoobi, Arjun Mukherjee

entry.summary: Investigates whether independently trained LLMs converge to geometrically compatible latent representations, learning linear projections to map teacher activations into student coordinate systems. Shows Ridge projection consistently works across 20 heterogeneous teacher-student pairings.

entry.title: Structural Sensitivity in Compressed Transformers: Error Propagation, Lyapunov Stability, and Formally Verified Bounds

author.name: Abhinaba Basu

entry.summary: Maps the compression sensitivity landscape across five transformer architectures (117M-8B params), finding that early-layer MLP up-projections are catastrophically sensitive while value projections compress nearly for free. Uses Lyapunov stability theory to explain why residual connections contract compression errors, providing formally verified bounds.

entry.title: Thinking Deeper, Not Longer: Depth-Recurrent Transformers for Compositional Generalization

author.name: Hung-Hsuan Chen

entry.summary: Introduces a depth-recurrent Transformer that decouples computational depth from parameter count by iteratively applying shared-weight blocks, enabling variable-depth reasoning at inference time. Uses silent thinking objectives and stabilization mechanisms for 20+ recurrence steps.

entry.title: Demystifying Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Tool-Using Agents: A Comprehensive Recipe

author.name: Xixi Wu, Qianguo Sun, Ruiyang Zhang, Chao Song, Junlong Wu, Yiyan Qi, Hong Cheng

entry.summary: Presents a systematic empirical study of RL for long-horizon tool-using LLM agents using TravelPlanner, decomposing the design space along 5 axes (reward shaping, model scaling, data composition, algorithm selection, environmental stability) and yielding 7 key takeaways about scale-dependent design choices.

entry.title: Measuring Reasoning Trace Legibility: Can Those Who Understand Teach?

author.name: Dani Roytburg, Shreya Sridhar, Daphne Ippolito

entry.summary: Introduces 'transfer utility' to measure reasoning trace legibility - whether an RLM's reasoning traces help a weaker non-reasoning model arrive at correct answers. Evaluates 90k traces from 12 reasoning language models.

entry.title: Structured Visual Narratives Undermine Safety Alignment in Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Rui Yang Tan, Yujia Hu, Roy Ka-Wei Lee

entry.summary: Introduces ComicJailbreak, a benchmark of 1,167 attack instances that embed harmful goals in three-panel comic templates to jailbreak multimodal LLMs. Tests across 15 state-of-the-art MLLMs show comic-based attacks achieve high success rates comparable to strong rule-based jailbreaks.

entry.title: Compression is all you need: Modeling Mathematics

author.name: Vitaly Aksenov, Eve Bodnia, Michael H. Freedman, Michael Mulligan

entry.summary: Argues that human mathematics is distinguished from formal mathematics by its compressibility through hierarchical definitions. Models this with monoids and proves results about expressivity expansion from macro sets, testing predictions against mathematical corpora.

entry.title: Coding Agents are Effective Long-Context Processors

author.name: Weili Cao, Xunjian Yin, Bhuwan Dhingra, Shuyan Zhou

entry.summary: Shows that off-the-shelf coding agents can effectively process long contexts by organizing text in file systems and manipulating it with native tools, externalizing long-context processing from latent attention into explicit executable interactions.

entry.title: DSPA: Dynamic SAE Steering for Data-Efficient Preference Alignment

author.name: James Wedgwood, Aashiq Muhamed, Mona T. Diab, Virginia Smith

entry.summary: Proposes DSPA, an inference-time preference alignment method using sparse autoencoders (SAEs) for prompt-conditional steering. Computes conditional-difference maps from preference triples and modifies only token-active latents during decoding, without weight updates.

entry.title: ROM: Real-time Overthinking Mitigation via Streaming Detection and Intervention

author.name: Xinyan Wang, Xiaogeng Liu, Chaowei Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes ROM, a real-time overthinking mitigation method for large reasoning models that attaches a lightweight detection head to monitor hidden states and intervene when the model continues generating after reaching the correct answer.

entry.title: Mechanisms of Introspective Awareness

author.name: Uzay Macar, Li Yang, Atticus Wang, Peter Wallich, Emmanuel Ameisen, Jack Lindsey

entry.summary: Investigates mechanisms of introspective awareness in LLMs when steering vectors are injected, finding the capability emerges from post-training and relies on anomaly detection across multiple non-linear features rather than simple heuristics.

entry.title: Holistic Scaling Laws for Optimal Mixture-of-Experts Architecture Optimization

author.name: Weilin Wan, Jingtao Han, Weizhong Zhang, Cheng Jin

entry.summary: Proposes a reusable framework for holistic Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectural optimization, showing that FLOPs per token alone is an inadequate fairness metric for MoE models. The work bridges the gap between scaling laws and practical MoE configuration by accounting for computational density differences across layer types.

entry.title: RLVR Training of LLMs Does Not Improve Thinking Ability for General QA: Evaluation Method and a Simple Solution

author.name: Kaiyuan Li, Jing-Cheng Pang, Yang Yu

entry.summary: Evaluates RLVR training on general question answering using a cross-generation evaluation framework, finding that thinking processes effective for verifiable tasks don't transfer well to GQA, and proposes a simple solution.

entry.title: Greater accessibility can amplify discrimination in generative AI

author.name: Carolin Holtermann, Minh Duc Bui, Kaitlyn Zhou, Valentin Hofmann, Katharina von der Wense, Anne Lauscher

entry.summary: Demonstrates that audio-enabled LLMs exhibit systematic gender discrimination based on voice characteristics, shifting responses toward gender-stereotyped content. Shows accessibility gains from voice interfaces may come at cost of equitable treatment.

entry.title: End-to-End Training for Unified Tokenization and Latent Denoising

author.name: Shivam Duggal, Xingjian Bai, Zongze Wu, Richard Zhang, Eli Shechtman, Antonio Torralba, Phillip Isola, William T. Freeman

entry.summary: Proposes UNITE, an end-to-end architecture that unifies image tokenization and latent diffusion through a Generative Encoder with weight sharing, eliminating the staged training pipeline of standard latent diffusion models.

entry.title: On the Direction of RLVR Updates for LLM Reasoning: Identification and Exploitation

author.name: Kexin Huang, Haoming Meng, Junkang Wu, Jinda Lu, Chiyu Ma, Ziqian Chen, Xue Wang, Bolin Ding, Jiancan Wu, Xiang Wang, Xiangnan He, Guoyin Wang, Jingren Zhou

entry.summary: Analyzes the direction (not just magnitude) of RLVR-induced updates in LLMs, showing that signed token-level log probability differences better identify sparse, reasoning-critical changes than magnitude-based measures.

entry.title: Seed1.8 Model Card: Towards Generalized Real-World Agency

author.name: Bytedance Seed

entry.summary: ByteDance presents Seed1.8, a foundation model for generalized real-world agency supporting multi-turn interaction, tool use, and multi-step execution across search, code generation, and GUI interaction.

entry.title: Silent Commitment Failure in Instruction-Tuned Language Models: Evidence of Governability Divergence Across Architectures

author.name: Gregory M. Ruddell

entry.summary: Introduces 'governability' — the degree to which model errors are detectable before output — showing that 2 of 3 instruction-following models exhibit 'silent commitment failure' with confident, fluent, incorrect output and zero warning signals.

entry.title: Solver-Aided Verification of Policy Compliance in Tool-Augmented LLM Agents

author.name: Cailin Winston, Claris Winston, Ren\'e Just

entry.summary: Introduces an SMT solver-aided framework to enforce tool-use policy compliance in tool-augmented LLM agents, providing formal guarantees that policy violations will be prevented rather than merely steering behavior.

entry.title: The data heat island effect: quantifying the impact of AI data centers in a warming world

author.name: Andrea Marinoni, Pietro Lio', Erik Cambria, Luca Dal Zilio, Weisi Lin, Mauro Dalla Mura, Jocelyn Chanussot, Edoardo Ragusa, Gianmarco Mengaldo, Chi Yan Tso, Yihao Zhu, Benjamin Horton

entry.summary: Quantifies the 'data heat island effect' showing AI data centers increase surrounding land surface temperatures by ~2°C on average, using remote sensing measurements over multiple decades globally.

entry.title: Mixture of Chapters: Scaling Learnt Memory in Transformers

author.name: Tasmay Pankaj Tibrewal, Pritish Saha, Ankit Meda, Kunal Singh, Pradeep Moturi

entry.summary: Introduces learnable sparse memory banks for transformers using cross-attention, with chapter-based routing inspired by Mixture-of-Experts to scale to 262K memory tokens. Evaluated against standard transformers in iso-FLOP settings on pre-training and instruction following.

entry.title: On the Number of Conditional Independence Tests in Constraint-based Causal Discovery

author.name: Marc Franquesa Mon\'es, Jiaqi Zhang, Caroline Uhler

entry.summary: Establishes an improved complexity bound for constraint-based causal discovery, showing that conditional independence tests can be reduced to p^O(s) where s is the maximum undirected clique number, improving over the PC algorithm's exponential worst case.

entry.title: Visual Exclusivity Attacks: Automatic Multimodal Red Teaming via Agentic Planning

author.name: Yunbei Zhang, Yingqiang Ge, Weijie Xu, Yuhui Xu, Jihun Hamm, Chandan K. Reddy

entry.summary: Introduces Visual Exclusivity (VE) attacks where harm emerges only through reasoning over visual content like schematics, and proposes MM-Plan, a multi-turn agentic planning framework for jailbreaking multimodal models using GRPO.

entry.title: Hawkeye: Reproducing GPU-Level Non-Determinism

author.name: Erez Badash, Dan Boneh, Ilan Komargodski, Megha Srivastava

entry.summary: Presents Hawkeye, a system for reproducing GPU-level arithmetic operations on CPU, enabling exact verification of matrix multiplications used in ML training/inference without precision loss.

entry.title: The Hidden Puppet Master: A Theoretical and Real-World Account of Emotional Manipulation in LLMs

author.name: Jocelyn Shen, Amina Luvsanchultem, Jessica Kim, Kynnedy Smith, Valdemar Danry, Kantwon Rogers, Sharifa Alghowinem, Hae Won Park, Maarten Sap, Cynthia Breazeal

entry.summary: Introduces PUPPET, a taxonomy of personalized emotional manipulation in LLM-human dialogues, with N=1,035 participant study. Centers on incentive morality - whether manipulation drives users toward harmful or beneficial outcomes.

entry.title: ThinkJEPA: Empowering Latent World Models with Large Vision-Language Reasoning Model

author.name: Haichao Zhang, Yijiang Li, Shwai He, Tushar Nagarajan, Mingfei Chen, Jianglin Lu, Ang Li, Yun Fu

entry.summary: Proposes ThinkJEPA, combining latent world models (V-JEPA2 style) with large vision-language reasoning models to overcome limitations of both: world models get semantic grounding while VLMs get dense temporal prediction.

entry.title: Effective Strategies for Asynchronous Software Engineering Agents

author.name: Jiayi Geng, Graham Neubig

entry.summary: Proposes strategies for asynchronous multi-agent collaboration on long-horizon software engineering tasks, addressing challenges of concurrent edits, dependency synchronization, and combining partial progress. Led by Graham Neubig's group.

entry.title: Manifold-Aware Exploration for Reinforcement Learning in Video Generation

author.name: Mingzhe Zheng, Weijie Kong, Yue Wu, Dengyang Jiang, Yue Ma, Xuanhua He, Bin Lin, Kaixiong Gong, Zhao Zhong, Liefeng Bo, Qifeng Chen, Harry Yang

entry.summary: Proposes SAGE-GRPO for stable RL-based alignment of video generation models by constraining exploration to the vicinity of the pre-trained model's data manifold, preventing quality degradation during GRPO training.

entry.title: Me, Myself, and $\pi$ : Evaluating and Explaining LLM Introspection

author.name: Atharv Naphade, Samarth Bhargav, Sean Lim, Mcnair Shah

entry.summary: Proposes a principled taxonomy for LLM introspection and introduces Introspect-Bench to distinguish genuine meta-cognition from general knowledge application. Finds frontier models show promising but inconsistent introspective abilities.

entry.title: PivotRL: High Accuracy Agentic Post-Training at Low Compute Cost

author.name: Junkeun Yi, Damon Mosk-Aoyama, Baihe Huang, Ritu Gala, Charles Wang, Sugam Dipak Devare, Khushi Bhardwaj, Abhibha Gupta, Oleksii Kuchaiev, Jiantao Jiao, Jian Zhang, Venkat Srinivasan

entry.summary: Introduces PivotRL, combining SFT compute efficiency with E2E RL generalization by identifying 'pivots' — informative intermediate turns with high variance in outcomes — for targeted on-policy training.

entry.title: INTRYGUE: Induction-Aware Entropy Gating for Reliable RAG Uncertainty Estimation

author.name: Alexandra Bazarova, Andrei Volodichev, Daria Kotova, Alexey Zaytsev

entry.summary: Reveals that standard entropy-based uncertainty quantification fails in RAG due to a mechanistic paradox where induction heads copying correct answers collaterally trigger entropy neurons, causing false uncertainty signals.

entry.title: MARCUS: An agentic, multimodal vision-language model for cardiac diagnosis and management

author.name: Jack W O'Sullivan, Mohammad Asadi, Lennart Elbe, Akshay Chaudhari, Tahoura Nedaee, Francois Haddad, Michael Salerno, Li Fe-Fei, Ehsan Adeli, Rima Arnaout, Euan A Ashley

entry.summary: Presents MARCUS, an agentic multimodal vision-language system for end-to-end cardiac diagnosis across ECGs, echocardiograms, and CMR imaging. Uses hierarchical architecture with modality-specific expert models coordinated by a multi-agent system.

entry.title: OpenResearcher: A Fully Open Pipeline for Long-Horizon Deep Research Trajectory Synthesis

author.name: Zhuofeng Li, Dongfu Jiang, Xueguang Ma, Haoxiang Zhang, Ping Nie, Yuyu Zhang, Kai Zou, Jianwen Xie, Yu Zhang, Wenhu Chen

entry.summary: Presents OpenResearcher, a fully open pipeline for synthesizing long-horizon deep research trajectories offline using a 15M-document corpus and browser primitives, producing 97K+ trajectories including 100+ tool call sequences.

entry.title: The Causal Impact of Tool Affordance on Safety Alignment in LLM Agents

author.name: Shasha Yu, Fiona Carroll, Barry L. Bentley

entry.summary: Empirically examines how executable tool affordance alters LLM safety alignment, comparing text-only chatbot behavior with tool-enabled agent behavior in a deterministic financial transaction environment across 1,500 scenarios.

entry.title: Policies Permitting LLM Use for Polishing Peer Reviews Are Currently Not Enforceable

author.name: Rounak Saha, Gurusha Juneja, Dayita Chaudhuri, Naveeja Sajeevan, Nihar B Shah, Danish Pruthi

entry.summary: Demonstrates that current AI-text detection tools cannot reliably distinguish LLM-polished human-written reviews from fully AI-generated ones, showing that conference policies allowing LLM polishing but prohibiting LLM writing are practically unenforceable.

entry.title: SWE-Next: Scalable Real-World Software Engineering Tasks for Agents

author.name: Jiarong Liang, Zhiheng Lyu, Zijie Liu, Xiangchao Chen, Ping Nie, Kai Zou, Wenhu Chen

entry.summary: Presents SWE-Next, a scalable framework for collecting execution-grounded software engineering tasks from real pull requests, retaining only instances that produce strict test improvements. Also introduces trajectory collection methodology.

entry.title: Rethinking Plasticity in Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zhiqiang He

entry.summary: Proposes the Optimization-Centric Plasticity (OCP) hypothesis for plasticity loss in deep RL, arguing it arises because optimal points from previous tasks become poor local optima for new tasks. Establishes equivalence between neuron dormancy and zero-gradient states.

entry.title: When Convenience Becomes Risk: A Semantic View of Under-Specification in Host-Acting Agents

author.name: Di Lu, Yongzhi Liao, Xutong Mu, Lele Zheng, Ke Cheng, Xuewen Dong, Yulong Shen, Jianfeng Ma

entry.summary: Analyzes security risks in host-acting AI agents arising from semantic under-specification in goal instructions, where benign user goals can lead to risky execution plans due to incomplete specification of process constraints and safety boundaries.

entry.title: Generalized Discrete Diffusion from Snapshots

author.name: Oussama Zekri, Th\'eo Uscidda, Nicolas Boull\'e, Anna Korba

entry.summary: Introduces GDDS, a unified framework for discrete diffusion modeling supporting arbitrary noising processes over large state spaces, with an efficient ELBO based on snapshot latents rather than full noising paths.

entry.title: Towards Secure Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Comprehensive Review of Threats, Defenses and Benchmarks

author.name: Yanming Mu, Hao Hu, Feiyang Li, Qiao Yuan, Jiang Wu, Zichuan Liu, Pengcheng Liu, Mei Wang, Hongwei Zhou, Yuling Liu

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of security threats and defenses for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, covering data poisoning, adversarial attacks, and membership inference. Constructs a taxonomy of defense technologies spanning input and output stages.

entry.title: P^2O: Joint Policy and Prompt Optimization

author.name: Xinyu Lu, Kaiqi Zhang, Jinglin Yang, Boxi Cao, Yaojie Lu, Hongyu Lin, Min He, Xianpei Han, Le Sun

entry.summary: Proposes P²O, combining prompt optimization with policy optimization in RLVR to address hard samples that yield near-zero success rates. Uses GeneticPareto prompt optimization to generate useful training signal for otherwise uninformative instances.

entry.title: When Does Content-Based Routing Work? Representation Requirements for Selective Attention in Hybrid Sequence Models

author.name: Abhinaba Basu

entry.summary: Identifies a routing paradox in hybrid recurrent-attention architectures: content-based routing requires pairwise computation that routing aims to avoid. Shows one attention layer creates a latent subspace enabling 98.4% routing precision.

entry.title: Kolmogorov Complexity Bounds for LLM Steganography and a Perplexity-Based Detection Proxy

author.name: Andrii Shportko

entry.summary: Proves that any steganographic scheme preserving semantic content while encoding a payload must increase Kolmogorov complexity, providing information-theoretic detection bounds and a practical perplexity-based detection proxy.

entry.title: Scaling DoRA: High-Rank Adaptation via Factored Norms and Fused Kernels

author.name: Alexandra Zelenin, Alexandra Zhuravlyova

entry.summary: Addresses the memory bottleneck in high-rank DoRA (Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation) by introducing factored norm computation and fused Triton kernels, reducing transient memory from ~512MB to O(d_out*r + r^2) intermediates.

entry.title: Fast-Slow Thinking RM: Efficient Integration of Scalar and Generative Reward Models

author.name: Jiayun Wu, Peixu Hou, Shan Qu, Peng Zhang, Ning Gu, Tun Lu

entry.summary: Introduces Fast-Slow Thinking Reward Models (F/S-RM) that integrate scalar scoring (fast thinking) and chain-of-thought judgment (slow thinking) in a single model, using dual-confidence activation to select the appropriate mode.

entry.title: DRTriton: Large-Scale Synthetic Data Reinforcement Learning for Triton Kernel Generation

author.name: Siqi Guo, Ming Lin, Tianbao Yang

entry.summary: Proposes DRTriton, a scalable RL-based framework for training LLMs to convert PyTorch code into optimized Triton kernels. Uses synthetic data generation (CSP-DAG) for comprehensive operator coverage. Notes that GPT-5.2 and Claude-Sonnet-4.5 still struggle at this task.

entry.title: CoVFT: Context-aware Visual Fine-tuning for Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Nan Zhou, Huiqun Wang, Yaoyan Zheng, Di Huang

entry.summary: Investigates whether vision encoders in multimodal LLMs should be fine-tuned or frozen, finding that existing visual fine-tuning methods don't consistently beat frozen baselines. Proposes context-aware visual fine-tuning (CoVFT) to resolve visual preference conflicts caused by context-agnostic encoder updates.

entry.title: The Universal Normal Embedding

author.name: Chen Tasker, Roy Betser, Eyal Gofer, Meir Yossef Levi, Guy Gilboa

entry.summary: Proposes the Universal Normal Embedding (UNE) hypothesis: that generative models and vision encoders share a common approximately Gaussian latent space. Introduces NoiseZoo dataset to test this with DDIM-inverted noise and encoder representations.

entry.title: Agentic AI and the next intelligence explosion

author.name: James Evans, Benjamin Bratton, Blaise Ag\"uera y Arcas

entry.summary: Essay by James Evans, Benjamin Bratton, and Blaise Agüera y Arcas arguing that the AI singularity should be understood as plural, social intelligence rather than a monolithic mind. Proposes shifting from dyadic alignment to institutional alignment.

entry.title: Revisiting Tree Search for LLMs: Gumbel and Sequential Halving for Budget-Scalable Reasoning

author.name: Leonid Ugadiarov, Yuri Kuratov, Aleksandr Panov, Alexey Skrynnik

entry.summary: Presents ReSCALE, an adaptation of Gumbel AlphaZero MCTS for LLM reasoning that fixes the scaling failure of standard tree search where accuracy drops with increased budget. Achieves monotonic scaling on GSM8K and Game24.

entry.title: Enhancing Safety of Large Language Models via Embedding Space Separation

author.name: Xu Zhao, Xiting Wang, Weiran Shen

entry.summary: Proposes ES2, a representation-level fine-tuning approach that improves LLM safety by explicitly enlarging the distance between harmful and safe representations in embedding space, with measures to preserve general capabilities.

entry.title: Weber's Law in Transformer Magnitude Representations: Efficient Coding, Representational Geometry, and Psychophysical Laws in Language Models

author.name: Jon-Paul Cacioli

entry.summary: Applies psychophysical methods to show transformer models represent magnitude with log-compressive (Weber's law) geometry across multiple domains and architecture families, resolving conflicting prior findings about magnitude encoding.

entry.title: Mitigating Shortcut Reasoning in Language Models: A Gradient-Aware Training Approach

author.name: Hongyu Cao, Kunpeng Liu, Dongjie Wang, Yanjie Fu

entry.summary: Proposes SART, a gradient-aware framework that detects shortcut-promoting training samples via gradient misalignment and answer-token concentration, then modifies training dynamics to mitigate shortcut reasoning in LLMs. Achieves +16.5% accuracy and +40.2% robustness gains.

entry.title: When Models Judge Themselves: Unsupervised Self-Evolution for Multimodal Reasoning

author.name: Zhengxian Wu, Kai Shi, Chuanrui Zhang, Zirui Liao, Jun Yang, Ni Yang, Qiuying Peng, Luyuan Zhang, Hangrui Xu, Tianhuang Su, Zhenyu Yang, Haonan Lu, Haoqian Wang

entry.summary: Proposes an unsupervised self-evolution framework for multimodal reasoning where models judge their own outputs using self-consistency signals and a bounded judge modulation to reweight trajectories, achieving improvements without human annotations or external rewards.

entry.title: Sharper Generalization Bounds for Transformer

author.name: Yawen Li, Tao Hu, Zhouhui Lian, Wan Tian, Yijie Peng, Huiming Zhang, Zhongyi Li

entry.summary: Derives sharper generalization bounds for transformer architectures using offset Rademacher complexity and empirical covering numbers, obtaining optimal convergence rates for single/multi-head and multi-layer transformers.

entry.title: Confidence-Based Decoding is Provably Efficient for Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Changxiao Cai, Gen Li

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis proving that confidence-based decoding for diffusion language models is efficient, offering formal guarantees for adaptive token unmasking strategies that have shown empirical success.

entry.title: The Multiverse of Time Series Machine Learning: an Archive for Multivariate Time Series Classification

author.name: Matthew Middlehurst, Aiden Rushbrooke, Ali Ismail-Fawaz, Maxime Devanne, Germain Forestier, Angus Dempster, Geoffrey I. Webb, Christopher Holder, Anthony Bagnall

entry.summary: Presents a major expansion of the UEA multivariate time series classification archive from 30 to 133 datasets (149 with preprocessed versions), providing an essential community benchmark resource.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning from Multi-Source Imperfect Preferences: Best-of-Both-Regimes Regret

author.name: Ming Shi, Yingbin Liang, Ness B. Shroff, Ananthram Swami

entry.summary: Studies RLHF with multi-source imperfect preferences, establishing regret bounds when feedback comes from multiple sources with systematic biases, achieving best-of-both-regimes guarantees.

entry.title: Understanding Contextual Recall in Transformers: How Finetuning Enables In-Context Reasoning over Pretraining Knowledge

author.name: Bhavya Vasudeva, Puneesh Deora, Alberto Bietti, Vatsal Sharan, Christos Thrampoulidis

entry.summary: Investigates contextual recall in transformers using a controlled synthetic framework, demonstrating that finetuning creates induction-head-like circuits enabling models to recall pretraining facts in novel prompt formats.

entry.title: Towards Practical World Model-based Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Zhilong Zhang, Haoxiang Ren, Yihao Sun, Yifei Sheng, Haonan Wang, Haoxin Lin, Zhichao Wu, Pierre-Luc Bacon, Yang Yu

entry.summary: Proposes VLA-MBPO, a practical framework for finetuning Vision-Language-Action models using world models, addressing pixel-level world modeling, multi-view consistency, and compounding errors in model-based RL for robotics.

entry.title: LLM Router: Prefill is All You Need

author.name: Tanay Varshney, Annie Surla, Michelle Xu, Gomathy Venkata Krishnan, Maximilian Jeblick, David Austin, Neal Vaidya, Davide Onofrio

entry.summary: Proposes using internal prefill activations for LLM routing via Encoder-Target Decoupling, using Fisher Separability and Effective Dimensionality as mathematical probes to identify optimal encoder-target pairings.

entry.title: Gumbel Distillation for Parallel Text Generation

author.name: Chi Zhang, Xixi Hu, Bo Liu, Qiang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces Gumbel Distillation, a technique enabling parallel decoders to learn complex joint token distributions from autoregressive teachers. Uses the Gumbel-Max trick for deterministic mapping from latent noise to output tokens.

entry.title: Consistent but Dangerous: Per-Sample Safety Classification Reveals False Reliability in Medical Vision-Language Models

author.name: Binesh Sadanandan, Vahid Behzadan

entry.summary: Shows that consistency under paraphrase is a flawed proxy for reliability in medical VLMs, introducing a four-quadrant safety taxonomy revealing models can be consistently wrong by relying on text patterns rather than images.

entry.title: CVT-Bench: Counterfactual Viewpoint Transformations Reveal Unstable Spatial Representations in Multimodal LLMs

author.name: Shanmukha Vellamcheti, Uday Kiran Kothapalli, Disharee Bhowmick, Sathyanarayanan N. Aakur

entry.summary: Introduces CVT-Bench to evaluate whether MLLMs maintain stable spatial representations under counterfactual viewpoint changes. Finds that despite high single-view accuracy, state-of-the-art MLLMs exhibit systematic degradation and cycle consistency violations under viewpoint transformations.

entry.title: Grounded Chess Reasoning in Language Models via Master Distillation

author.name: Zhenwei Tang, Qianfeng Wen, Seth Grief-Albert, Yahya Elgabra, Blair Yang, Honghua Dong, Ashton Anderson

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for distilling expert system reasoning into natural language chain-of-thought explanations for chess. A 4B parameter model achieves 48.1% accuracy, outperforming GPT-4o, by learning from chess engine reasoning traces.

entry.title: Profit is the Red Team: Stress-Testing Agents in Strategic Economic Interactions

author.name: Shouqiao Wang, Marcello Politi, Samuele Marro, Davide Crapis

entry.summary: Proposes profit-driven red teaming, where a learned opponent trained to maximize profit stress-tests agentic AI systems in structured economic interactions, without requiring handcrafted attacks.

entry.title: The Intelligent Disobedience Game: Formulating Disobedience in Stackelberg Games and Markov Decision Processes

author.name: Benedikt Hornig, Reuth Mirsky

entry.summary: Introduces the Intelligent Disobedience Game (IDG), a game-theoretic framework for when an AI assistant should override human instructions to prevent harm, identifying phenomena like 'safety traps'.

entry.title: AgentHER: Hindsight Experience Replay for LLM Agent Trajectory Relabeling

author.name: Liang Ding

entry.summary: Introduces AgentHER, adapting Hindsight Experience Replay to LLM agent trajectories for offline data augmentation, recovering training signal from failed trajectories by relabeling them for alternative achievable goals.

entry.title: CRoCoDiL: Continuous and Robust Conditioned Diffusion for Language

author.name: Roy Uziel, Omer Belhasin, Itay Levi, Akhiad Bercovich, Ran El-Yaniv, Ran Zilberstein, Michael Elad

entry.summary: Proposes CRoCoDiL, which shifts masked diffusion models into continuous sentence-level semantic space, creating a novel autoencoder where decoding is performed by an MDM algorithm. Addresses token dependency and semantic coherence issues.

entry.title: AI Detectors Fail Diverse Student Populations: A Mathematical Framing of Structural Detection Limits

author.name: Nathan Garland

entry.summary: Provides mathematical proof that AI text detectors must produce high false positive rates on diverse student populations due to composite null hypotheses when the assessor doesn't know individual writing distributions.

entry.title: On the Fragility of AI Agent Collusion

author.name: Jussi Keppo, Yuze Li, Gerry Tsoukalas, Nuo Yuan

entry.summary: Shows that LLM algorithmic collusion in pricing games is fragile under realistic heterogeneity conditions. Patience heterogeneity, asymmetric data, more competitors, and cross-algorithm competition all reduce collusive behavior.

entry.title: PEARL: Personalized Streaming Video Understanding Model

author.name: Yuanhong Zheng, Ruichuan An, Xiaopeng Lin, Yuxing Liu, Sihan Yang, Huanyu Zhang, Haodong Li, Qintong Zhang, Renrui Zhang, Guopeng Li, Yifan Zhang, Yuheng Li, Wentao Zhang

entry.summary: Defines and benchmarks Personalized Streaming Video Understanding (PSVU), where models must continuously recognize new objects/identities and update memories in real-time video streams. Introduces PEARL-Bench as the first benchmark for this task.

entry.title: HiCI: Hierarchical Construction-Integration for Long-Context Attention

author.name: Xiangyu Zeng, Qi Xu, Yunke Wang, Chang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes HiCI, a hierarchical attention module inspired by cognitive discourse comprehension that constructs segment-level representations and integrates them globally, extending LLaMA-2 context from 4K to 100K tokens with <5.5% additional parameters.

entry.title: AC4A: Access Control for Agents

author.name: Reshabh K Sharma, Dan Grossman

entry.summary: Introduces AC4A, an access control framework for LLM agents that enables fine-grained permission management for API and web content access, moving beyond all-or-nothing access paradigms.

entry.title: Before the Tool Call: Deterministic Pre-Action Authorization for Autonomous AI Agents

author.name: Uchi Uchibeke

entry.summary: Presents Open Agent Passport (OAP), a specification for deterministic pre-action authorization in AI agents that intercepts tool calls synchronously before execution and evaluates them against declarative policies with cryptographic audit trails.

entry.title: Mitigating Selection Bias in Large Language Models via Permutation-Aware GRPO

author.name: Jinquan Zheng, Jia Yuan, Jiacheng Yao, Chenyang Gu, Pujun Zheng, Guoxiu He

entry.summary: Proposes PA-GRPO (Permutation-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization) to mitigate selection bias in LLMs during multiple-choice and pairwise evaluation tasks. Enforces permutation-consistent reasoning by constructing permutation groups and optimizing with cross-permutation advantage.

entry.title: Prompt replay: speeding up grpo with on-policy reuse of high-signal prompts

author.name: Andrei Baroian, Rutger Berger

entry.summary: Proposes Prompt Replay for GRPO-style RLVR training, an overhead-free online data selection method that reuses prompts (not trajectories) of medium difficulty to maximize learning signal. Prioritizes prompts near 0.5 pass rate.

entry.title: Toward a Theory of Hierarchical Memory for Language Agents

author.name: Yashar Talebirad, Ali Parsaee, Csongor Y. Szepesvari, Amirhossein Nadiri, Osmar Zaiane

entry.summary: Proposes a formal theory of hierarchical memory for language agents with three operators: extraction, coarsening, and traversal. Identifies a self-sufficiency spectrum for memory representations and provides a shared formalism for comparing design choices.

entry.title: PRISM: Breaking the O(n) Memory Wall in Long-Context LLM Inference via O(1) Photonic Block Selection

author.name: Hyoseok Park, Yeonsang Park

entry.summary: Proposes PRISM, using photonic computing for O(1) block selection in long-context LLM inference, identifying that the KV cache block selection step is structurally matched to the photonic broadcast-and-weight paradigm.

entry.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning and The Tale of Two Temporal Difference Errors

author.name: Juan Sebastian Rojas, Chi-Guhn Lee

entry.summary: Shows that two classical interpretations of the temporal difference error (successive predictions vs bootstrapped target) are not equivalent in nonlinear deep RL architectures, and this discrepancy grows with network nonlinearity.

entry.title: SpatialReward: Verifiable Spatial Reward Modeling for Fine-Grained Spatial Consistency in Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Sashuai Zhou, Qiang Zhou, Junpeng Ma, Yue Cao, Ruofan Hu, Ziang Zhang, Xiaoda Yang, Zhibin Wang, Jun Song, Cheng Yu, Bo Zheng, Zhou Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces SpatialReward, a verifiable reward model for evaluating spatial layouts in text-to-image generation, using prompt decomposition, expert detectors for grounding, and rule-based spatial verification.

entry.title: Generating from Discrete Distributions Using Diffusions: Insights from Random Constraint Satisfaction Problems

author.name: Alankrita Bhatt, Mukur Gupta, Germain Kolossov, Andrea Montanari

entry.summary: Studies discrete distribution generation using diffusion models through the lens of random constraint satisfaction problems. Shows continuous diffusions outperform masked discrete diffusions on k-SAT/k-XORSAT benchmarks, with insights from CSP theory.

entry.title: Beyond Token Eviction: Mixed-Dimension Budget Allocation for Efficient KV Cache Compression

author.name: Ruijie Miao, Zhiming Wang, Wang Li, Shiwei Wu, Shufan Liu, Yanbing Jiang, Tong Yang

entry.summary: Proposes MixedDimKV, a KV cache compression method that allocates different numbers of dimensions to different tokens rather than binary keep/evict decisions, enabling more granular memory optimization for long-context transformers.

entry.title: Pretrained Video Models as Differentiable Physics Simulators for Urban Wind Flows

author.name: Janne Perini, Rafael Bischof, Moab Arar, Ay\c{c}a Duran, Michael A. Kraus, Siddhartha Mishra, Bernd Bickel

entry.summary: Introduces WinDiNet, repurposing a 2B-parameter pretrained video diffusion model (LTX-Video) as a fast differentiable surrogate for urban wind flow CFD simulations, fine-tuned on 10,000 2D simulations.

entry.title: Decoupling Exploration and Policy Optimization: Uncertainty Guided Tree Search for Hard Exploration

author.name: Zakaria Mhammedi, James Cohan

entry.summary: Proposes decoupling exploration from policy optimization in RL by using uncertainty-guided tree search during exploration phase, bypassing RL entirely for state coverage expansion.

entry.title: Expected Reward Prediction, with Applications to Model Routing

author.name: Kenan Hasanaliyev, Silas Alberti, Jenny Hamer, Dheeraj Rajagopal, Kevin Robinson, Jasper Snoek, Victor Veitch, Alexander Nicholas D'Amour

entry.summary: Studies lifting reward model scores to predict a model's expected reward before seeing responses, enabling a model routing protocol that routes prompts to maximize reward while controlling cost.

entry.title: Predictive Regularization Against Visual Representation Degradation in Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Enguang Wang, Qiang Wang, Yuanchen Wu, Ke Yan, Xinbin Yuan, Shouhong Ding, Xialei Liu, Ming-Ming Cheng

entry.summary: Diagnoses visual representation degradation in multimodal LLMs where language-driven training compromises visual fidelity, and proposes predictive regularization to maintain both global visual function and patch structure.

entry.title: A Comparative Analysis of LLM Memorization at Statistical and Internal Levels: Cross-Model Commonalities and Model-Specific Signatures

author.name: Bowen Chen, Namgi Han, Yusuke Miyao

entry.summary: Analyzes LLM memorization across multiple model series (Pythia, OpenLLaMa, StarCoder, OLMo) at statistical and internal levels. Finds memorization rate scales log-linearly with model size and identifies cross-model commonalities and model-specific signatures.

entry.title: The Dual Mechanisms of Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Kelly Cui, Nikhil Prakash, Ayush Raina, David Bau, Antonio Torralba, Tamar Rott Shaham

entry.summary: Investigates dual mechanisms of spatial reasoning in VLMs: content-independent spatial relations in language backbone and dominant spatial encoding in the vision encoder that directly influences outputs.

entry.title: The Anatomy of an Edit: Mechanism-Guided Activation Steering for Knowledge Editing

author.name: Yuan Cao, Mingyang Wang, Hinrich Sch\"utze

entry.summary: Takes a mechanistic view of knowledge editing using post-edit neuron-level attribution. Finds consistent pattern: mid-to-late attention promotes new targets while attention and FFN cooperate to suppress original facts. Proposes mechanism-guided activation steering.

entry.title: Taming Sampling Perturbations with Variance Expansion Loss for Latent Diffusion Models

author.name: Qifan Li, Xingyu Zhou, Jinhua Zhang, Weiyi You, Shuhang Gu

entry.summary: Identifies that β-VAE tokenizers in latent diffusion models create overly compact latent manifolds sensitive to sampling perturbations. Proposes a variance expansion loss to improve robustness, addressing an overlooked factor in generation quality.

entry.title: FluidGaussian: Propagating Simulation-Based Uncertainty Toward Functionally-Intelligent 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Yuqiu Liu, Jialin Song, Marissa Ramirez de Chanlatte, Rochishnu Chowdhury, Rushil Paresh Desai, Wuyang Chen, Daniel Martin, Michael Mahoney

entry.summary: Introduces FluidGaussian, which propagates simulation-based uncertainty through 3D Gaussian reconstruction to identify function-critical regions. Uses physics simulations (e.g., fluid dynamics) to assess reconstruction quality beyond visual fidelity.

entry.title: PROBE: Diagnosing Residual Concept Capacity in Erased Text-to-Video Diffusion Models

author.name: Yiwei Xie, Zheng Zhang, Ping Liu

entry.summary: Introduces PROBE, a diagnostic protocol to quantify the reactivation potential of erased concepts in text-to-video diffusion models, showing that current concept erasure methods may not truly remove concept representations.

entry.title: Speed by Simplicity: A Single-Stream Architecture for Fast Audio-Video Generative Foundation Model

author.name: SII-GAIR, Sand. ai, :, Ethan Chern, Hansi Teng, Hanwen Sun, Hao Wang, Hong Pan, Hongyu Jia, Jiadi Su, Jin Li, Junjie Yu, Lijie Liu, Lingzhi Li, Lyumanshan Ye, Min Hu, Qiangang Wang, Quanwei Qi, Steffi Chern, Tao Bu, Taoran Wang, Teren Xu, Tianning Zhang, Tiantian Mi, Weixian Xu, Wenqiang Zhang, Wentai Zhang, Xianping Yi, Xiaojie Cai, Xiaoyang Kang, Yan Ma, Yixiu Liu, Yunbo Zhang, Yunpeng Huang, Yutong Lin, Zewei Tao, Zhaoliang Liu, Zheng Zhang, Zhiyao Cen, Zhixuan Yu, Zhongshu Wang, Zhulin Hu, Zijin Zhou, Zinan Guo, Yue Cao, Pengfei Liu

entry.summary: Presents daVinci-MagiHuman, an open-source single-stream Transformer for joint audio-video generation of human-centric content. Uses unified token sequence with self-attention only, supporting multilingual spoken generation.

entry.title: UniDex: A Robot Foundation Suite for Universal Dexterous Hand Control from Egocentric Human Videos

author.name: Gu Zhang, Qicheng Xu, Haozhe Zhang, Jianhan Ma, Long He, Yiming Bao, Zeyu Ping, Zhecheng Yuan, Chenhao Lu, Chengbo Yuan, Tianhai Liang, Xiaoyu Tian, Maanping Shao, Feihong Zhang, Mingyu Ding, Yang Gao, Hao Zhao, Hang Zhao, Huazhe Xu

entry.summary: UniDex provides a robot foundation suite with a 50K+ trajectory dataset across 8 dexterous hands (6-24 DoFs) derived from egocentric human videos, plus a unified VLA policy for universal dexterous control. Uses human-in-the-loop retargeting from video.

entry.title: Is Monitoring Enough? Strategic Agent Selection For Stealthy Attack in Multi-Agent Discussions

author.name: Qiuchi Xiang, Haoxuan Qu, Hossein Rahmani, Jun Liu

entry.summary: Studies attacks on multi-agent discussions under monitoring constraints, showing that existing attacks fail when anomaly detectors monitor communications, then develops a novel stealthy attack method that evades such monitoring.

entry.title: What Do World Models Learn in RL? Probing Latent Representations in Learned Environment Simulators

author.name: Xinyu Zhang

entry.summary: Applies interpretability techniques (probing, causal interventions, attention analysis) to world models IRIS and DIAMOND trained on Atari, finding they develop approximately linear representations of game state that causally influence predictions.

entry.title: Diffusion Model for Manifold Data: Score Decomposition, Curvature, and Statistical Complexity

author.name: Zixuan Zhang, Kaixuan Huang, Tuo Zhao, Mengdi Wang, Minshuo Chen

entry.summary: Investigates how diffusion models learn data on low-dimensional manifolds, revealing score function decompositions under different noise levels and the interplay of manifold curvature with score structure, enabling efficient neural network approximation.

entry.title: Relax Forcing: Relaxed KV-Memory for Consistent Long Video Generation

author.name: Zengqun Zhao, Yanzuo Lu, Ziquan Liu, Jifei Song, Jiankang Deng, Ioannis Patras

entry.summary: Proposes Relax Forcing for long video generation, showing that progressive temporal degradation in autoregressive video diffusion is caused by how temporal memory is utilized during inference, not insufficient memory. Uses relaxed KV-memory for consistent generation.

entry.title: AgentComm-Bench: Stress-Testing Cooperative Embodied AI Under Latency, Packet Loss, and Bandwidth Collapse

author.name: Aayam Bansal, Ishaan Gangwani

entry.summary: Introduces AgentComm-Bench, a benchmark for stress-testing cooperative embodied AI under realistic communication impairments including latency, packet loss, and bandwidth collapse across six dimensions.

entry.title: Where can AI be used? Insights from a deep ontology of work activities

author.name: Alice Cai, Iman YeckehZaare, Shuo Sun, Vasiliki Charisi, Xinru Wang, Aiman Imran, Robert Laubacher, Alok Prakash, Thomas W. Malone

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive ontology of work activities by reorganizing the O*NET database to systematically analyze where AI can be used. Classifies 13,275 AI software applications and 20.8 million robotic systems against this framework.

entry.title: Can we automatize scientific discovery in the cognitive sciences?

author.name: Akshay K. Jagadish, Milena Rmus, Kristin Witte, Marvin Mathony, Marcel Binz, Eric Schulz

entry.summary: Proposes fully automated cognitive science research using LLMs for every stage: designing experiments, generating synthetic behavioral data, and discovering computational models in silico.

entry.title: The Library Theorem: How External Organization Governs Agentic Reasoning Capacity

author.name: Zachary F. Mainen

entry.summary: Proves that tool-augmented agents with indexed external memory achieve exponentially lower retrieval cost than sequential scanning agents, formalizing this as the 'Library Theorem' with empirical validation.

entry.title: RoboAlign: Learning Test-Time Reasoning for Language-Action Alignment in Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Dongyoung Kim, Sumin Park, Woomin Song, Seungku Kim, Taeyoung Kim, Huiwon Jang, Jinwoo Shin, Jaehyung Kim, Younggyo Seo

entry.summary: Proposes RoboAlign, a framework for training VLAs that samples action tokens via natural language reasoning and refines this using RL to improve language-action alignment, addressing instability in prior approaches.

entry.title: A Multidisciplinary AI Board for Multimodal Dementia Characterization and Risk Assessment

author.name: Sheng Liu, Long Chen, Zeyun Zhao, Qinglin Gou, Qingyue Wei, Arjun Masurkar, Kevin M. Spiegler, Philip Kuball, Stefania C. Bray, Megan Bernath, Deanna R. Willis, Jiang Bian, Lei Xing, Eric Topol, Kyunghyun Cho, Yu Huang, Ruogu Fang, Narges Razavian, James Zou

entry.summary: Presents Cerebra, an interactive multi-agent AI team for dementia characterization that coordinates EHR, clinical notes, and imaging analysis agents with a clinician-facing dashboard, supporting privacy-preserving deployment.

entry.title: Deterministic Hallucination Detection in Medical VQA via Confidence-Evidence Bayesian Gain

author.name: Mohammad Asadi, Tahoura Nedaee, Jack W. O'Sullivan, Euan Ashley, Ehsan Adeli

entry.summary: Proposes a deterministic hallucination detection method for medical VQA that identifies inconsistent confidence and weak evidence grounding in model log-probabilities, avoiding expensive stochastic generation methods.

entry.title: Reasoning or Rhetoric? An Empirical Analysis of Moral Reasoning Explanations in Large Language Models

author.name: Aryan Kasat, Smriti Singh, Aman Chadha, Vinija Jain

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLM moral reasoning reflects genuine developmental progression through Kohlberg's stages or merely alignment-produced rhetoric. Analyzes 600+ responses from 13 LLMs across six moral dilemmas using LLM-as-judge scoring.

entry.title: RedacBench: Can AI Erase Your Secrets?

author.name: Hyunjun Jeon, Kyuyoung Kim, Jinwoo Shin

entry.summary: Introduces RedacBench, a benchmark for evaluating policy-conditioned redaction across domains and strategies, using 514 human-authored texts paired with 187 security policies to measure selective information removal.

entry.title: Locally Coherent Parallel Decoding in Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Michael Hersche, Nicolas Menet, Ronan Tanios, Abbas Rahimi

entry.summary: Introduces CoDiLA, a method for diffusion language models that reconciles parallel sampling with local dependency modeling through local autoregression, addressing syntactic inconsistencies in parallel token generation.

entry.title: Deciphering Scientific Reasoning Steps from Outcome Data for Molecule Optimization

author.name: Zequn Liu, Kehan Wu, Shufang Xie, Zekun Guo, Wei Zhang, Tao Qin, Renhe Liu, Yingce Xia

entry.summary: Proposes DESRO, a framework for deciphering scientific reasoning steps from outcome data by analyzing shared patterns in grouped molecular property records. Applied to molecule optimization for drug discovery, inferring optimization rationales from 2.3M records.

entry.title: When Agents Disagree: The Selection Bottleneck in Multi-Agent LLM Pipelines

author.name: Artem Maryanskyy

entry.summary: Identifies the 'selection bottleneck' in multi-agent LLM pipelines, finding a closed-form crossover threshold that determines whether team diversity helps or hurts output quality based on aggregation method.

entry.title: Procedural Refinement by LLM-driven Algorithmic Debugging for ARC-AGI-2

author.name: Yu-Ning Qiu, Lin-Feng Zou, Jiong-Da Wang, Xue-Rong Yuan, Wang-Zhou Dai

entry.summary: Proposes ABPR, a neuro-symbolic approach coupling LLMs with meta-interpreters for algorithmic debugging on ARC-AGI-2 tasks, using Shapiro's theory of algorithmic program debugging for procedural refinement.

entry.title: WebNavigator: Global Web Navigation via Interaction Graph Retrieval

author.name: Xuanwang Zhang, Yuteng Han, Jinnan Qi, Mulong Xie, Zhen Wu, Xinyu Dai

entry.summary: Introduces WebNavigator, which reframes web navigation from probabilistic exploration to deterministic retrieval by constructing Interaction Graphs offline and implementing a Retrieve-Reason-Teleport workflow for global navigation.

entry.title: Delightful Distributed Policy Gradient

author.name: Ian Osband

entry.summary: Introduces Delightful Policy Gradient (DG) that separates high-surprisal failures from high-surprisal successes in distributed RL by gating updates with 'delight' (product of advantage and surprisal), improving robustness to stale/mismatched actor data.

entry.title: MKA: Memory-Keyed Attention for Efficient Long-Context Reasoning

author.name: Dong Liu, Yanxuan Yu, Ben Lengerich, Ying Nian Wu

entry.summary: Proposes Memory-Keyed Attention (MKA), a hierarchical attention mechanism integrating local, session, and long-term KV caches with learned dynamic routing, plus a broadcast-routed variant (FastMKA) for efficiency.

entry.title: REVERE: Reflective Evolving Research Engineer for Scientific Workflows

author.name: Balaji Dinesh Gangireddi, Aniketh Garikaparthi, Manasi Patwardhan, Arman Cohan

entry.summary: Introduces REVERE, a framework for AI research coding agents that continuously learns from cross-repository execution trajectories, distilling recurring failure modes into reusable heuristics for better generalization.

entry.title: Reasoning Topology Matters: Network-of-Thought for Complex Reasoning Tasks

author.name: Fan Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Network-of-Thought (NoT), a framework modeling LLM reasoning as a directed graph with typed nodes and edges, guided by heuristic controllers. Tests across four benchmarks and three models to investigate when network topology outperforms chains or trees.

entry.title: Semantic Sections: An Atlas-Native Feature Ontology for Obstructed Representation Spaces

author.name: Hossein Javidnia

entry.summary: Introduces 'semantic sections' as an atlas-native feature ontology for interpretability, formalizing features as transport-compatible families of local representatives over context atlases. Distinguishes tree-local, globalizable, and twisted sections.

entry.title: How AI Systems Think About Education: Analyzing Latent Preference Patterns in Large Language Models

author.name: Daniel Autenrieth

entry.summary: First systematic measurement of educational alignment in LLMs, testing GPT-5.1 with a 48-item Delphi-validated instrument across eight educational dimensions. Finds the model exhibits highly coherent preferences aligned with humanistic education where expert consensus exists, but diverges where human experts themselves disagree.

entry.title: DSL-R1: From SQL to DSL for Training Retrieval Agents across Structured and Unstructured Data with Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yunhai Hu, Junwei Zhou, Yumo Cao, Yitao Long, Yiwei Xu, Qiyi Jiang, Weiyao Wang, Xiaoyu Cao, Zhen Sun, Yiran Zou, Nan Du

entry.summary: Proposes DSL-R1, a framework that unifies structured metadata filtering and vector similarity search via a novel Domain-Specific Language embedding vector primitives within SQL-style operators. Uses reinforcement learning with execution feedback and retrieval quality rewards to optimize DSL generation.

entry.title: Reward Sharpness-Aware Fine-Tuning for Diffusion Models

author.name: Kwanyoung Kim, Byeongsu Sim

entry.summary: Introduces reward sharpness-aware fine-tuning for diffusion models to mitigate reward hacking in RLHF-style training, showing that vulnerability arises from non-robust reward model gradients in sharp reward landscapes.

entry.title: KG-Hopper: Empowering Compact Open LLMs with Knowledge Graph Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Shuai Wang, Yinan Yu

entry.summary: Proposes KG-Hopper, an RL framework enabling compact open LLMs to perform integrated multi-hop knowledge graph reasoning in a single inference round, rather than sequential step-by-step reasoning that causes error cascades.

entry.title: Quotient Geometry, Effective Curvature, and Implicit Bias in Simple Shallow Neural Networks

author.name: Hang-Cheng Dong, Pengcheng Cheng

entry.summary: Develops a differential-geometric framework for analyzing shallow neural networks through quotient spaces obtained by modding out parameter symmetries, showing that Euclidean geometry can mislead about network properties.

entry.title: mSFT: Addressing Dataset Mixtures Overfiting Heterogeneously in Multi-task SFT

author.name: Woosung Koh, Jeyoung Jeon, Youngjin Song, Yujin Cheon, Soowon Oh, Jaehyeong Choi, Se-Young Yun

entry.summary: Introduces mSFT, an iterative overfitting-aware search algorithm for multi-task SFT data mixtures that identifies and excludes earliest-overfitting sub-datasets, reverting to optimal checkpoints before continuing.

entry.title: Rethinking Token Reduction for Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Yi Wang, Haofei Zhang, Qihan Huang, Anda Cao, Gongfan Fang, Wei Wang, Xuan Jin, Jie Song, Mingli Song, Xinchao Wang
