entry.title: RuntimeSlicer: Towards Generalizable Unified Runtime State Representation for Failure Management

author.name: Lingzhe Zhang, Tong Jia, Weijie Hong, Mingyu Wang, Chiming Duan, Minghua He, Rongqian Wang, Xi Peng, Meiling Wang, Gong Zhang, Renhai Chen, Ying Li

entry.summary: Proposes RuntimeSlicer, a unified runtime state representation model that pre-trains a task-agnostic model encoding metrics, traces, and logs into a single aligned representation for generalizable failure management.

entry.title: Optimizing Feature Extraction for On-device Model Inference with User Behavior Sequences

author.name: Chen Gong, Zhenzhe Zheng, Yiliu Chen, Sheng Wang, Fan Wu, Guihai Chen

entry.summary: Introduces AutoFeature, an automated feature extraction engine that identifies and eliminates redundant extraction operations across model features and consecutive inferences, addressing an overlooked bottleneck in on-device model execution.

entry.title: FISformer: Replacing Self-Attention with a Fuzzy Inference System in Transformer Models for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Bulent Haznedar, Levent Karacan

entry.title: CoNBONet: Conformalized Neuroscience-inspired Bayesian Operator Network for Reliability Analysis

author.name: Shailesh Garg, Souvik Chakraborty

entry.title: LipsAM: Lipschitz-Continuous Amplitude Modifier for Audio Signal Processing and its Application to Plug-and-Play Dereverberation

author.name: Kazuki Matsumoto, Ren Uchida, Kohei Yatabe

entry.title: MAGPI: Multifidelity-Augmented Gaussian Process Inputs for Surrogate Modeling from Scarce Data

author.name: Atticus Rex, Elizabeth Qian, David Peterson

entry.summary: Introduces MAGPI, a multifidelity approach that augments Gaussian process inputs with low-fidelity model outputs to improve surrogate modeling from scarce high-fidelity data.

entry.summary: Proposes Clifford-M, a lightweight backbone for multi-label fundus diagnosis using Clifford algebra for geometric feature decoupling, replacing both feed-forward expansion and frequency-splitting modules.

entry.title: Fast and Robust Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting

entry.title: FinRL-X: An AI-Native Modular Infrastructure for Quantitative Trading

author.name: Hongyang Yang, Boyu Zhang, Yang She, Xinyu Liao, Xiaoli Zhang

entry.summary: Presents FinRL-X, a modular trading architecture unifying data processing, strategy construction, backtesting, and broker execution. Supports both rule-based and AI-driven components including RL allocators and LLM sentiment signals.

entry.title: TaigiSpeech: A Low-Resource Real-World Speech Intent Dataset and Preliminary Results with Scalable Data Mining In-the-Wild

author.name: Kai-Wei Chang, Yi-Cheng Lin, Huang-Cheng Chou, Wenze Ren, Yu-Han Huang, Yun-Shao Tsai, Chien-Cheng Chen, Yu Tsao, Yuan-Fu Liao, Shrikanth Narayanan, James Glass, Hung-yi Lee

entry.summary: Introduces TaigiSpeech, a real-world speech intent dataset for Taiwanese Taigi collected from older adults (21 speakers, 3K utterances). Explores data mining strategies to address labeled data scarcity for this low-resource spoken language.

entry.title: Feature Incremental Clustering with Generalization Bounds

author.name: Jing Zhang, Chenping Hou

entry.summary: Addresses feature incremental clustering where attributes accumulate over time in expanding feature spaces. Provides theoretical generalization bounds for the proposed algorithm.

entry.title: Rateless DeepJSCC for Broadcast Channels: a Rate-Distortion-Complexity Tradeoff

author.name: Zijun Qin, Jingxuan Huang, Zesong Fei, Haichuan Ding, Yulin Shao, Xianhao Chen

entry.summary: Introduces NTRSCC, a variable-length deep joint source-channel coding framework for broadcast channels using rateless codes and learned source transformations. Addresses the rate-distortion-complexity tradeoff.

entry.title: A plug-and-play approach with fast uncertainty quantification for weak lensing mass mapping

author.name: Hubert Leterme, Andreas Tersenov, Jalal Fadili, Jean-Luc Starck

entry.summary: Proposes a plug-and-play approach with fast uncertainty quantification for weak lensing mass mapping, relevant for upcoming Euclid and Rubin surveys. Avoids slow MCMC sampling while providing coverage guarantees.

entry.title: Data Curation for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials by Determinantal Point Processes

author.name: Joanna Zou, Youssef Marzouk

entry.summary: Applies determinantal point processes (DPPs) for selecting informative atomic configurations to label for machine learning interatomic potentials. Shows DPPs are competitive for building compact training sets.

entry.title: Linguistic Signatures for Enhanced Emotion Detection

author.name: Florian Lecourt (LIRMM | ADVANSE), Madalina Croitoru (LIRMM), Konstantin Todorov (WEB3)

entry.summary: Examines whether linguistic features can serve as reliable interpretable signals for emotion recognition. RoBERTa models enriched with linguistic features achieve up to +2.4 macro F1 gains on GoEmotions.

entry.title: A Modular LLM Framework for Explainable Price Outlier Detection

author.name: Shadi Sartipi, John Wu, Sina Ghotbi, Nikhita Vedula, Shervin Malmasi

entry.summary: Proposes a modular LLM framework for explainable price outlier detection in retail/e-commerce. Uses three-stage agentic approach: relevance classification, utility assessment, and price evaluation.

entry.title: Optimizing Multi-Agent Weather Captioning via Text Gradient Descent: A Training-Free Approach with Consensus-Aware Gradient Fusion

author.name: Shixu Liu

entry.summary: Introduces WeatherTGD, a training-free multi-agent framework for weather time series captioning using Text Gradient Descent. Deploys three specialized LLM agents for statistical, physics, and synthesis analysis.

entry.title: Multiperspectivity as a Resource for Narrative Similarity Prediction

author.name: Max Upravitelev, Veronika Solopova, Jing Yang, Charlott Jakob, Premtim Sahitaj, Ariana Sahitaj, Vera Schmitt

entry.summary: Proposes using multiperspectivity (ensemble of 31 LLM personas) for narrative similarity prediction, arguing that divergent interpretations should be incorporated rather than resolved. Tested on SemEval-2026 Task 4.

entry.title: Which Workloads Belong in Orbit? A Workload-First Framework for Orbital Data Centers Using Semantic Abstraction

author.name: Durgendra Narayan Singh

entry.summary: Proposes a workload-centric framework for deciding which AI tasks belong in orbital data centers vs. terrestrial cloud. Demonstrates 99.7-99.99% payload reduction through semantic abstraction of satellite imagery.

entry.title: NCSTR: Node-Centric Decoupled Spatio-Temporal Reasoning for Video-based Human Pose Estimation

author.name: Quang Dang Huynh, Xuefei Yin, Andrew Busch, Hugo G. Espinosa, Alan Wee-Chung Liew, Matthew T. O. Worsey, Yanming Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes NCSTR, a node-centric framework for video-based human pose estimation that decouples visual, temporal, and structural reasoning with explicit joint topology modeling.

entry.title: Thermal is Always Wild: Characterizing and Addressing Challenges in Thermal-Only Novel View Synthesis

author.name: M. Kerem Aydin, Vishwanath Saragadam, Emma Alexander

entry.summary: Characterizes unique challenges of thermal-only novel view synthesis (low dynamic range, photometric fluctuations) and proposes solutions including calibration and anti-floater strategies.

entry.title: IBCapsNet: Information Bottleneck Capsule Network for Noise-Robust Representation Learning

author.name: Canqun Xiang, Chen Yang, Jiaoyan Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes IBCapsNet, a capsule network using information bottleneck principle with one-pass variational aggregation instead of iterative routing, improving efficiency and noise robustness.

entry.title: VSD-MOT: End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking in Low-Quality Video Scenes Guided by Visual Semantic Distillation

author.name: Jun Du

entry.summary: Proposes VSD-MOT, a multi-object tracking framework using CLIP-based visual semantic distillation to handle low-quality video scenarios where conventional trackers fail.

entry.title: SATTC: Structure-Aware Label-Free Test-Time Calibration for Cross-Subject EEG-to-Image Retrieval

author.name: Qunjie Huang, Weina Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces SATTC for cross-subject EEG-to-image retrieval, combining geometric and structural calibration experts to address subject shift and hubness in embedding space.

entry.title: Lean Learning Beyond Clouds: Efficient Discrepancy-Conditioned Optical-SAR Fusion for Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Chenxing Meng, Wuzhou Quan, Yingjie Cai, Liqun Cao, Liyan Zhang, Mingqiang Wei

entry.summary: Proposes a discrepancy-conditioned optical-SAR fusion method for semantic segmentation under cloud occlusion, achieving efficient global modeling without indiscriminate noise propagation.

entry.title: Single-Eye View: Monocular Real-time Perception Package for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Haixi Zhang, Aiyinsi Zuo, Zirui Li, Chunshu Wu, Tong Geng, Zhiyao Duan

entry.summary: Proposes LRHPerception, a real-time monocular perception package for autonomous driving combining object tracking, road segmentation, and depth estimation into a unified efficient framework.

entry.title: ReDiffuse: Rotation Equivariant Diffusion Model for Multi-focus Image Fusion

author.name: Bo Li, Tingting Bao, Lingling Zhang, Weiping Fu, Yaxian Wang, Jun Liu

entry.summary: Proposes ReDiffuse, a rotation-equivariant diffusion model for multi-focus image fusion that preserves geometric structure consistency. Addresses the challenge of defocus blur causing warped geometric patterns in fused images.

entry.title: CornOrb: A Multimodal Dataset of Orbscan Corneal Topography and Clinical Annotations for Keratoconus Detection

author.name: Mohammed El Amine Lazouni, Leila Ryma Lazouni, Zineb Aziza Elaouaber, Mohammed Ammar, Sofiane Zehar, Mohammed Youcef Bouayad Agha, Ahmed Lazouni, Amel Feroui, Ali H. Al-Timemy, Siamak Yousefi, Mostafa El Habib Daho

entry.summary: Presents CornOrb, a publicly accessible multimodal dataset of 1,454 eyes with Orbscan corneal topography images and clinical annotations for keratoconus detection, collected from patients in Algeria.

entry.title: Respiratory Status Detection with Video Transformers

author.name: Thomas Savage, Evan Madill

entry.summary: Evaluates video transformers for respiratory status detection from video, using healthy volunteers recovering from exercise to create a labeled dataset for respiratory distress classification.

entry.title: HACMatch Semi-Supervised Rotation Regression with Hardness-Aware Curriculum Pseudo Labeling

author.name: Mei Li, Huayi Zhou, Suizhi Huang, Yuxiang Lu, Yue Ding, Hongtao Lu

entry.summary: Proposes HACMatch for semi-supervised 3D rotation regression using hardness-aware curriculum pseudo labeling, improving upon entropy-based filtering for distinguishing reliable and unreliable samples.

entry.title: Multi-View Deformable Convolution Meets Visual Mamba for Coronary Artery Segmentation

author.name: Xiaochan Yuan, Pai Zeng

entry.summary: Combines multi-view deformable convolutions with Visual Mamba for coronary artery segmentation from CTA images, addressing long-range dependencies with lower computational cost than ViT approaches.

entry.title: Deep S2P: Integrating Learning Based Stereo Matching Into the Satellite Stereo Pipeline

author.name: El\'ias Masquil, Thibaud Ehret, Pablo Mus\'e, Gabriele Facciolo

entry.summary: Integrates modern learning-based stereo matchers (StereoAnywhere, MonSter, Foundation Stereo) into the Satellite Stereo Pipeline (S2P), adapting the rectification stage for compatible disparities. This bridges the gap between SOTA stereo methods and operational satellite imagery pipelines.

entry.title: Biophysics-Enhanced Neural Representations for Patient-Specific Respiratory Motion Modeling

author.name: Jan Boysen, Hristina Uzunova, Heinz Handels, Jan Ehrhardt

entry.summary: Proposes PRISM-RM, using implicit neural representations with physics regularization for patient-specific respiratory motion modeling in radiotherapy, eliminating the need for a fixed reference breathing state.

entry.title: ToFormer: Towards Large-scale Scenario Depth Completion for Lightweight ToF Camera

author.name: Juncheng Chen, Tiancheng Lai, Xingpeng Wang, Bingxin Liao, Baozhe Zhang, Chao Xu, Yanjun Cao

entry.summary: Proposes ToFormer for depth completion in large-scale scenarios for short-range ToF cameras, including a new multi-sensor dataset (LASER) and a transformer-based architecture.

entry.title: OrbitStream: Training-Free Adaptive 360-degree Video Streaming via Semantic Potential Fields

author.name: Aizierjiang Aiersilan, Zhangfei Yang

entry.summary: Proposes OrbitStream, a training-free 360° video streaming framework combining semantic potential fields for viewport prediction with robust control theory for bitrate adaptation.

entry.title: Anatomical Prior-Driven Framework for Autonomous Robotic Cardiac Ultrasound Standard View Acquisition

author.name: Zhiyan Cao, Zhengxi Wu, Yiwei Wang, Pei-Hsuan Lin, Li Zhang, Zhen Xie, Huan Zhao, Han Ding

entry.title: ADaFuSE: Adaptive Diffusion-generated Image and Text Fusion for Interactive Text-to-Image Retrieval

entry.title: Current state of the multi-agent multi-view experimental and digital twin rendezvous (MMEDR-Autonomous) framework

author.name: Logan Banker, Michael Wozniak, Mohanad Alameer, Smriti Nandan Paul, David Meisinger, Grant Baer, Trevor Hunting, Ryan Dunham, Jay Kamdar

entry.summary: Introduces the MMEDR-Autonomous framework combining learning-based optical navigation, RL-based guidance, and digital twin capabilities for autonomous space rendezvous and docking.

entry.title: LASER: Level-Based Asynchronous Scheduling and Execution Regime for Spatiotemporally Constrained Multi-Robot Timber Manufacturing

author.name: Zhenxiang Huang, Lior Skoury, Tim Stark, Aaron Wagner, Hans Jakob Wagner, Thomas Wortmann, Achim Menges

entry.title: Evaluating Factor-Wise Auxiliary Dynamics Supervision for Latent Structure and Robustness in Simulated Humanoid Locomotion

entry.title: RTD-RAX: Fast, Safe Trajectory Planning for Systems under Unknown Disturbances

author.name: Evanns Morales-Cuadrado, Long Kiu Chung, Shreyas Kousik, Samuel Coogan

entry.title: IGV-RRT: Prior-Real-Time Observation Fusion for Active Object Search in Changing Environments

entry.title: From Singleton Obstacles to Clutter: Translation Invariant Compositional Avoid Sets

entry.title: Generative Diffusion Model for Risk-Neutral Derivative Pricing

author.name: Nilay Tiwari

entry.title: Identification of physiological shock in intensive care units via Bayesian regime switching models

author.name: Emmett B. Kendall, Jonathan P. Williams, Curtis B. Storlie, Misty A. Radosevich, Erica D. Wittwer, Matthew A. Warner

entry.summary: Develops a Bayesian regime switching model for early detection of occult hemorrhage in ICU patients by analyzing trends in vitals and labs, providing probabilistic assessment of underlying physiological states.

entry.title: Modeling Epistemic Uncertainty in Social Perception via Rashomon Set Agents

author.name: Jinming Yang, Xinyu Jiang, Xinshan Jiao, Xinping Zhang

entry.title: A Multihead Continual Learning Framework for Fine-Grained Fashion Image Retrieval with Contrastive Learning and Exponential Moving Average Distillation

author.name: Ling Xiao, Toshihiko Yamasaki

entry.title: Enhancing LIME using Neural Decision Trees

author.name: Mohamed Aymen Bouyahia, Argyris Kalogeratos

entry.title: Learning Progressive Adaptation for Multi-Modal Tracking

author.name: He Wang, Tianyang Xu, Zhangyong Tang, Xiao-Jun Wu, Josef Kittler

entry.summary: Proposes PATrack for multi-modal tracking with progressive adaptation of RGB pre-trained models, incorporating modality-dependent, modality-entangled, and task-level adapters.

entry.title: An InSAR Phase Unwrapping Framework for Large-scale and Complex Events

author.name: Yijia Song, Juliet Biggs, Alin Achim, Robert Popescu, Simon Orrego, Nantheera Anantrasirichai

entry.title: Spatio-Temporal Attention Enhanced Multi-Agent DRL for UAV-Assisted Wireless Networks with Limited Communications

author.name: Che Chen, Lanhua Li, Shimin Gong, Yu Zhao, Yuming Fang, Dusit Niyato

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent DRL framework for UAV-assisted wireless networks with limited communications, using spatio-temporal attention to handle delayed and lost information among cooperating UAVs.

entry.title: Transparent Fragments Contour Estimation via Visual-Tactile Fusion for Autonomous Reassembly

author.name: Qihao Lin, Borui Chen, Yuping Zhou, Jianing Wu, Yulan Guo, Weishi Zheng, Chongkun Xia

entry.title: End-to-End Optimization of Polarimetric Measurement and Material Classifier

author.name: Ryota Maeda, Naoki Arikawa, Yutaka No, Shinsaku Hiura

entry.summary: Proposes end-to-end optimization of polarimetric measurement and material classification, jointly learning optimal polarization states and classifier for efficient material recognition.

entry.title: Cross-modal Fuzzy Alignment Network for Text-Aerial Person Retrieval and A Large-scale Benchmark

author.name: Yifei Deng, Chenglong Li, Yuyang Zhang, Guyue Hu, Jin Tang

entry.summary: Proposes a cross-modal fuzzy alignment network for text-aerial person retrieval from UAV images, using fuzzy logic for token-level reliability and ground-view images as bridge agents.

entry.title: FontCrafter: High-Fidelity Element-Driven Artistic Font Creation with Visual In-Context Generation

author.name: Wuyang Luo, Chengkai Tan, Chang Ge, Binye Hong, Su Yang, Yongjiu Ma

entry.summary: Introduces FontCrafter for element-driven artistic font generation with a large-scale ElementFont dataset. Uses visual in-context generation to handle both structured object and amorphous texture elements.

entry.title: Cross-Modal Reinforcement Learning for Navigation with Degraded Depth Measurements

author.name: Omkar Sawant, Luca Zanatta, Grzegorz Malczyk, Kostas Alexis

entry.summary: Presents a cross-modal learning framework using a Wasserstein Autoencoder to learn shared representations between depth and grayscale images, enabling robust navigation when depth sensors degrade due to adverse conditions.

entry.title: Feasibility of Augmented Reality-Guided Robotic Ultrasound with Cone-Beam CT Integration for Spine Procedures

author.name: Tianyu Song, Felix Pabst, Feng Li, Yordanka Velikova, Miruna-Alexandra Gafencu, Yuan Bi, Ulrich Eck, Nassir Navab

entry.summary: Demonstrates feasibility of an augmented reality-guided robotic ultrasound system integrated with cone-beam CT for spine procedures, providing in situ 3D visualization to support needle trajectory planning with reduced radiation exposure.

entry.title: Unfolding with a Wasserstein Loss

author.name: Katy Craig, Benjamin Faktor, Benjamin Nachman

entry.summary: Studies data unfolding using Wasserstein loss as an alternative to the standard KL divergence in Richardson-Lucy deconvolution, establishing sharp conditions for existence and uniqueness without requiring binning of the data.

entry.title: Governance-Aware Vector Subscriptions for Multi-Agent Knowledge Ecosystems

author.name: Steven Johnson

entry.summary: Introduces governance-aware vector subscriptions that compose semantic similarity matching with multi-dimensional policy predicates for multi-agent knowledge ecosystems, addressing EU AI Act and DSM Directive compliance.

entry.title: Safety as Computation: Certified Answer Reuse via Capability Closure in Task-Oriented Dialogue

author.name: Cosimo Spera

entry.summary: Introduces certified answer reuse in task-oriented dialogue via capability closure, precomputing all derivable follow-up answers at each certified turn for sub-millisecond response times.

entry.title: Inference Energy and Latency in AI-Mediated Education: A Learning-per-Watt Analysis of Edge and Cloud Models

author.name: Kushal Khemani

entry.summary: Investigates energy, latency, and learning quality trade-offs for AI tutoring by comparing FP16 and NF4 quantized Phi-3 Mini inference on edge hardware, evaluated by teachers and frontier AI systems.

entry.title: Fusing Driver Perceived and Physical Risk for Safety Critical Scenario Screening in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Chen Xiong, Ziwen Wang, Deqi Wang, Cheng Wang, Yiyang Chen, He Zhang, Chao Gou

entry.summary: Proposes a driver risk fusion method for autonomous driving scenario screening that combines Driver Risk Field with dynamic cost models to generate risk supervision signals for efficient large-scale scenario mining.

entry.title: Graph-based data-driven discovery of interpretable laws governing corona-induced noise and radio interference for high-voltage transmission lines

author.name: Hao Xu, Yuntian Chen, Chongqing Kang, Dongxiao Zhang

entry.summary: Presents Mono-GraphMD, a monotonicity-constrained graph symbolic discovery framework for finding interpretable laws governing corona-induced noise and radio interference in ultra-high-voltage transmission lines.

entry.title: CTFS : Collaborative Teacher Framework for Forward-Looking Sonar Image Semantic Segmentation with Extremely Limited Labels

author.name: Ping Guo, Chengzhou Li, Guanchen Meng, Qi Jia, Jinyuan Liu, Zhu Liu, Yu Liu, Zhongxuan Luo, Xin Fan

entry.summary: Proposes a Collaborative Teacher Framework for forward-looking sonar image semantic segmentation with extremely limited labels, using multiple sonar-specific teachers alongside a general teacher to handle the unique challenges of sonar imagery.

entry.title: enhancing reasoning accuracy in large language models during inference time

author.name: Vinay Sharma, Manish Jain

entry.summary: Evaluates inference-time techniques for improving LLM reasoning: self-consistency via stochastic decoding, dual-model reasoning agreement, and self-reflection, without additional training.

entry.title: SmaAT-QMix-UNet: A Parameter-Efficient Vector-Quantized UNet for Precipitation Nowcasting

author.name: Nikolas Stavrou, Siamak Mehrkanoon

entry.summary: Presents SmaAT-QMix-UNet for precipitation nowcasting, introducing vector quantization bottleneck and mixed kernel depth-wise convolutions to reduce model size while improving forecast performance.

entry.title: Semi-Supervised Learning with Balanced Deep Representation Distributions

author.name: Changchun Li, Ximing Li, Bingjie Zhang, Wenting Wang, Jihong Ouyang

entry.summary: Applies angular margin loss with Gaussian linear transformations to achieve balanced label angle variances in semi-supervised text classification, addressing the margin bias problem from imbalanced representation distributions.

entry.title: Beyond a Single Signal: SPECTREG2, A Unified MultiExpert Anomaly Detector for Unknown Unknowns

author.name: Rahul D Ray

entry.summary: Introduces SPECTRE-G2, a multi-signal anomaly detector combining eight complementary signals from a dual-backbone neural network for detecting unknown unknowns.

entry.title: MIHT: A Hoeffding Tree for Time Series Classification using Multiple Instance Learning

author.name: Aurora Esteban, Amelia Zafra, Sebasti\'an Ventura

entry.summary: Introduces MIHT, a Hoeffding Tree algorithm that uses multi-instance learning to classify multivariate and variable-length time series by representing them as 'bags of subseries' with incremental decision trees.

entry.title: Solomonoff induction

author.name: Tom F. Sterkenburg

entry.summary: A theoretical chapter discussing Solomonoff induction and its limitations, including a generalized diagonalization argument showing the approach fails to meet computability desiderata for universal prediction.

entry.title: G2DR: A Genotype-First Framework for Genetics-Informed Target Prioritization and Drug Repurposing

author.name: Muhammad Muneeb, David B. Ascher

entry.summary: Presents G2DR, a genotype-first drug repurposing framework that propagates genetic variation through predicted expression, pathway enrichment, and druggability analysis, demonstrated in a migraine case study.

entry.title: Identifiability and amortized inference limitations in Kuramoto models

author.name: Emma Hannula, Jana de Wiljes, Matthew T. Moores, Heikki Haario, Lassi Roininen

entry.summary: Presents amortized Bayesian inference for Kuramoto oscillator networks using neural posterior approximation. Shows promising results but reveals fundamental identifiability limitations in coupling parameter estimation.

entry.title: ShapDBM: Exploring Decision Boundary Maps in Shapley Space

author.name: Luke Watkin, Daniel Archambault, Alex Telea

entry.summary: Proposes ShapDBM, computing Decision Boundary Maps in Shapley space for ML classifier visualization. Shows that transforming data to Shapley space yields more compact and interpretable decision zones.

entry.title: Reading Between the Lines: How Electronic Nonverbal Cues shape Emotion Decoding

author.name: Taara Kumar, Kokil Jaidka

entry.summary: Develops a taxonomy of electronic nonverbal cues (eNVCs) in text-based communication with a Python toolkit for detection. Conducts a survey experiment showing how eNVCs affect emotion perception.

entry.title: Remote Sensing Image Dehazing: A Systematic Review of Progress, Challenges, and Prospects

author.name: Heng Zhou, Xiaoxiong Liu, Zhenxi Zhang, Jieheng Yun, Chengyang Li, Yunchu Yang, Dongyi Xia, Chunna Tian, Xiao-Jun Wu

entry.summary: First systematic survey of remote sensing image dehazing, covering 30+ methods across CNNs, GANs, Transformers, and diffusion models. Includes large-scale experiments on 5 datasets with 12 metrics.

entry.title: PGR-Net: Prior-Guided ROI Reasoning Network for Brain Tumor MRI Segmentation

author.name: Jiacheng Lu, Hui Ding, Shiyu Zhang, Guoping Huo

entry.summary: Proposes PGR-Net for brain tumor MRI segmentation incorporating data-driven spatial priors to guide ROI reasoning, reducing redundant computation over background regions.

entry.title: Benchmarking Recurrent Event-Based Object Detection for Industrial Multi-Class Recognition on MTEvent

author.name: Lokeshwaran Manohar, Moritz Roidl

entry.summary: Benchmarks recurrent event-based object detection on MTEvent for industrial multi-class recognition, showing recurrent models provide modest improvement over non-recurrent baselines and that event-domain pretraining has stronger effect.

entry.title: 6D Robotic OCT Scanning of Curved Tissue Surfaces

author.name: Suresh Guttikonda, Maximilian Neidhardt, Vidas Raudonis, Alexander Schlaefer

entry.summary: Proposes a marker-based 6D hand-eye calibration approach for robot-mounted OCT probes, enabling scanning of curved tissue surfaces. Addresses limitations of translation-only scanning approaches.

entry.title: MEVIUS2: Practical Open-Source Quadruped Robot with Sheet Metal Welding and Multimodal Perception

author.name: Kento Kawaharazuka, Keita Yoneda, Shintaro Inoue, Temma Suzuki, Jun Oda, Kei Okada

entry.summary: MEVIUS2 is a practical open-source quadruped robot constructed via sheet metal welding rather than 3D printing, enabling larger, more structurally robust designs with multimodal perception capabilities.

entry.title: Neyman-Pearson multiclass classification under label noise via empirical likelihood

author.name: Qiong Zhang, Qinglong Tian, Pengfei Li

entry.summary: Studies the Neyman-Pearson multiclass classification problem when training labels are noisy, proposing an empirical likelihood method to handle label corruption while maintaining class-specific error probability bounds.

entry.title: Towards Intelligent Geospatial Data Discovery: a knowledge graph-driven multi-agent framework powered by large language models

author.name: Ruixiang Liu, Zhenlong Li, Ali Khosravi Kazazi

entry.summary: Proposes a knowledge graph-driven multi-agent framework for intelligent geospatial data discovery, using LLMs to align heterogeneous metadata standards across platforms.

entry.title: gUFO: A Gentle Foundational Ontology for Semantic Web Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Jo\~ao Paulo A. Almeida, Giancarlo Guizzardi, Tiago Prince Sales, Claudenir M. Fonseca

entry.summary: Presents gUFO, a lightweight OWL 2 DL implementation of the Unified Foundational Ontology (UFO) for Semantic Web knowledge graphs, currently being standardized as ISO/IEC CD 21838-5.

entry.title: Is the future of AI green? What can innovation diffusion models say about generative AI's environmental impact?

author.name: Robert Viseur, Nicolas Jullien

entry.summary: Analyzes generative AI's environmental impact using the A-U innovation diffusion model, arguing that product evolution and optimization may moderate environmental concerns though GAI will never be 'green'.

entry.title: A Blueprint for Self-Evolving Coding Agents in Vehicle Aerodynamic Drag Prediction

author.name: Jinhui Ren, Huaiming Li, Yabin Liu, Tao Li, Zhaokun Liu, Yujia Liang, Zengle Ge, Chufan Wu, Xiaomin Yuan, Danyu Liu, Annan Li, Jianmin Wu

entry.summary: Presents a blueprint for self-evolving coding agents that discover surrogate pipelines for predicting vehicle aerodynamic drag coefficients. Uses population-based island evolution with structured mutations and multi-objective selection under industrial constraints.

entry.title: Your Robot Will Feel You Now: Empathy in Robots and Embodied Agents

author.name: Angelica Lim, \"O. Nilay Yal\c{c}in

entry.summary: Reviews the implementation of empathy in robots and embodied conversational agents, covering multimodal social/emotional intelligence and discussing lessons for today's language-based agents like ChatGPT.

entry.title: Measuring Research Convergence in Interdisciplinary Teams Using Large Language Models and Graph Analytics

author.name: Wenwen Li, Yuanyuan Tian, Sizhe Wang, Amber Wutich, Paul Westerhoff, Sarah Porter, Anais Roque, Jobayer Hossain, Patrick Thomson, Rhett Larson, Michael Hanemann

entry.summary: Presents an AI-driven framework using LLMs and graph analytics to measure research convergence in interdisciplinary teams, using the NABC framework to extract structured viewpoints and analyze their integration over time.

entry.title: Emergency Lane-Change Simulation: A Behavioral Guidance Approach for Risky Scenario Generation

author.name: Chen Xiong, Cheng Wang, Yuhang Liu, Zirui Wu, Ye Tian

entry.summary: Proposes a behavior-guided method for generating high-risk lane change scenarios using optimized sequence GANs for emergency behavior learning, designed for autonomous driving simulation testing.

entry.title: The Deep-Match Framework for Event-Related Potential Detection in EEG

author.name: Marek Zylinski, Bartosz Tomasz Smigielski, Gerard Cybulski

entry.summary: Proposes a deep learning framework for single-trial ERP detection in EEG using a two-stage encoder-decoder approach with ERP template incorporation, comparing standard and template-enhanced variants.

entry.title: JCAS-MARL: Joint Communication and Sensing UAV Networks via Resource-Constrained Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Islam Guven, Mehmet Parlak

entry.summary: Proposes JCAS-MARL, a multi-agent RL framework for joint communication and sensing UAV networks, where drones jointly optimize trajectory and OFDM resource allocation for waste hotspot detection.

entry.title: Shift-Invariant Feature Attribution in the Application of Wireless Electrocardiograms

entry.summary: Presents a multi-stage fine-tuning methodology for 13-class white blood cell classification using DINOBloom-base with multiple classifier head families (linear, cosine, MLP) for the WBCBench 2026 Challenge.

entry.title: Enhancing Brain Tumor Classification Using Vision Transformers with Colormap-Based Feature Representation on BRISC2025 Dataset

author.name: Faisal Ahmed

entry.summary: Applies Vision Transformers with colormap-based feature representation for brain tumor classification on the BRISC2025 dataset, achieving improved multi-class classification across glioma, meningioma, pituitary tumor, and non-tumor cases.

entry.title: Riverine Land Cover Mapping through Semantic Segmentation of Multispectral Point Clouds

author.name: Sopitta Thurachen, Josef Taher, Matti Lehtom\"aki, Leena Matikainen, Linnea Bl{\aa}field, Mikel Calle Navarro, Antero Kukko, Tomi Westerlund, Harri Kaartinen

entry.summary: Applies Point Transformer v2 for land cover mapping in riverine environments using multispectral LiDAR point clouds, mapping classes like sand, gravel, and vegetation.

entry.title: FIGURA: A Modular Prompt Engineering Method for Artistic Figure Photography in Safety-Filtered Text-to-Image Models

author.name: Luca Cazzaniga

entry.summary: Presents the FIGURA Method, a modular prompt engineering system to generate artistic figure photography within safety filter constraints of commercial T2I models like FLUX 2 Pro.

entry.title: Elite Lanes: Evolutionary Generation of Realistic Small-Scale Road Networks

author.name: Artur Morys-Magiera, Marek D{\l}ugosz, Pawe{\l} Skruch

entry.summary: Compares evolutionary algorithms, Wave Function Collapse, and swarm methods for generating realistic road networks with connectivity and redundancy constraints.

entry.title: Affordance-Guided Enveloping Grasp Demonstration Toward Non-destructive Disassembly of Pinch-Infeasible Mating Parts

author.name: Masaki Tsutsumi, Takuya Kiyokawa, Gen Sako, Kensuke Harada

entry.summary: Proposes affordance-guided teleoperation for enveloping grasps on hard-to-pinch mating parts during disassembly. Pre-generates grasp candidates via physics simulation and visualizes them with quality-graded color overlays to assist operators.

entry.title: Directional Mollification for Controlled Smooth Path Generation

author.name: Alfredo Gonz\'alez-Calvin, Juan F. Jim\'enez, H\'ector Garc\'ia de Marina

entry.summary: Proposes directional mollification for smooth path generation from discrete waypoints, extending the mollification approach to handle corner cutting artifacts near sharp turns. Provides formal smoothness and curvature guarantees.

entry.title: MineRobot: A Unified Framework for Kinematics Modeling and Solving of Underground Mining Robots in Virtual Environments

author.name: Shengzhe Hou, Xinming Lu, Tianyu Zhang, Changqing Yan, Xingli Zhang

entry.summary: MineRobot provides a unified framework for kinematics modeling and solving of underground mining robots in virtual environments, introducing a domain-specific description format (MRDF) for closed-chain mechanisms common in mining equipment.

entry.title: Leveraging Natural Language Processing and Machine Learning for Evidence-Based Food Security Policy Decision-Making in Data-Scarce Making

author.name: Karan Kumar Singh, Nikita Gajbhiye

entry.summary: Proposes ZeroHungerAI, an NLP/ML framework for food security policy decision-making in data-scarce regions, combining structured indicators with DistilBERT text embeddings for policy classification.

entry.title: BadminSense: Enabling Fine-Grained Badminton Stroke Evaluation on a Single Smartwatch

author.name: Taizhou Chen, Kai Chen, Xingyu Liu, Pingchuan Ke, Zhida Sun

entry.summary: Presents BadminSense, a smartwatch-based system for fine-grained badminton performance analysis including stroke classification, quality prediction, and shuttle impact location estimation using wearable sensors.

entry.title: MISApp: Multi-Hop Intent-Aware Session Graph Learning for Next App Prediction

author.name: Yunchi Yang, Longlong Li, Jianliang Wu, Cunquan Qu

entry.summary: Proposes MISApp for next mobile app prediction using multi-hop session graph learning to capture higher-order structural dependencies and evolving session intent without user profiles.

entry.title: BOOST-RPF: Boosted Sequential Trees for Radial Power Flow

author.name: Ehimare Okoyomon, Christoph Goebel

entry.summary: Reformulates power flow voltage prediction from a global graph regression task into a sequential path-based learning problem using gradient-boosted decision trees, with physics-informed residual variants for radial distribution networks.

entry.title: Ensemble of Small Classifiers For Imbalanced White Blood Cell Classification

author.name: Siddharth Srivastava, Adam Smith, Scott Brooks, Jack Bacon, Till Bretschneider

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight ensemble of pretrained models (SwinV2-Tiny, DinoBloom-Small, ConvNeXT-V2-Tiny) for white blood cell classification with dataset expansion for class imbalance.

entry.title: Deep Adaptive Rate Allocation in Volatile Heterogeneous Wireless Networks

author.name: Gregorio Maglione, Veselin Rakocevic, Markus Amend, Touraj Soleymani

entry.summary: Integrates Transformer-based path state forecasting with deep RL for multipath scheduling in 5G+ vehicular networks.

entry.title: MOELIGA: a multi-objective evolutionary approach for feature selection with local improvement

author.name: Leandro Vignolo, Matias Gerard

entry.summary: Proposes MOELIGA, a multi-objective genetic algorithm with evolutionary local improvement strategy for feature selection, using crowding-based fitness sharing.

entry.title: TabPFN Extensions for Interpretable Geotechnical Modelling

author.name: Taiga Saito, Yu Otake, Daijiro Mizutani, Stephen Wu

entry.summary: Explores TabPFN (transformer-based tabular foundation model) and its extensions for geotechnical site characterization tasks including soil classification and parameter imputation.

entry.title: Learning to Optimize Joint Source and RIS-assisted Channel Encoding for Multi-User Semantic Communication Systems

author.name: Haidong Wang, Songhan Zhao, Bo Gu, Shimin Gong, Hongyang Du, Ping Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a joint source and RIS-assisted channel encoding framework for multi-user semantic communications, optimizing energy efficiency through user scheduling, RIS phase shifts, and compression ratios.

entry.title: Engineering Distributed Governance for Regional Prosperity: A Socio-Technical Framework for Mitigating Under-Vibrancy via Human Data Engines

author.name: Amil Khanzada, Takuji Takemoto

entry.summary: Introduces Distributed Human Data Engine (DHDE) framework for regional economic optimization, applied to Japan's least-visited prefecture. Uses AI-driven decision support to address 'under-vibrancy' in declining regions.

entry.title: Can I guess where you are from? Modeling dialectal morphosyntactic similarities in Brazilian Portuguese

author.name: Manoel Siqueira, Raquel Freitag

entry.summary: Investigates morphosyntactic covariation in Brazilian Portuguese to assess whether dialectal origin can be inferred. Finds clustering reveals regional patterns better than pairwise correlation.

entry.title: A Backbone Benchmarking Study on Self-supervised Learning as a Auxiliary Task with Texture-based Local Descriptors for Face Analysis

author.name: Shukesh Reddy, Abhijit Das

entry.summary: Benchmarks different backbones for self-supervised learning as an auxiliary task with texture-based local descriptors for face analysis, studying the impact of shallow to deep architectures.

entry.title: AI Token Futures Market: Commoditization of Compute and Derivatives Contract Design

author.name: Yicai Xing

entry.summary: Proposes treating AI inference tokens as commodities and designs standardized token futures contracts (Standard Inference Token), drawing parallels with electricity futures markets.

entry.title: Profiling learners' affective engagement: Emotion AI, intercultural pragmatics, and language learning

author.name: Robert Godwin-Jones

entry.summary: Discusses emotion AI and intercultural pragmatics in language learning, exploring how affective engagement profiling can support second language acquisition through AI-based tools.

entry.title: Revenue-Sharing as Infrastructure: A Distributed Business Model for Generative AI Platforms

author.name: Ghislain Dorian Tchuente Mondjo

entry.summary: Proposes 'Revenue-Sharing as Infrastructure' (RSI), a business model where AI platforms offer free API access to developers in exchange for revenue sharing on generated income, aiming to lower barriers for developers in emerging economies.

entry.title: Deep Attention-based Sequential Ensemble Learning for BLE-Based Indoor Localization in Care Facilities

author.name: Minh Triet Pham, Quynh Chi Dang, Le Nhat Tan

entry.summary: Proposes DASEL for BLE-based indoor localization in care facilities, using bidirectional GRU with attention and confidence-weighted temporal smoothing to treat localization as a sequential learning problem.

entry.title: Benchmarking Scientific Machine Learning Models for Air Quality Data

author.name: Khawja Imran Masud, Venkata Sai Rahul Unnam, Sahara Ali

entry.summary: Benchmarks classical time-series, ML, and deep learning approaches for multi-horizon air quality forecasting in North Texas with physics-guided approaches.

entry.title: MiSiSUn: Minimum Simplex Semisupervised Unmixing

author.name: Behnood Rasti, Bikram Koirala, Paul Scheunders

entry.summary: Proposes MiSiSUn, a semisupervised geometric unmixing approach incorporating simplex-volume penalties into library-based unmixing for remote sensing data.

entry.title: Hetero-Net: An Energy-Efficient Resource Allocation and 3D Placement in Heterogeneous LoRa Networks via Multi-Agent Optimization

author.name: Abdullahi Isa Ahmed, Ana Maria Dr\u{a}gulinescu, El Mehdi Amhoud

entry.summary: Proposes Hetero-Net, a heterogeneous LoRa framework integrating ground and underground sensor networks with UAV-mounted gateways using multi-agent optimization.

entry.title: The Global-Local loop: what is missing in bridging the gap between geospatial data from numerous communities?

author.name: Cl\'ement Mallet, Ana-Maria Raimond

entry.summary: Position paper arguing for better integration of diverse geospatial data sources, critiquing current 'master-slave' paradigms in remote sensing data fusion.

entry.title: Image-Based Structural Analysis Using Computer Vision and LLMs: PhotoBeamSolver

author.name: Altamirano-Mu\~niz Emilio Fernando

entry.summary: Presents PhotoBeamSolver, a program that solves idealized beam models from hand-drawn diagrams using computer vision and LLMs, exploring the integration of CV into structural analysis for civil engineering education.

entry.title: Kelly Criterion is for Cowards

author.name: X4vier

entry.summary: Provocatively argues that the Kelly Criterion's bet sizing is too conservative for most people, since the standard recommendation maximizes log-wealth but most people's utility curves are less concave than log. Provides mathematical analysis of optimal betting under different utility functions.

entry.title: Democratizing AI: A Comparative Study in Deep Learning Efficiency and Future Trends in Computational Processing

author.name: Lisan Al Amin, Md Ismail Hossain, Rupak Kumar Das, Mahbubul Islam, Saddam Mukta, Abdulaziz Tabbakh

entry.summary: Benchmarks four deep learning models across TensorFlow/PyTorch on CPUs vs GPUs, showing 11x-246x speedups and analyzing democratization implications for AI compute access.

entry.title: Vibecoders can't build for longevity

author.name: dominicq

entry.summary: Argues that vibecoding (shipping AI-generated code without reading it) is incompatible with Naur's 'Programming as Theory Building' framework, because long-term software maintenance requires understanding the underlying theory behind design decisions.

entry.title: Artificial Intelligence in Experimental Approaches: Growth Hacking, Lean Startup, Design Thinking, and Agile

author.name: Parisa Omidmand, Saeid Ataei

entry.summary: Systematic literature review of AI integration with experimental business methodologies (growth hacking, lean startup, design thinking, agile), analyzing 37 articles from 2018-2024.

entry.title: Ontology-driven personalized information retrieval for XML documents

author.name: Ounnaci Iddir, Ahmed-ouamer Rachid, Tai Dinh

entry.summary: Proposes ontology-driven personalized XML document retrieval integrating domain ontologies and user profiles with concept-weighted vector representations.

entry.title: Architecture for Multi-Unmanned Aerial Vehicles based Autonomous Precision Agriculture Systems

author.name: Ebasa Temesgen, Nathnael Minyelshowa, Lebsework Negash

entry.summary: Defines an architectural framework for multi-UAV systems in precision agriculture, modeling tasks like image processing, path planning, and field mapping.

entry.title: BHDD: A Burmese Handwritten Digit Dataset

author.name: Swan Htet Aung, Hein Htet, Htoo Say Wah Khaing, Thuya Myo Nyunt

entry.summary: Introduces BHDD, a Burmese handwritten digit dataset with 87,561 images following MNIST format. Provides baselines reaching 99.8% accuracy and analyzes confusion patterns in Myanmar script.

entry.title: Some things I noticed while LARPing as a grantmaker

author.name: Zach Stein-Perlman

entry.summary: Practical advice for grantmakers in AI safety, arguing that most value comes from finding/creating projects far above the funding bar rather than discriminating between marginal proposals. Emphasizes proactive research identification over reactive evaluation.

entry.title: Representative Futarchy

author.name: goldfine

entry.summary: Proposes 'representative futarchy' as a governance model where elected representatives make policy decisions guided by prediction markets, combining representative democracy with futarchy's information aggregation benefits.

entry.title: Set the Line Before It's Crossed

author.name: nomagicpill

entry.summary: Discusses the importance of proactively setting behavioral lines/boundaries before they are crossed, with relevance to AI governance and policy. Covers soft, firm, and hard lines and how normalization of deviance erodes standards.

entry.title: AI-Driven Multi-Agent Simulation of Stratified Polyamory Systems: A Computational Framework for Optimizing Social Reproductive Efficiency

author.name: Yicai Xing

entry.summary: Proposes a computational framework for modeling a 'Stratified Polyamory System' (SPS) using AI multi-agent simulation, framed as addressing declining fertility rates.

entry.title: Fuel Consumption Prediction: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Paradigms

author.name: Ali Akram

entry.summary: Comparative analysis of ML methods (linear regression, SVM, logistic regression) for vehicle fuel consumption prediction using the Motor Trend dataset.

entry.title: Universal Coefficients and Mayer-Vietoris for Moore Homology of Ample Groupoids

author.name: Luciano Melodia

entry.summary: Establishes universal coefficient theorem and Mayer-Vietoris sequence for Moore homology of ample groupoids.

entry.title: Hollywood ACX Meetup - April 2026

author.name: Timothy M.

entry.summary: A meetup announcement for an ACX group in Hollywood, April 2026. No research content.
